Image (JPEG, PNG, GIF, SVG, PSD, TIFF), Audio (MP3, WAV, AAC, OGG), and Video (MP4, AVI, MKV, MOV, WMV) codecs and containers.
Stages of multimedia production (planning, design, production, testing, distribution) and card/page, icon, and time-based authoring tools.
Image editing (layers, masks, curves, healing brush, clone stamp), audio editing (trimming, noise reduction, mixing), and non-linear video editing (timeline, transitions, chroma key).

topics.topic_name: Information and Computer Security & Impact on Society
topics.description: National critical infrastructure protection, digital trust, e-banking/e-government security, and societal implications of cyber incidents.
Data privacy vs data security, personally identifiable information (PII), digital footprints, cookies, and data protection rights.
Advanced malware (ransomware, rootkits, keyloggers, botnets), social engineering (phishing, spear-phishing, pretexting), SQL injection, and Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attacks.
Technical controls: encryption (symmetric & public-key), firewalls, Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), VPNs, patch management, and biometric access control.
Cyber defense frameworks, ethical hacking vs black-hat cracking, incident response, and Ethiopian Computer Crime Proclamation.
Role of algorithms in computer science, translating real-world logic into unambiguous computational instructions.
Finiteness, definiteness (unambiguity), input, output, effectiveness, and generality of a valid algorithm.
Representing algorithms using structured Pseudocode and standard Flowcharts for sequence, selection (IF-ELSE), and iteration (WHILE, FOR) problems; trace tables.
Components of an IDE (source code editor, compiler vs interpreter, debugger, build automation, console) and writing/executing basic programs.

topics.topic_name: Overview of the World's Major Landforms
topics.description: Endogenic (tectonic folding, faulting, volcanism) and exogenic (weathering, erosion, deposition) processes; mountains, plateaus, and plains.

topics.topic_name: Location and Related Features of Africa
topics.description: Astronomical (37°21'N to 34°52'S, 17°33'W to 51°28'E) and relative location of Africa, compactness, coastline, and area (30.37 million km²).
Atlas Mountains, Sahara Desert, Sahel, Sudanian Savanna, African Massif, East African Rift System & Highlands, and Southern Africa Platform (Drakensberg, Kalahari, Namib).

topics.topic_name: Overview of World Climatic Regions and Types
topics.description: Global climate classification schemes (ancient Greek torrid/temperate/frigid and Köppen empirical classification system).

topics.topic_name: Climate Types and Zones of Africa
topics.description: Controls of African climate (latitude/ITCZ, ocean currents, altitude, continentality) and the 7 climate zones: Equatorial, Tropical Wet-and-Dry (Savanna), Semi-arid (Sahel), Hot Desert, Mediterranean, Humid Subtropical, and Highland.

topics.topic_name: Benefits of Climate for Life of People of Africa
topics.description: Solar/wind/hydro energy potential, diverse agro-climatic zones, bimodal rainfall, and wildlife tourism.

topics.topic_name: Climate Change and Its Challenges to Africa's Development Vision
topics.description: Vulnerability of African rain-fed agriculture, recurrent droughts in the Horn and Sahel, desertification, and adaptation/mitigation strategies.

topics.topic_name: Overview of Major Natural Resources of the World
topics.description: Renewable vs non-renewable resources and sustainable resource management.

topics.topic_name: Major Drainage and Water Resources in Africa
topics.description: Major rivers (Nile, Congo, Niger, Zambezi, Orange, Limpopo), Rift Valley & Victoria lakes, swamps (Sudd, Okavango, Chad), and hydro-power dams (GERD, Aswan, Kariba, Inga, Akosombo).

topics.topic_name: Main Types of Soils and Mineral Resources in Africa
topics.description: African soil groups (Ferralsols, Arenosols, Lixisols, Nitisols, Vertisols, Calcisols) and strategic mineral wealth (gold, diamonds, cobalt, platinum, copper, bauxite, petroleum).

topics.topic_name: Major Vegetation and Wildlife of Africa
topics.description: Tropical rainforest, savanna (parkland, acacia, scrub), desert xerophytes, Mediterranean maquis, Afro-montane vegetation, rich megafauna, and conservation challenges (poaching, deforestation).

topics.topic_name: Overview of World Population Growth and Size
topics.description: Global demographic growth trends, doubling time, and regional population shares.
High fertility and birth rates, declining mortality, rapid natural increase, infant mortality rate, and life expectancy in Africa.
Broad-based youthful age-sex pyramid of Africa, high youth dependency ratio, sex ratio, and demographic dividend potential.

topics.topic_name: Distribution and Density of Africa's Population
topics.description: Densely populated regions (Nile Valley, West African coast, East African Highlands) vs sparsely populated deserts and rainforest basins.

topics.topic_name: Urban and Rural Settlement Patterns in Africa
topics.description: Rural agrarian Dominance vs rapid urbanization rate, primate cities, informal settlements, and urban infrastructure.

topics.topic_name: Overview of Employment Structure in the World
topics.description: Primary, secondary, tertiary, and quaternary economic sectors across developed and developing nations.
Subsistence vs plantation agriculture (cocoa, coffee, tea, cotton, palm oil), pastoralism, forestry, fishing, mining, and nascent manufacturing.

topics.topic_name: Possible Solutions to the Problem of Unemployment
topics.description: Youth unemployment in Africa, TVET skill development, entrepreneurship, agro-processing industrialization, and digital jobs.
The African Union's 50-year strategic framework ("The Africa We Want"), flagship projects, and AfCFTA continental free trade.

topics.topic_name: Africa's Agenda 2063 Vis-À-Vis Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
topics.description: Alignment between AU Agenda 2063 aspirations and the UN 2030 Sustainable Development Goals.

topics.topic_name: Linguistic and Religious Diversity in Africa
topics.description: Afro-Asiatic, Niger-Congo, Nilo-Saharan, and Khoisan language families; indigenous beliefs, Islam, and Christianity in Africa.
Population growth pressures on global land, water, energy, and ecological carrying capacity.
Environmental determinism, possibilism, and human modification of landscapes (overgrazing, deforestation, pollution, irrigation).

topics.topic_name: Indigenous Knowledge in Conservation of Natural Resources in Africa
topics.description: Traditional African agroforestry, Konso terracing, sacred groves, rotational pastoralism, and water harvesting.
Causes and consequences of rapid unplanned urban sprawl: slums, sanitation deficits, traffic congestion, unemployment, and urban planning remedies.

topics.topic_name: Migration – Factors and Impacts on Africa
topics.description: Internal displacement, rural-urban migration, trans-Mediterranean and Red Sea irregular migration routes, brain drain, and remittances.
Oil spills (Niger Delta), plastic waste, untreated sewage, industrial effluent, mangrove destruction, and marine ecosystem protection.
Spatial vs attribute data, georeferencing, coordinates, and importance of geospatial intelligence.

topics.topic_name: Sources and Tools of Geographic Data
topics.description: Field surveys, census, aerial photography, satellite remote sensing, Global Positioning System (GPS), and GIS software.
Vector data model (points, lines, polygons) vs Raster data model (grid cells/pixels), qualitative and quantitative thematic maps.

topics.topic_name: Advances in Mapmaking and the Birth of GIS
topics.description: Evolution from manual cartography to digital Geographic Information Systems (hardware, software, data, people, methods) and layer overlay analysis.

topics.topic_name: Making and Interpretation of Graphs, Charts and Diagrams
topics.description: Constructing and analyzing climographs (temperature-rainfall), line graphs, bar graphs, pie charts, and population pyramids.

topics.topic_name: የቋንቋና የማህበረሰብ ቁርኝት (ዳመና፣ ቀለምና የቋንቋ አገልግሎት)
topics.description: ቋንቋ ማህበራዊ ማንነትን፣ ባህልንና እሴትን በመግለጽ ረገድ ያለው ሚና።

topics.topic_name: የቃላት አውዳዊ ፍቺ እና የቃላት ምስረታ (ቅጥያዎች)
topics.description: ነጻና ጥገኛ ምዕላዶች፣ እርባታዊና መስራች ቅጥያዎች በአማርኛ ቃላት አወቃቀር።
ኃይለ-ቃል (መሪ አረፍተ-ነገር)፣ መዘርዝር አረፍተ-ነገሮች እና የአንቀጽ ውህደት።
በኢትዮጵያ የተለያዩ ማህበረሰቦች የሚከናወኑ ባህላዊ የጋብቻ ስርዓቶች፣ ሽምግልና እና ቃል-ኪዳን።
ከጋብቻና ማህበራዊ ህይወት ጋር የተያያዙ ፈሊጦች፣ ምሳሌያዊ አነጋገሮች እና ቃላዊ ግጥሞች።
ስማዊ ሐረግ፣ ቅጽላዊ ሐረግ፣ መሪና ተከታይ (መስተፃምራዊ) አካላት ትንተና።
ሴቶች በኢኮኖሚ፣ በፖለቲካ፣ በሳይንስና በማህበራዊ ልማት ያላቸው ጉልህ አስተዋጽኦ።
በመረጃ የተደገፈ ክርክር ማቅረብ፣ የሌሎችን ሀሳብ ማዳመጥና በምክንያት ማስተባበል።
የግሳዊ ሐረግ አركን፣ ባለቤትና ማሰሪያ አንቀጽ በፆታ፣ በቁጥርና በመደብ መስማማት።
የባህል፣ የቋንቋና የታሪክ ትስስር ለጠንካራ ሀገራዊ አንድነት ያለው ፋይዳ።
የድርሰት ቢጋር (አስተዋጽኦ) ማዘጋጀት፣ መግቢያ፣ ሐተታና መደምደሚያ።
ነጻና ጥገኛ አንቀጾችን በአያያዥ ቃላትና ምዕላዶች በማቀናጀት ውስብስብ አረፍተ-ነገር መመስረት።
ሰምና ወርቅ፣ ተነጻጻሪ፣ ተለዋጭ፣ ሰውኛ፣ ግነት እና ምጸት ዘይቤዎች።
ስንኝ፣ ሐረግ፣ አርኬ፣ ቀለም፣ የቤት መድፊያ ድምፆችና የግጥም ትንተና።
የቃላት እማሬያዊና ፍካሬያዊ ፍቺዎች፣ አውዳዊ ተመሳሳይነትና ተቃራኒነት።
የታሪክ፣ የጥበብና የሳይንስ ታላላቅ ሰዎች የህይወት ተሞክሮና ለትውልድ ያስተላለፉት ቅርስ።
የራስን የህይወት ታሪክና የሌሎች ታዋቂ ሰዎችን የህይወት ታሪክ በቅደም-ተከተል መጻፍ።

topics.topic_name: አድራጊና ተገብሮ ግሶች እንዲሁም ቀጥተኛና ኢ-ቀጥተኛ ንግግር
topics.description: የድርጊትና የተገብሮ አረፍተ-ነገሮች ቅየራ እና የተናጋሪ ንግግርን ሪፖርት ማድረግ።

ከታዋቂ የአማርኛ ረጅም ልቦለዶች የተወሰዱ ቅንጭቦችን በማንበብ የገፀ-ባህሪያትን ስነ-ልቦና መተንተን።

topics.topic_name: የልቦለድ ስነ-ፅሁፋዊ ዘዴዎች (ምልሰት፣ ትንቢት፣ ምናባዊ ስዕል)
topics.description: ደራሲያን ታሪክን ለማዋቀር የሚጠቀሙባቸው የምልሰት፣ የትንቢትና የገለጻ ስልቶች።

topics.topic_name: የማህበራዊ መገናኛ ብዙኀን ጠቀሜታና ስነ-ምግባራዊ ፈተናዎች
topics.description: ፈጣን መረጃ ልውውጥ፣ የሐሰት መረጃ (Fake News) ስርጭትን መከላከል እና ዲጂታል ጨዋነት።
የመስሪያ ቤት ደብዳቤ ቅርጽ፣ የስራ ማመልከቻ እና የስብሰባ ቃለ-ጉባኤ አዘገጃጀት።
የአማርኛ ስርዓተ-ነጥቦች ህግጋት እና የቴክኖሎጂ ቃላትን በአማርኛ የመተርጎም ስልቶች።

topics.topic_name: የሥራ ፈጠራ ክህሎት፣ ታታሪነትና የቁጠባ ባህል

Company Rule, British Indirect Rule (Lord Lugard), French Direct Rule (Assimilation and Association), Settler Rule, and Divide-and-Rule.

topics.topic_name: Early African Resistance Movements Against Colonialism
topics.description: Samori Toure (Mandinka Empire), Ashanti resistance (Yaa Asantewaa), Maji-Maji Rebellion (Tanganyika), Urabi Pasha (Egypt), Mahdist Sudan, and Herero-Nama uprising.

topics.topic_name: Impacts of Colonial Rule on Africa
topics.description: Arbitrary borders, loss of sovereignty, monocrop cash-crop dependency, land alienation, and infrastructure built solely for resource extraction.

topics.topic_name: Long Distance Trade & Cottage Industry in Ethiopia in the 19th Century
topics.description: Jabarti and Afqala merchants, trade routes linking Bonga/Jimma to Massawa, Zeila, Berbera, and Metemma; Maria Theresa Thaler and amole salt bars; cottage crafts (smithing, weaving, pottery, tanning).

topics.topic_name: The Making of the Modern Ethiopian State 1855–1913
topics.description: Emperor Tewodros II (ending Zemene-Mesafint, Gafat Sebastopol, Maqdala 1868), Tekle Giyorgis II, Yohannes IV (Liche Agreement 1878, Boru Meda Council), and Menelik II (territorial incorporation, founding of Addis Ababa 1886, modernization, 1907 Ministerial Cabinet).

topics.topic_name: External Aggressions and the Struggle for the Defense of National Sovereignty, 1871–1896
topics.description: Egyptian invasions defeated at Gundet (1875) and Gura (1876); Hewett (Adwa) Treaty (1884); Mahdist battles (Kufit, Metemma 1889); Italian encroachment, Dogali (1887), Treaty of Wuchale (Article XVII), and the historic Victory of Adwa (March 1, 1896).

topics.topic_name: Inception of Power Struggle Among the Ruling Elites, 1906–1935
topics.description: Empress Taytu Bitul, Lij Iyasu's reforms, 1916 coup and Battle of Segele, Dual Rule (Diarchy) of Empress Zewditu and Regent Ras Tafari Makonnen, and coronation of Emperor Haile Selassie I (1930) & 1931 Constitution.

topics.topic_name: Fascist Italian Aggression and Patriotic Resistance (1935–1941)
topics.description: Walwal Incident (1934), Northern and Southern Fronts (Amba Aradom, Tembien, Maychew, Qorahe, Genale Dorya), Italian East Africa (AOI), Graziani Massacre (Yekatit 12, 1937), Black Lions, Abune Petros, Patriots (Arbegnoch) & Women Patriots, and 1941 Liberation Campaign (Gideon Force).

topics.topic_name: The First World War: Causes, Course and the Consequence (1914–1918)
topics.description: MAIN causes (Militarism, Alliances: Triple Entente vs Triple Alliance, Imperialism, Nationalism), Sarajevo assassination, Western/Eastern fronts, US entry, and Treaty of Versailles (1919).

topics.topic_name: The October 1917 Russian Revolution: Cause, Course and Results
topics.description: Tsarist autocracy, 1905 Revolution, February 1917 Revolution, Vladimir Lenin and the Bolsheviks ("Peace, Land, and Bread"), October Revolution, Civil War (Reds vs Whites), NEP, and Stalin's Five-Year Plans.

topics.topic_name: The League of Nations & the Worldwide Economic Crisis
topics.description: Structure and weaknesses of the League of Nations; the 1929 Wall Street Crash and the Great Depression.

topics.topic_name: The Rise of Fascism in Italy, Nazism in Germany and Militarism in Japan
topics.description: Benito Mussolini's March on Rome (1922), Adolf Hitler's Nazi regime (1933), and Japanese militarist expansion into Manchuria (1931) and China (1937).

Appeasement (Munich Agreement), invasion of Poland (Sept 1, 1939), Axis vs Allies, Battle of Britain, Operation Barbarossa, Pearl Harbor, Stalingrad, El Alamein, D-Day, the Holocaust, and Hiroshima/Nagasaki.

topics.topic_name: The United Nations Organization: Formation, Mission, Principles and Achievements
topics.description: San Francisco Conference (1945), General Assembly, Security Council (5 permanent veto members), Secretariat, ICJ, and specialized agencies (WHO, UNESCO, UNICEF).

topics.topic_name: The Rise of the Superpowers and the Beginning of the Cold War
topics.description: US-Soviet ideological rivalry, Iron Curtain, Truman Doctrine, Marshall Plan, Berlin Blockade, NATO (1949) vs Warsaw Pact (1955), arms race, space race, and Cuban Missile Crisis (1962).

topics.topic_name: Situations in Asia During the Cold War: Japan, Korea, China, Vietnam
topics.description: Post-WWII reconstruction of Japan, 1949 Chinese Revolution (Mao Zedong), Korean War (1950–53), and Vietnam War (Ho Chi Minh, Dien Bien Phu, US withdrawal 1973–75).

topics.topic_name: The Non-Aligned Movement (NAM) & the Arab-Israeli Conflict
topics.description: Bandung Conference (1955) and Belgrade (1961); Zionism, 1947 UN Partition of Palestine, 1948 War, 1956 Suez Crisis, 1967 Six-Day War, 1973 Yom Kippur War, and Camp David Accords.

topics.topic_name: The Collapse of the Soviet Union
topics.description: Mikhail Gorbachev's Glasnost (openness) and Perestroika (restructuring), 1989 fall of the Berlin Wall, and 1991 dissolution of the USSR.

topics.topic_name: Major Post-Liberation Administrative Reforms & Socio-Economic Conditions
topics.description: Anglo-Ethiopian Agreements (1942, 1944), Point Four & Ethio-US alliance (Kagnew Station), 1952 Federation and 1962 union of Eritrea, 1955 Revised Constitution, education expansion (UCAA/HSIU), and feudal land tenure (Gebbar/Chisegna).

topics.topic_name: Early Opposition Movements Against the Imperial Rule
topics.description: 1943 Woyane Rebellion, 1960 Abortive Coup (Mengistu and Germame Neway), Bale Peasant Rebellion (Waqqo Gutu), Gojjam Peasant Rebellion (1968), Macha-Tulama Association (Tadesse Birru), Eritrean armed struggle, and the Ethiopian Student Movement ("Land to the Tiller").

topics.topic_name: The Ethiopian Revolution and the Fall of the Monarchy
topics.description: 1973 Wollo famine, February 1974 popular uprisings, formation of the Derg, deposition of Haile Selassie (Sept 12, 1974), Zemacha, 1975 Rural and Urban Land Nationalization Proclamations, and the Red Terror (1977–78).

topics.topic_name: The Ethio-Somalia War, Question of Eritrea, and the Fall of the Derg
topics.description: 1977–78 Ogaden War (Karamara victory), 1984–85 famine and resettlement/villagization, 1987 PDRE Constitution, Battle of Afabet and Shire, and May 1991 collapse of the Derg regime.

topics.topic_name: Rise of Independent States in Africa
topics.description: National liberation across North, West (Kwame Nkrumah in Ghana 1957, Guinea 1958, "Year of Africa" 1960), East (Mau Mau in Kenya, Julius Nyerere in Tanzania), and Lusophone/Southern Africa (Algerian FLN, Angola MPLA, Mozambique FRELIMO, Zimbabwe 1980).

topics.topic_name: Struggle Against Apartheid, Pan-Africanism and the OAU
topics.description: Casablanca vs Monrovia blocs, founding of the Organization of African Unity (OAU) in Addis Ababa (May 25, 1963), transformation into the African Union (AU, 2002), and anti-Apartheid victory in South Africa (ANC, Nelson Mandela, 1994).
Neo-colonialism, structural adjustment programs, Lagos Plan of Action, NEPAD, and Regional Economic Communities (ECOWAS, COMESA, SADC, EAC, IGAD).
Military coups, ethnic conflicts (1994 Rwandan genocide), external debt, poverty, HIV/AIDS, climate change, and democratization.

topics.topic_name: The Transitional Government of Ethiopia (TGE) and the 1995 Constitution
topics.description: July 1991 Peace and Democracy Conference, Transitional Charter, 1993 Eritrean Referendum, and the 1995 FDRE Constitution establishing multinational federalism.

topics.topic_name: Hydro-Political History of the Nile (Abay) Basin and Development Issues
topics.description: Colonial-era 1929 and 1959 Nile treaties excluding Ethiopia, Nile Basin Initiative (NBI), Cooperative Framework Agreement (CFA), and the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam (GERD, launched 2011).

Infrastructure expansion (roads, universities, telecom, railways, industrial parks), poverty reduction, 1998–2000 Ethio-Eritrean War (Algiers Agreement) & 2018 Peace Accord, and ongoing democratization reforms.

topics.topic_name: Indigenous Knowledge and Its Role in Sustainable Development
topics.description: Characteristics of Ethiopian indigenous knowledge: traditional medicine, weather forecasting, soil/water conservation (Konso terracing), social welfare (Iddir, Iqub, Debo/Jigie), and conflict resolution.

Tangible and intangible UNESCO World Heritage sites of Ethiopia: Rock-Hewn Churches of Lalibela, Simien Mountains, Fasil Ghebbi, Aksum, Lower Valley of the Awash & Omo, Tiya, Harar Jugol, Konso Cultural Landscape, Bale Mountains, Gedeo Cultural Landscape, Meskel, Fichee-Chambalaalla, Gadaa System, Timket, and Shuwalid.

topics.topic_name: Historical Development and Modern Atomic Theory
topics.description: Dalton postulates, discoveries of electron (Thomson, Millikan), nucleus (Rutherford), and neutron (Chadwick).

topics.topic_name: Subatomic Particles, Atomic Mass, and Isotopes
topics.description: Mass spectrometry, atomic mass unit definitions, isotopic abundance calculations, and nuclear notations.

topics.topic_name: Electromagnetic Radiation, Quantum Theory & Bohr Model
topics.description: Planck constant, photoelectric effect, hydrogen emission spectrum lines (Lyman, Balmer), and Bohr orbits.

topics.topic_name: Quantum Mechanical Model of the Atom
topics.description: De Broglie matter waves, Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle, quantum numbers (n, l, ml, ms), and orbital shapes.
Pauli Exclusion Principle, Hund rule of maximum multiplicity, orbital diagrams, and anomalies (Cr, Cu).

topics.topic_name: Modern Periodic Table and Periodic Trends
topics.description: Atomic radii, ionic radii, ionization energy trends, electron affinity, and electronegativity scales.
Lewis dot structures, octet rule, Born-Haber thermochemical cycle, and properties of crystalline ionic solids.
Single, double, triple bonds, coordinate covalent bonds, resonance hybrids, and formal charge calculations.
Electron pair repulsion geometries: linear, trigonal planar, tetrahedral, trigonal bipyramidal, and octahedral.
Dipole-dipole interactions, hydrogen bonding, and London dispersion forces influencing melting and boiling points.
Electron-sea model, metallic luster, malleability, electrical conductivity, and ionic/molecular/covalent network crystals.
Sigma and pi orbital overlap, sp, sp2, sp3, sp3d, and sp3d2 hybridizations with bond angle derivations.
Bonding and antibonding molecular orbitals, bond order calculations, and magnetic behavior of homonuclear diatomics.
Postulates of KMT, microscopic particle dynamics in solids, liquids, and gases, and kinetic temperature.

topics.topic_name: The Gaseous State and Ideal Gas Laws
topics.description: Boyle law, Charles law, Gay-Lussac law, Avogadro law, and the combined Ideal Gas Equation (PV = nRT).

topics.topic_name: Gas Stoichiometry and Dalton Law of Partial Pressures
topics.description: Mole fractions, partial pressures, collection of gases over water, and Graham law of effusion and diffusion.

topics.topic_name: Real Gases and Deviations from Ideal Behavior
topics.description: Intermolecular attractions and finite molecular volume, Van der Waals equation of state.

topics.topic_name: The Liquid State: Viscosity, Surface Tension & Vapor Pressure
topics.description: Dynamic equilibrium, boiling point variations with atmospheric pressure, Clausius-Clapeyron relation.

topics.topic_name: The Solid State and Phase Diagrams
topics.description: Unit cells, packing efficiency, phase changes, heating curves, triple point, and critical point in phase diagrams.

topics.topic_name: Rate of Chemical Reaction and Rate Expressions
topics.description: Average vs. instantaneous rates, differential rate laws, reaction orders (zero, first, second), and rate constant k.
Effect of nature of reactants, concentration, surface area, temperature, and catalysts.

topics.topic_name: Collision Theory and Transition State Theory
topics.description: Effective collisions, activation energy (Ea), steric factors, and reaction coordinate energy profiles.

topics.topic_name: The Arrhenius Equation and Reaction Mechanisms
topics.description: Arrhenius plot (ln k vs 1/T), elementary steps, molecularity, and rate-determining step determination.
Reversibility of reactions, forward and reverse rate equality, and constancy of macroscopic properties.
Law of mass action, relationship between Kc and Kp (Kp = Kc(RT)^dn), and heterogeneous equilibria expressions.
Reaction quotient (Qc) comparisons, predicting reaction direction, and equilibrium concentration ICE tables.

topics.topic_name: Le Chatelier Principle and Equilibrium Shifts
topics.description: Effects of changing concentration, pressure, volume, temperature, and inert gas additions on equilibrium.
Haber-Bosch ammonia synthesis and Contact process for sulfuric acid: thermodynamic vs. kinetic optimization.

topics.topic_name: Alcohols and Ethers: Classification and Properties
topics.description: Primary, secondary, tertiary alcohols, IUPAC nomenclature, hydrogen bonding, dehydration, and ether synthesis.

topics.topic_name: Aldehydes and Ketones: Carbonyl Group Chemistry
topics.description: Structure, nomenclature, oxidation reactions, Tollens and Fehling tests, and nucleophilic addition reactions.
Carboxyl group resonance stabilization, inductive effects on pKa, esterification, and fatty acid classifications.
Fischer esterification mechanism, fragrance compounds, alkaline hydrolysis (saponification), and soap making.

topics.topic_name: Fats and Oils: Structure, Hardening & Rancidity
topics.description: Triglyceride structures, saturated vs unsaturated fatty acids, catalytic hydrogenation of oils, and lipid oxidation.

topics.topic_name: Listening: Natural and Anthropogenic Environmental Hazards
topics.description: Identifying main ideas, acoustic discrimination, note-taking strategies, and hazard classifications.

topics.topic_name: Speaking: Discussing Disaster Preparedness in Ethiopian Regions
topics.description: Expressing viewpoints, modal certainty, group deliberation, and formal presentation conventions.

topics.topic_name: Reading: Drought, Deforestation and Ecological Balance
topics.description: Skimming, scanning, contextual lexical inference, cause-and-effect rhetorical patterns, and critical analysis.
Affixes, environmental collocation pairs, register distinctions, and idiomatic ecological phrases.

topics.topic_name: Grammar: Present Perfect vs. Past Simple in Environmental Reports
topics.description: Aspectual contrasts, time adverbials (since, for, already, recently), and active-passive environmental constructions.
Causal linkers (consequently, due to, as a result of), topic sentences, evidentiary elaboration, and concluding remarks.

topics.topic_name: Listening: Ancient Civilizations and Ethiopian Archaeological Heritage
topics.description: Axumite kingdom, Lalibela rock-hewn architecture, historical chronology, and audio note extraction.

topics.topic_name: Speaking: Debating Attributes of Ancient and Modern Societies
topics.description: Persuasive rhetoric, formal refutations, turn-taking markers, and consensus negotiation.

topics.topic_name: Reading: Evolutionary Trajectory of Agrarian and Urban Settlements
topics.description: Textual cohesion, pronoun referencing, identifying author perspective, and synthesis across historical passages.
Domain-specific vocabulary, archaic vs modern linguistic shifts, and structural word formation.

topics.topic_name: Grammar: Past Perfect and Past Continuous Narrative Tenses
topics.description: Time sequencers (prior to, by the time, while), narrative progression, and reported speech transformations.
Timeline connectors, transitional coherence, paragraph organization, and thesis statement formulation.

topics.topic_name: Listening: Traffic Safety and Road Statistics in Ethiopia
topics.description: Statistical data interpretation from speech, identifying warning signs, and synthesizing auditory facts.

topics.topic_name: Speaking: Proposing Community Interventions for Road Safety
topics.description: Giving recommendations (should, ought to, must), asking clarifying questions, and cooperative problem-solving.

topics.topic_name: Reading: Behavioral, Mechanical and Infrastructural Risk Factors
topics.description: Categorization of risk variables, identifying logical fallacies, and comparative reading analysis.

topics.topic_name: Vocabulary: Vehicular Dynamics, Highway Codes & Emergency Response
topics.description: Traffic regulation terminology, phrasal verbs related to travel and transit, and emergency jargon.

topics.topic_name: Grammar: Modal Verbs of Obligation, Prohibition & Advice
topics.description: Must, mustn't, have to, need to, should, had better; degrees of prescriptive force and formal legal discourse.

topics.topic_name: Writing: Problem-Solution Proposals for Municipal Transit
topics.description: Executive proposal format, problem statement, feasible interventions, budget/resource justification, and call to action.
Comprehending lectures on resource depletion, note-taking in outline format, and speaker tone detection.

topics.topic_name: Speaking: Role-Playing Stakeholder Summits on Land and Water
topics.description: Diplomatic discourse registers, conditional concessions (provided that, as long as), and active listening.

topics.topic_name: Reading: Indigenous Conservation Systems and Forest Stewardship
topics.description: Sacred groves in Ethiopia, community pasture management, and analytical reading of socio-ecological texts.
Compound nouns, antonyms and synonyms in resource science, and formal expository terms.

topics.topic_name: Grammar: Conditionals (Zero, First, Second, and Third Conditionals)
topics.description: Real vs hypothetical conditions, unreal past regrets (If + had + V3, would have + V3), and inverted conditionals.

topics.topic_name: Writing: Evaluative Essays on Resource Exploitation vs Conservation
topics.description: Balanced argument essay structure, integrating counterarguments, conceding opposing points, and synthesizing conclusions.
Following sequential instructions, identifying technical hydraulic terminology, and diagram labeling.

topics.topic_name: Speaking: Explaining Drip vs Flood Irrigation Methodologies
topics.description: Comparative discourse markers (whereas, in contrast, similarly), clarifying technical concepts, and audience pacing.

topics.topic_name: Reading: River Basin Development in Ethiopia (Awash, Omo, Nile)
topics.description: Reading technical schematics, distinguishing between direct observations and inferences in hydro-development.
Technical agrarian terminology, water distribution vocabularies, and prefix/suffix analysis.

topics.topic_name: Grammar: Passive Voice in Scientific and Technical Descriptions
topics.description: Agent omission for objectivity, passive with modals (must be maintained), and process description flow.

topics.topic_name: Writing: Technical Process Descriptions and Field Reports
topics.description: Sequential connectors (initially, subsequently, simultaneously), objective passive register, and clear flow diagrams.

topics.topic_name: Listening: Climate Science and Greenhouse Gas Emissions
topics.description: Atmospheric physics summaries, identifying speaker bias, and noting numerical statistical trends.

topics.topic_name: Speaking: Delivering Persuasive Speeches on Carbon Reduction
topics.description: Rhetorical questions, emotive vs objective registers, vocal projection, and audience engagement.

topics.topic_name: Reading: Impacts of Global Warming on Sub-Saharan Ecosystems
topics.description: Analyzing complex academic prose, synthesizing disparate paragraphs, and evaluating evidentiary strength.

topics.topic_name: Vocabulary: Climatology, Renewable Energy & Carbon Sequestration
topics.description: Carbon footprints, greenhouse gases, mitigation terminology, and academic collocations.

topics.topic_name: Grammar: Adverbial Clauses of Contrast, Reason and Purpose
topics.description: Although, even though, whereas, in spite of, so that, in order to; sentence combining and punctuation rules.

topics.topic_name: Writing: Persuasive Argumentative Essays on Climate Action
topics.description: Clear thesis statement, body paragraphs with topic sentences and evidence, refutation of counterarguments, and strong conclusion.

topics.topic_name: Listening: Civic Responsibility and National Unity in Ethiopia
topics.description: Comprehending historical speeches, distinguishing patriotism from chauvinism, and thematic analysis.

topics.topic_name: Speaking: Presenting on Heroes and Contributions of Ethiopian Citizens
topics.description: Narrative presentation skills, expressive intonation, and moderating classroom panel discussions.

topics.topic_name: Reading: Civic Virtues, Rule of Law, and Community Development
topics.description: Textual interpretation of civic texts, ethical reasoning, and evaluating moral choices presented in stories.

topics.topic_name: Vocabulary: Civic Institutions, Constitutional Rights & Patriotism
topics.description: Constitutional terminology, civic duty phrases, abstract ethical nouns, and antonym pairs.
Who, whom, whose, which, that; essential vs non-essential information, comma conventions, and pronoun omission.

topics.topic_name: Writing: Reflective Essays on Personal Contribution to Society
topics.description: First-person reflective style, balancing personal anecdotes with broader civic analysis, and polished rhetoric.

topics.topic_name: Listening: Healthcare Delivery and Primary Care Systems
topics.description: Clinical audio dialogues, recognizing patient-physician interactions, and identifying diagnostic steps.

topics.topic_name: Speaking: Formulating Inquiries and Interviewing Medical Personnel
topics.description: Polite questioning techniques (Could you clarify...), indirect questions, and respectful professional registers.

topics.topic_name: Reading: Health Extension Programs and Rural Clinics in Ethiopia
topics.description: Understanding administrative public health literature, analyzing healthcare equity, and statistical infographics.

topics.topic_name: Vocabulary: Medical Terminology, Epidemiology & Public Health
topics.description: Symptom descriptions, therapeutic treatments, pharmacological terms, and healthcare policy vocabulary.

topics.topic_name: Grammar: Reported Speech in Medical Diagnostics and Interviews
topics.description: Backshifting tenses, changes in pronouns/time markers, reporting verbs (advised, warned, inquired, insisted).

topics.topic_name: Writing: Formal Healthcare Appraisal and Evaluation Reports
topics.description: Administrative report structure, executive summary, methodology, findings, and formal policy recommendations.
Oral history traditions, identifying cultural mediation steps, and listening for consensus-building nuances.
Mediation discourse, consensus building, non-adversarial framing, and customary respectful addresses.

topics.topic_name: Reading: Comparative Analysis of Customary and Formal Courts
topics.description: Restorative vs retributive justice paradigms, identifying sociological arguments, and critical synthesis.

topics.topic_name: Vocabulary: Customary Law, Restorative Justice & Mediation
topics.description: Jurisprudential concepts, arbitration vocabularies, idiomatic peace-making metaphors, and legal registers.

topics.topic_name: Grammar: Subjunctive Mood, Wish, and Hypothetical Inversions
topics.description: It is essential that he be present; Had the elders not intervened...; expressing solemn formal recommendations.

topics.topic_name: Writing: Comparative Synthesis Papers on Justice Paradigms
topics.description: Point-by-point vs block comparison formats, comparative transitions, and objective academic conclusions.

topics.topic_name: Listening: Machine Learning, Automation and Societal Futures
topics.description: Tech podcasts, distinguishing algorithmic hype from reality, and noting predictions on employment.

topics.topic_name: Speaking: Debating the Ethics and Boundaries of AI Systems
topics.description: Parliamentary debate conventions, rebuttal techniques, cross-examination, and framing ethical dilemmas.

topics.topic_name: Reading: Natural Language Processing and Computer Vision Applications
topics.description: Comprehending computer science literature, identifying technical metaphors, and assessing AI in Ethiopia.

topics.topic_name: Vocabulary: Computer Science, Algorithms & Data Ethics
topics.description: Neural networks, training models, algorithmic bias, generative AI, and cybersecurity lexicon.

topics.topic_name: Grammar: Advanced Cohesive Devices and Discourse Markers
topics.description: Furthermore, notwithstanding, in light of, conversely; complex sentence punctuation and academic cohesion.

topics.topic_name: Writing: Forward-Looking Analytical Essays on Technological Impact

topics.topic_name: DNA Molecular Structure and Semiconservative Replication
topics.description: Watson-Crick double helix model, antiparallel strands (5' to 3' and 3' to 5'), nucleotide units (deoxyribose, phosphate, purine/pyrimidine bases), Chargaff's rules (%A=%T, %G=%C); Semiconservative replication: Helicase, DNA polymerase, RNA primase, Okazaki fragments, and DNA ligase.

Central dogma of molecular biology; RNA structure vs DNA; Transcription by RNA Polymerase binding promoter region; Template strand reading 3' to 5', mRNA synthesis 5' to 3'; Eukaryotic RNA processing: 5' capping, 3' poly-A tailing, splicing out non-coding introns by spliceosomes.

topics.topic_name: The Genetic Code, Translation and Protein Synthesis
topics.description: Features of the genetic code (triplet, universal, degenerate/redundant, non-overlapping, start codon AUG, stop codons UAA, UAG, UGA); tRNA structure and anticodon loop; Ribosome structure (A, P, E sites); Translation stages: Initiation, Elongation (peptide bond formation), Termination.

topics.topic_name: Recombinant DNA Technology, PCR and Biotechnology Applications
topics.description: Restriction endonucleases ("molecular scissors" cutting palindromic recognition sequences), DNA ligase, plasmid vectors, bacterial transformation; Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR: Denaturation, Annealing, Extension); Gel electrophoresis; Applications in Ethiopian agriculture (tissue culture of teff, coffee) and medicine (recombinant insulin).

topics.topic_name: Mendelian Genetics: Monohybrid and Dihybrid Crosses
topics.description: Mendel's experiments on Pisum sativum; Law of Segregation (alleles separate during meiosis, monohybrid 3:1 phenotypic and 1:2:1 genotypic ratios); Law of Independent Assortment (unlinked genes assort independently, dihybrid 9:3:3:1 ratio); Test cross with homozygous recessive.

Incomplete dominance (intermediate heterozygote phenotype 1:2:1 ratio, e.g. Snapdragon flowers); Codominance (both alleles expressed simultaneously, e.g. sickle cell trait HbA/HbS, MN blood group); Multiple alleles (ABO blood group system with IA, IB, i); Polygenic quantitative traits (skin color, human height).

topics.topic_name: Sex Determination, Sex-Linkage and Pedigree Analysis
topics.description: Chromosomal sex determination (XX/XY in humans, ZW/ZZ in birds); Sex-linked inheritance of X-linked recessive traits (Hemophilia A, Red-green color blindness); Hemizygous males (XY) expressing recessive alleles; Interpreting human pedigree charts (autosomal dominant/recessive vs X-linked).

Gene/point mutations (silent, missense, nonsense, frameshift insertions/deletions); Mutagenic agents (UV, ionizing radiation, chemicals); Chromosomal structural alterations (deletion, duplication, inversion, translocation); Numerical aneuploidy due to nondisjunction during meiosis (Down syndrome Trisomy 21, Turner syndrome XO, Klinefelter syndrome XXY).

Paleontological fossil record and transitional fossils (e.g. Archaeopteryx, Lucy/Australopithecus afarensis discovered in the Afar Depression of Ethiopia); Comparative anatomy: Homologous structures (divergent evolution) vs Analogous structures (convergent evolution), vestigial structures; Biochemical and DNA sequence homology.

topics.topic_name: Theories of Evolution: Lamarckism vs. Darwinian Natural Selection
topics.description: Lamarck's theory of inheritance of acquired characteristics and disuse; Charles Darwin and Alfred Russel Wallace: Overproduction, struggle for existence, variation within populations, differential survival and reproduction ("survival of the fittest"); Modern evolutionary synthesis combining Mendelian genetics with natural selection.

topics.topic_name: Population Genetics and the Hardy-Weinberg Principle
topics.description: Gene pool, allele frequency (p + q = 1) and genotype frequency (p^2 + 2pq + q^2 = 1); Five conditions for Hardy-Weinberg genetic equilibrium (large population, random mating, no mutation, no gene flow/migration, no natural selection); Evolutionary forces disrupting equilibrium: Genetic drift (bottleneck and founder effects), gene flow, natural selection.

topics.topic_name: Speciation Mechanisms and Ethiopian Endemic Biodiversity
topics.description: Biological species concept; Reproductive isolating mechanisms: Prezygotic (temporal, behavioral, ecological, mechanical, gametic isolation) and Postzygotic (hybrid inviability, hybrid sterility); Allopatric speciation via geographical barriers vs Sympatric speciation (polyploidy); Adaptive radiation of Ethiopian highlands endemic wildlife (Walia Ibex, Ethiopian Wolf, Gelada Baboon).

topics.topic_name: Neural Coordination: Action Potentials and Synaptic Transmission
topics.description: Structure of sensory, relay, and motor neurons; Resting membrane potential (-70 mV maintained by Na+/K+ ATPase pump: 3 Na+ out, 2 K+ in); Action potential phases: Depolarization (voltage-gated Na+ channels open, potential reaches +30 mV), Repolarization (K+ channels open), Hyperpolarization, Refractory periods; Saltatory conduction in myelinated axons; Synaptic transmission via neurotransmitter acetylcholine release.

topics.topic_name: Endocrine Coordination and Homeostatic Feedback Loops
topics.description: Ductless endocrine glands and hormone signaling; Hypothalamus-pituitary axis; Blood glucose regulation by pancreatic islets: Beta cells secrete insulin (promotes glycogenesis and glucose uptake), Alpha cells secrete glucagon (stimulates glycogenolysis and gluconeogenesis); Thyroid hormones T3/T4 and metabolic rate; Adrenal stress hormones (adrenaline and cortisol); Negative feedback control.

topics.topic_name: The Human Immune System and Defence Mechanisms
topics.description: Innate (non-specific) immunity: Physical/chemical barriers (skin, lysozyme, stomach acid), phagocytes (macrophages, neutrophils), inflammatory response, fever; Adaptive (specific) immunity: Humoral response mediated by B-lymphocytes and antibodies (IgG, IgM, IgA, IgE), Cell-mediated response mediated by cytotoxic T-cells (CD8+) and helper T-cells (CD4+); Active vs passive immunity, vaccination mechanisms.

topics.topic_name: Major Pathogenic Diseases and Public Health in Ethiopia
topics.description: Malaria: Plasmodium falciparum lifecycle between female Anopheles mosquito vector and human host (liver and red blood cell phases), symptoms, Artemisinin-based combination therapy (ACT); Tuberculosis: Mycobacterium tuberculosis pathogenesis, BCG vaccination, DOTS treatment program; HIV/AIDS: Retrovirus replication cycle, reverse transcriptase, destruction of CD4+ T-helper cells, Antiretroviral therapy (ART); Schistosomiasis lifecycle with freshwater snail intermediate host.

topics.topic_name: Ecosystem Dynamics, Trophic Levels and Energy Flow
topics.description: Ecosystem components (biotic communities and abiotic factors); Trophic levels: Primary producers (autotrophs), primary consumers (herbivores), secondary/tertiary consumers (carnivores), decomposers; Unidirectional energy flow; Lindeman's 10% ecological efficiency rule (90% lost as metabolic heat and respiration); Ecological pyramids of numbers, biomass, and energy.

Carbon cycle: Photosynthesis, cellular respiration, combustion, and greenhouse effect global warming; Nitrogen cycle: Nitrogen fixation by Rhizobium in legume root nodules and free-living Azotobacter, nitrification by Nitrosomonas and Nitrobacter, assimilation, ammonification, and denitrification by Pseudomonas; Phosphorus cycle; Eutrophication of water bodies caused by synthetic fertilizer runoff.

topics.topic_name: Environmental Degradation and Climate Resilience in Ethiopia
topics.description: Deforestation causes (firewood, agricultural expansion) and consequences in Ethiopian highlands; Soil erosion mechanisms, terracing, and contour ploughing; Land degradation and desertification; Impact of erratic rainfall and recurring droughts on pastoralist communities; Ethiopia's Green Legacy Initiative and national reforestation campaigns.

topics.topic_name: Biodiversity Conservation and Protected Area Management
topics.description: In-situ conservation: National Parks of Ethiopia (Simien Mountains, Bale Mountains, Awash, Nechisar, Gambella), wildlife sanctuaries (Babille Elephant Sanctuary), biosphere reserves (Kafa coffee forest); Ex-situ conservation: Ethiopian Biodiversity Institute (EBI) genebanks, botanical gardens, and captive breeding programs; Economic and ecological value of preserving endemic genetic resources.

Arrhenius, Brønsted-Lowry, and Lewis theories of acids and bases; conjugate acid-base pairs, amphiprotic species.

topics.topic_name: Ionic Equilibria of Weak Acids and Bases
topics.description: Water autoionization, Kw, pH, pOH, Ka and Kb dissociation constants, percent ionization.

topics.topic_name: Common Ion Effect and Buffer Solutions
topics.description: Common ion effect, buffer action, Henderson-Hasselbalch equation, buffer capacity.
Hydrolysis of salts of strong/weak acid-base combinations and pH predictions.
Acid-base indicators, equivalents & normality (N1V1 = N2V2), titration curves, and equivalence point.
Oxidation and reduction definitions, oxidation numbers, balancing redox reactions using oxidation-number and half-reaction methods.
Metallic vs electrolytic conduction, electrolytic cells, factors affecting preferential discharge, molten NaCl, brine, dilute H2SO4, CuSO4.
Faraday's First and Second Laws of Electrolysis, electrochemical equivalent, charge and mass calculations.
Extraction of aluminum (Hall-Héroult), electrorefining of copper, electroplating, chlor-alkali production of Cl2 and NaOH.
Daniell cell, salt bridge, standard hydrogen electrode (SHE), standard reduction potentials, Nernst equation, commercial batteries, fuel cells, and corrosion.
Scope, characteristics of chemical industries, role in society and economic growth.
Atmospheric, hydrospheric, lithospheric, biospheric raw materials; renewable and non-renewable resources in Ethiopia.
Haber ammonia, Ostwald nitric acid, Contact sulfuric acid, Solvay sodium carbonate, Castner-Kellner NaOH, Urea and DAP fertilizers, pesticides.
Glass, ceramics, cement, sugar refining, pulp and paper, tannery, food preservation, ethanol, soaps and detergents.
Monomers, polymers, degree of polymerization (DP), homopolymers and copolymers.
Addition (chain-growth) vs condensation (step-growth) polymerization; free-radical mechanisms; Nylon 6,6 and Dacron.
Natural biopolymers (carbohydrates, proteins, nucleic acids, rubber) vs synthetic polymers (PE, PP, PVC, PMMA, Teflon); thermoplastics vs thermosets.

topics.topic_name: Introduction and Components of the Environment
topics.description: Atmosphere, hydrosphere, lithosphere, biosphere; hydrological, carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, phosphorus, sulfur cycles; BOD, DO, TLV.
Air pollution, photochemical smog, acid rain, CFCs ozone depletion; water pollution and eutrophication; land pollution.
Greenhouse gases (CO2, CH4, N2O), infrared absorption mechanism, and global climate impacts.
12 principles of green chemistry, atom economy calculation, cleaner production goals in chemical industries.

topics.topic_name: Academic Reading: Text Analysis, Tone and Main Ideas
topics.description: Skimming scholarly articles for main idea, scanning for supporting empirical data, evaluating author purpose and objective vs subjective tone, making logical inferences from academic prose, and distinguishing asserted facts from hypotheses.

topics.topic_name: Scholarly Vocabulary: Affixation and Academic Word List
topics.description: Morphological word analysis: Latin and Greek prefixes (anti-, bio-, inter-, poly-, trans-) and suffixes (-tion, -ize, -ous, -able); Contextual collocations in university research papers; Connotative nuances of scholarly synonyms.

topics.topic_name: Advanced Relative Clauses and Sentence Synthesis
topics.description: Defining vs non-defining relative clauses (comma rules, which vs that, who vs whom, whose); Reduced relative clauses (participle clauses using present -ing and past -ed participles); Combining simple sentences into cohesive compound-complex academic sentences.

topics.topic_name: Speaking and Discussion: Academic Seminars and Debates
topics.description: Active listening during scholarly presentations, formulating constructive questions, discourse markers for polite disagreement ("While I acknowledge your point, evidence suggests..."), and summarizing group conclusions.

topics.topic_name: Mastery of Conditional Sentences and Counterfactuals
topics.description: Zero, First, Second, and Third Conditionals review; Mixed conditionals (unreal past action with present consequence: If + past perfect, would + base verb); Formal inversion without 'if' ("Had I known the schedule...", "Were the committee to approve...", "Should you require assistance...").

Passive with reporting verbs for academic objectivity ("It is widely believed that...", "The findings are said to indicate..."); Passive infinitive and gerund forms; Causative passive structures (have/get something done); Avoiding agent identification when agent is unknown or irrelevant.

Tense backshift rules in reported speech (simple present to simple past, present perfect to past perfect); Exceptions when reporting universal scientific truths; Reporting verbs with specific patterns (insist on, apologize for, deny + gerund, advise someone to do); Shifting time and place adverbs.

topics.topic_name: Modals of Deduction, Speculation and Past Regret
topics.description: Present deduction (must be, can't be, might be); Past deduction and speculation (must have been, can't have done, might have seen); Expressing past obligation and regret (should have studied, ought to have submitted); Common multiple-choice distractors in national EUEE entrance exams.

topics.topic_name: Expository Writing: Process Descriptions and Technical Reports
topics.description: Structuring laboratory reports: Introduction, Materials & Methods (passive voice sequential instructions), Results, and Discussion; Sequential connectors (initially, subsequently, simultaneously, following this, ultimately); Precision and concise scientific prose.

Expressing causal relationships using diverse grammatical structures: Prepositions (due to, owing to, as a consequence of), Conjunctions (since, because, as), Transitional adverbs (consequently, therefore, thus, as a result); Structuring multi-paragraph cause-and-effect analytical essays.

topics.topic_name: Technical Vocabulary and Precise Scientific Phrasing
topics.description: Domain-specific vocabulary in STEM and social sciences; Avoiding vague colloquial language (e.g. replacing "make it bigger" with "amplify/expand", "get rid of" with "eliminate"); Technical collocations and standardized SI measurement phrasing.

topics.topic_name: Interpreting Graphical Data and Technical Visuals

topics.description: Compound interest formulas A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt), simple annuities, depreciation models, biological cell division sequences, and national economic growth projections.

topics.description: Definition of limits, one-sided limits (left-hand and right-hand), limit laws (sum, product, quotient, power), and evaluating limits by factoring, expansion, and conjugate rationalization.

topics.topic_name: Limits Involving Infinity and Indeterminate Forms
topics.description: Infinite limits, limits at infinity, resolving 0/0 and inf/inf forms, identifying horizontal and vertical asymptotes of rational functions, and Squeeze (Sandwich) Theorem.
Three conditions for continuity at a point (f(c) defined, lim f(x) exists, lim f(x) = f(c)), continuity on intervals, removable vs essential discontinuities, and Intermediate Value Theorem (IVT).
Fundamental limit lim(x->0) [sin(x)/x] = 1, lim(x->0) [(1 - cos(x))/x] = 0, and evaluating trigonometric indeterminate limits in EUEE.

topics.topic_name: The Derivative as an Instantaneous Rate of Change
topics.description: Difference quotient, limit definition f'(x) = lim(h->0) [f(x+h) - f(x)]/h, geometric slope of tangent line, instantaneous velocity and acceleration.
Constant rule, Power rule d/dx(x^n) = n·x^(n-1), Constant multiple rule, Sum and difference rules, Product rule (uv)' = u'v + uv', Quotient rule (u/v)' = (u'v - uv')/v^2.

topics.topic_name: The Chain Rule and Implicit Differentiation
topics.description: Derivatives of composite functions dy/dx = (dy/du)·(du/dx), extended power rule, implicit differentiation for curves F(x, y) = 0, higher order derivatives f''(x) and f^(n)(x).

topics.topic_name: Derivatives of Trigonometric, Exponential and Logarithmic Functions
topics.description: Derivatives of sin x, cos x, tan x, sec x, e^x, a^x, ln x, log_a x, and logarithmic differentiation for complex products.

topics.topic_name: Critical Points, Monotonicity and Extreme Values
topics.description: Critical numbers (where f'(c) = 0 or undefined), Fermat's Theorem, Extreme Value Theorem on closed intervals [a, b], First Derivative Test for local maxima and minima.

topics.topic_name: Concavity, Points of Inflection and Curve Sketching
topics.description: Second derivative test for local extrema, concavity test (f''(x) > 0 concave up, f''(x) < 0 concave down), points of inflection, combining asymptotes and intercepts for complete curve sketching.
Translating word problems into objective functions, constraints, domain restrictions, maximizing profit/area/volume, minimizing cost/material in construction and commerce.
Differentiating with respect to time t using chain rule, geometric modeling (expanding spherical balloons, draining conical tanks, sliding ladders, shadow movement).

Definition of antiderivative, indefinite integral symbol ∫ f(x) dx = F(x) + C, power rule for integration ∫ x^n dx = (x^(n+1))/(n+1) + C (n ≠ -1), integrals of trigonometric and exponential functions.
Reversing the chain rule: ∫ f(g(x))g'(x) dx = ∫ f(u) du, choosing appropriate substitution variable u, transforming differentials and limits of integration.
Riemann sums and area under curve, Part 1: d/dx ∫_a^x f(t) dt = f(x), Part 2: ∫_a^b f(x) dx = F(b) - F(a), properties of definite integrals (linearity, additivity of intervals).
Calculating exact planar area between curves f(x) and g(x), net displacement vs total distance traveled given velocity v(t), average value of a continuous function.

topics.topic_name: Vectors and Coordinate System in Three-Dimensional Space
topics.description: Right-handed 3D Cartesian coordinates (x, y, z), distance formula in 3D d = √((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2 + (z2-z1)^2), midpoint formula, standard unit vectors i, j, k.

topics.topic_name: Scalar (Dot) Product and Vector Projections in 3D
topics.description: Dot product u·v = u1v1 + u2v2 + u3v3 = |u||v|cos θ, orthogonality criterion (u·v = 0), direction cosines, scalar and vector projections proj_v u.

topics.topic_name: Cross Product of Vectors in 3D Space
topics.description: Vector product u × v, determinant calculation, magnitude |u × v| = |u||v|sin θ (area of parallelogram), right-hand rule for direction, collinearity condition u × v = 0.

topics.topic_name: Equations of Lines and Planes in 3D Space
topics.description: Vector and parametric equations of lines in space r(t) = r_0 + t·v, symmetric equations, standard equation of a plane A(x - x0) + B(y - y0) + C(z - z0) = 0 using normal vector n.

topics.topic_name: Continental Drift (Wegener) and Plate Tectonics Theory
topics.description: Pangaea evidence (jigsaw fit, Mesosaurus fossils, paleoclimatic tillites, sea-floor spreading) and divergent/convergent/transform boundaries.

topics.topic_name: Endogenic Forces: Folding, Faulting, Rift Valley Formation, Volcanism & Earthquakes
topics.description: Anticlines/synclines, normal/reverse/strike-slip faults, Horst and Graben (East African Rift), seismic P/S/Surface waves, Richter & Mercalli scales.

topics.topic_name: Exogenic Processes: Weathering, Mass Wasting, Fluvial, Aeolian & Coastal Landforms
topics.description: Physical (exfoliation, frost action) and chemical weathering (hydrolysis, carbonation), meanders, oxbow lakes, deltas, barchans, and wave cliffs.

topics.topic_name: Global Atmospheric Circulation (Hadley, Ferrel, Polar Cells), Jet Streams & ENSO
topics.description: ITCZ seasonal migration, Coriolis deflection, Trade Winds, Westerlies, El Niño / La Niña teleconnections with Ethiopian Kiremt/Belg rains.

topics.topic_name: Natural (Milankovitch Cycles, Solar, Volcanic) vs. Anthropogenic Climate Drivers
topics.description: Orbital eccentricity, axial tilt (obliquity), precession, radiative forcing of CO2/CH4/N2O, and positive albedo feedbacks.

topics.topic_name: International Climate Governance (Kyoto, Paris Agreement) and Ethiopia’s CRGE Strategy
topics.description: IPCC assessments, Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs), carbon markets, and Ethiopia’s Climate-Resilient Green Economy pillars.

topics.topic_name: Population Theories: Malthusian, Neo-Malthusian, Boserupian, and Marxist Perspectives
topics.description: Geometric population growth vs arithmetic food growth, preventive/positive checks, Ester Boserup’s agricultural intensification, and demographic dividend.

topics.topic_name: Carrying Capacity, Ecological Footprint, Water-Energy-Food Nexus & Population Policy
topics.description: Demographic measures (TFR, CBR, CDR, Doubling Time = 70/r), anti-natalist vs pro-natalist policies, and Ethiopia’s National Population Policy.

topics.topic_name: Dimensions of Sustainable Development (UN SDGs) and Green Growth Indicators
topics.description: Balancing economic growth, social equity, and environmental stewardship; circular economy and renewable resource thresholds.

topics.topic_name: Theories of Economic Development (Rostow’s 5 Stages, Dependency, World-Systems)
topics.description: Rostow’s linear modernization stages, core-semiperiphery-periphery unequal exchange (Wallerstein), and structural transformation.

topics.topic_name: Globalization, Multinational Corporations, Bretton Woods (IMF/World Bank/WTO) & AfCFTA
topics.description: Global supply chains, Foreign Direct Investment, African Continental Free Trade Area, and regional economic blocs (IGAD, COMESA, EAC).

topics.topic_name: Hydropolitics of the Nile Basin, Red Sea Geopolitics, and Strategic Corridors
topics.description: Abay (Blue Nile) 86% water contribution, Cooperative Framework Agreement (CFA), GERD energy diplomacy, and Horn of Africa port logistics.

topics.topic_name: Biodiversity Loss, Desertification, Transboundary Pollution, and Environmental Ethics
topics.description: Anthropocentrism vs ecocentrism, Sahel/Horn desertification drivers, wetland degradation, and invasive species (Prosopis juliflora, water hyacinth).

topics.topic_name: Indigenous Environmental Knowledge Systems in Ethiopia (Konso, Gedeo, Borana)
topics.description: UNESCO-registered Konso stone terraces, Gedeo multi-story agroforestry, and Borana Gadaa traditional deep-well (Tula) water governance.

topics.topic_name: Hazard Mapping, Vulnerability Assessment, and Disaster Risk Reduction (Sendai Framework)
topics.description: Risk equation Risk = (Hazard × Vulnerability) / Capacity; drought/flood early warning systems and community resilience.

topics.topic_name: Geographic Research Design: Hypothesis Testing, Sampling Methods & Fieldwork
topics.description: Probability sampling (simple random, stratified, systematic, cluster) vs non-probability sampling, correlation r, and research ethics.

topics.topic_name: Quantitative Cartography: Gradient, Vertical Exaggeration, Intervisibility & Thematic Maps
topics.description: Gradient = VI / HE, Vertical Exaggeration = Vertical Scale / Horizontal Scale, choropleth, isopleth, dot-density, and flow-line maps.

topics.topic_name: Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Spatial Analysis and Remote Sensing
topics.description: Vector (point, line, polygon) vs Raster grid models, spatial buffering, overlay analysis, and NDVI vegetation monitoring.

topics.topic_name: Congress of Vienna (1815), Industrial Capitalism, Socialism, and Labor Movements
topics.description: Metternich’s Concert of Europe, legitimacy and balance of power, Chartism, Utopian vs Scientific Socialism (Marxism), and the Paris Commune.

topics.topic_name: Unification of Italy (Cavour, Garibaldi) and Germany (Bismarck’s Realpolitik)
topics.description: Mazzini’s Young Italy, Piedmont-Sardinia diplomacy, Garibaldi’s Red Shirts, Zollverein, and Bismarck’s three wars (Denmark, Austria 1866, France 1870–71).

topics.topic_name: The American Civil War (1861–65), Meiji Restoration in Japan, and the Eastern Question
topics.description: Abraham Lincoln, Emancipation Proclamation (1863), abolition of slavery (13th Amendment), Japanese industrial modernization, and Ottoman Balkan crises.

topics.topic_name: The Scramble for Africa, Berlin Conference (1884–85), and Effective Occupation
topics.description: King Leopold II in Congo, Fashoda Incident (1898), Articles 34 & 35 of the Berlin Act, and geometric boundary demarcation.

topics.topic_name: African Anti-Colonial Resistance: Samori Ture, Ashanti, Maji-Maji, Mahdist & Urabi
topics.description: Mandinka Empire scorched-earth tactics, Yaa Asantewaa, Kinjikitile Ngwale’s Maji-Maji uprising (1905–07), and Herero-Nama resistance.

topics.topic_name: Colonial Administrative Systems (Indirect Rule, Assimilation, Settler Rule) & Economy
topics.description: Lugard’s Dual Mandate in Nigeria, French Federation of West Africa (evolués vs indigénat), cash-crop monoculture, and forced labor.

topics.topic_name: Modern State Formation under Emperors Tewodros II, Yohannes IV, and Menelik II
topics.description: Ending Zemene Mesafint, Gafat artillery, Boru Meda Council (1878), Menelik’s territorial incorporation (Chelenqo 1887, Embabo 1882), and Addis Ababa.

topics.topic_name: Defending Sovereignty: Gundet, Gura, Dogali, Metemma, and the Victory of Adwa (1896)
topics.description: Defeating Khedive Ismail’s Egyptian expeditions (1875–76), Ras Alula at Dogali (1887), Treaty of Wuchale Article XVII, and March 1, 1896 Adwa triumph.

topics.topic_name: Diarchy (1916–30), 1931 Constitution, Fascist Invasion (1935–41) & Patriotic Resistance
topics.description: Lij Iyasu, Empress Zewditu & Ras Teferi, League of Nations entry (1923), Black Lion Organization, Yekatit 12 martyrs, and May 5, 1941 Liberation.

topics.topic_name: World War I (1914–18), the 1917 Russian Revolution, and the Treaty of Versailles
topics.description: Triple Entente vs Central Powers, Schlieffen Plan, Bolshevik October Revolution, Wilson’s 14 Points, and League of Nations weaknesses.

topics.topic_name: The Great Depression (1929), Rise of Fascism/Nazism, World War II, and the UN
topics.description: Mussolini and Hitler’s aggression, Appeasement at Munich (1938), Operation Barbarossa, Pearl Harbor, Stalingrad, Hiroshima, and 1945 UN Charter.

topics.topic_name: The Cold War: Truman Doctrine, Marshall Plan, NATO/Warsaw Pact, China, Korea, Vietnam & détente
topics.description: Containment policy, Mao Zedong (1949), Ethiopian Kagnew Battalion in Korea, Cuban Missile Crisis (1962), Non-Aligned Movement, and Gorbachev’s reforms.

topics.topic_name: Post-Liberation Restoration, Anglo-Ethiopian Treaties (1942/44), Eritrea Federation & 1955 Constitution
topics.description: Point Four Agreement with USA, UN Resolution 390-A(V) federating Eritrea (1952), Revised 1955 Constitution, and autocratic centralization.

topics.topic_name: The 1960 Abortive Coup, Peasant Rebellions (Woyane, Bale, Gojjam) & Student Movement
topics.description: Mengistu and Germame Neway (Dec 1960), First Woyane (1943), Waqo Gutu in Bale (1963–70), Gojjam tax revolt (1968), and "Land to the Tiller" slogan.

topics.topic_name: The 1974 Popular Revolution, Derg Rule, 1975 Land Reform, Red Terror, 1977 War & 1991 Change
topics.description: Creeping coup of the Derg, March 1975 rural land nationalization, Qey Shibir, Karamara victory (1978), PDRE (1987), and May 1991 fall of the Derg.

topics.topic_name: Pan-Africanism (Du Bois, Garvey, Nkrumah), Manchester Congress (1945) & Decolonization
topics.description: Ghana independence (1957), Year of Africa (1960), Algerian FLN war of liberation (1954–62), Mau Mau in Kenya, and Lusophone armed struggles.

topics.topic_name: Casablanca vs. Monrovia Groups, Foundation of the OAU in Addis Ababa (1963) & End of Apartheid
topics.description: Emperor Haile Selassie’s mediation in May 1963, OAU Coordinating Committee for Liberation, Nelson Mandela & ANC, and 2002 transition to the African Union.

topics.topic_name: Post-Colonial Political Economy, Structural Adjustment, Regional Integration & Heritage
topics.description: Overcoming mono-crop dependency, military coups, Cold War proxy conflicts, Agenda 2063, and safeguarding Ethiopia’s tangible and intangible UNESCO heritage.

Curriculum Unit 1: The Number System & Sets

topics.title: Notion of Sets & Set Representations
topics.description: Roster method, set-builder notation, empty set, universal set, equal & equivalent sets, subsets and power sets.

topics.title: Set Operations & De Morgan's Laws
topics.description: Union A ∪ B, intersection A ∩ B, relative complement A \ B, symmetric difference A Δ B, and De Morgan's laws.

topics.title: Venn Diagrams and Practical Word Problems
topics.description: Representing set relations visually, inclusion-exclusion formula n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A ∩ B).

topics.title: The Real Number System, Exponents & Radicals
topics.description: Natural numbers, integers, rational and irrational numbers, laws of exponents, simplifying radicals, and rationalizing denominators.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Solving Equations and Inequalities

topics.title: Linear Equations in One Variable & Absolute Value Equations
topics.description: Solving ax + b = c, equations involving absolute values |ax + b| = c, and practical word problems.

topics.title: Systems of Linear Equations in Two Variables
topics.description: Solving 2×2 linear systems by substitution, elimination, and graphical intersection; consistent vs inconsistent systems.

topics.title: Linear Inequalities in One Variable
topics.description: Interval notation, properties of inequalities, and solving absolute value inequalities |ax + b| < c and |ax + b| > c.

topics.title: Quadratic Equations & the Quadratic Formula
topics.description: Solving ax² + bx + c = 0 by factoring, completing the square, quadratic formula, discriminant Δ = b² - 4ac, and Vieta's relations.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Relations and Functions

topics.title: Cartesian Coordinate Plane & Relations
topics.description: Ordered pairs (x, y), Cartesian product A × B, domain and range of a relation, and graphs of relations.

topics.title: Concept of a Function & Vertical Line Test
topics.description: Functions as unique mappings, vertical line test, function notation f(x), and algebra of functions (f ± g, f·g, f/g).

topics.title: Linear Functions and Their Graphs
topics.description: Linear function f(x) = mx + b, slope m = Δy/Δx, x- and y-intercepts, and rate of change applications.

topics.title: Quadratic Functions and Parabolic Graphs
topics.description: f(x) = ax² + bx + c, vertex form a(x - h)² + k, axis of symmetry x = -b/(2a), minimum/maximum values.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Geometry and Measurement

topics.title: Angles, Parallel Lines & Transversals
topics.description: Alternate interior, corresponding, and consecutive interior angles; interior and exterior angle theorems of polygons.

topics.title: Triangles: Congruence and Similarity
topics.description: SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS, RHS congruence postulates; AA, SAS, SSS similarity theorems and ratio of areas (k²).

topics.title: Pythagorean Theorem, Euclid's Theorem & Right Triangle Trigonometry
topics.description: a² + b² = c², altitude-on-hypotenuse theorems, and trigonometric ratios sin θ, cos θ, tan θ for 30°, 45°, 60°.

topics.title: Quadrilaterals and Regular Polygons
topics.description: Parallelogram, rectangle, rhombus, square, and trapezium properties; central, interior, and exterior angles of regular n-gons.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Circles

topics.title: Parts and Symmetrical Properties of Circles
topics.description: Radius, diameter, chord, secant, tangent, arc, sector, segment; perpendicular from center bisects a chord.

topics.title: Central Angles, Inscribed Angles and Cyclic Quadrilaterals
topics.description: Inscribed angle is half the central angle subtending the same arc; opposite angles of cyclic quadrilateral sum to 180°.

topics.title: Arc Length, Sector Area and Segment Area
topics.description: Circumference C = 2πr, arc length l = (θ/360°)·2πr, sector area A = (θ/360°)·πr², and segment area.

topics.title: Tangents and Intersecting Chords
topics.description: Tangent perpendicularity to radius, equal two-tangent theorem, and intersecting chords power theorem.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Solid Figures

topics.title: Prisms and Cylinders: Surface Area & Volume
topics.description: Lateral surface area, total surface area, and volume V = B·h of right prisms and circular cylinders (V = πr²h).

topics.title: Pyramids and Cones: Surface Area & Volume
topics.description: Slant height l vs altitude h, lateral area, total surface area, and volume V = (1/3)B·h and V = (1/3)πr²h.

topics.title: Spheres and Hemispheres
topics.description: Surface area of sphere A = 4πr², curved and total surface area of hemisphere (3πr²), and volume V = (4/3)πr³.

topics.title: Composite Solids and Real-World Engineering Problems
topics.description: Surface area and volume of combined solids such as silos, capsules, and architectural domes.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 7: Coordinate Geometry

topics.title: Distance Between Two Points in the Cartesian Plane
topics.description: Derivation and application of d = √[(x₂ - x₁)² + (y₂ - y₁)²] to classify triangles and quadrilaterals.

topics.title: Midpoint and Section Formula of a Line Segment
topics.description: Midpoint M = ((x₁ + x₂)/2, (y₁ + y₂)/2) and internal division of a segment in ratio m:n.

topics.title: Slope (Gradient) of a Straight Line
topics.description: Slope m = (y₂ - y₁)/(x₂ - x₁), collinearity of points, and slopes of parallel and perpendicular lines.

topics.title: Equations of Straight Lines
topics.description: Slope-intercept form y = mx + b, point-slope form y - y₁ = m(x - x₁), two-point form, and general form Ax + By + C = 0.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 8: Statistics and Probability

topics.title: Data Collection, Organization and Frequency Distributions
topics.description: Population vs sample, qualitative vs quantitative data, ungrouped and grouped frequency distribution tables.

topics.title: Statistical Graphs: Histograms, Frequency Polygons & Pie Charts
topics.description: Constructing and interpreting bar charts, histograms, frequency polygons, ogives, and pie charts.

topics.title: Measures of Central Tendency and Dispersion
topics.description: Mean (x̄), median, mode, range, quartiles, variance, and standard deviation for ungrouped and grouped data.

topics.title: Experimental and Theoretical Probability
topics.description: Random experiments, sample space S, events, P(E) = n(E)/n(S), mutually exclusive and independent events.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 9: Regular Polygons and Congruency

topics.title: Properties and Angles of Regular Polygons
topics.description: Interior angle ((n-2)·180°/n), exterior angle (360°/n), central angle, and lines of symmetry.

topics.title: Radius, Apothem, Perimeter and Area of Regular Polygons
topics.description: Relationships a = r cos(180°/n), s = 2r sin(180°/n), P = ns, and Area A = ½·P·a.

topics.title: Inscribed and Circumscribed Regular Polygons
topics.description: Exact formulas for equilateral triangles, squares, and regular hexagons inscribed in a circle of radius r.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 10: Vectors in Two Dimensions

topics.title: Introduction to Scalars and Vectors
topics.description: Directed line segments, magnitude, direction, equal vectors, opposite vectors, and zero vector.

topics.title: Graphical and Component Operations on Vectors
topics.description: Triangle law, parallelogram law, position vectors, component form u = (x, y), and scalar multiplication.

topics.title: Magnitude, Direction Angle and Unit Vectors
topics.description: Norm ||u|| = √(x² + y²), standard unit vectors i = (1,0) and j = (0,1), and navigation/force word problems.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Physics and Human Society

topics.title: Definition and Nature of Physics
topics.description: Meaning of physics as the fundamental study of matter, energy, space, time, and their interactions.

topics.title: Branches of Physics
topics.description: Mechanics, thermodynamics, electromagnetism, optics, acoustics, astrophysics, atomic and nuclear physics.

topics.title: Related Fields to Physics
topics.description: Connections between physics and chemistry, biology, astronomy, geology, engineering, and medical diagnostics.

topics.title: Historical Issues and Contributors
topics.description: Pioneering discoveries by Galileo, Newton, Faraday, Maxwell, Marie Curie, Einstein, and modern physicists.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Physical Quantities

topics.title: Scales, Standards, Units (Prefixes)
topics.description: Standard measurement scales, SI system of units, and metric prefixes (pico, nano, micro, milli, centi, kilo, mega, giga).

topics.title: Measurement and Safety
topics.description: Scientific measurement instruments (meter rule, vernier caliper, micrometer, balance, stopwatch), uncertainty, and lab safety.

topics.title: Classification of Physical Quantities
topics.description: Fundamental (base) vs derived physical quantities, and scalar vs vector quantities.

topics.title: Unit Conversion
topics.description: Conversion factors between metric and non-metric units for length, area, volume, mass, time, and speed.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 3: Motion in a Straight Line
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Motion in a Straight Line

topics.title: Position, Distance and Displacement
topics.description: Reference frame, position coordinate x, total path length (distance) vs directed change in position (displacement Δx).

topics.title: Average Speed and Instantaneous Speed
topics.description: Calculating average speed (total distance / total time) vs instantaneous speedometer reading.

topics.title: Average Velocity and Instantaneous Velocity
topics.description: Displacement per unit time v_avg = Δx/Δt, direction of motion, and instantaneous velocity.

topics.title: Acceleration
topics.description: Rate of change of velocity a = (v - u)/t, uniform acceleration, and deceleration (retardation).

topics.title: Uniform Motion
topics.description: Motion at constant velocity (zero acceleration, s = vt) and its kinematic properties.

topics.title: Graphical Representation of Motion
topics.description: Position-time (s-t) and velocity-time (v-t) graphs, calculating velocity from slope and displacement from area under v-t curve.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 4: Force, Work, Energy and Power
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Force, Work, Energy and Power

topics.title: The Concept of Force
topics.description: Vector nature of force, contact vs non-contact forces, gravitational weight W = mg, and net resultant force.

topics.title: Newton's Laws of Motion
topics.description: Newton's First Law (inertia), Second Law (F_net = ma), and Third Law (action and reaction).

topics.title: Forces of Friction
topics.description: Static and kinetic friction (f_s = μ_s N, f_k = μ_k N), factors affecting friction, advantages and lubrication methods.

topics.title: The Concept of Work
topics.description: Mechanical work W = Fd cos θ, Joule (J) unit, positive, negative, and zero work conditions.

topics.title: Kinetic and Potential Energies
topics.description: Kinetic energy KE = ½mv², gravitational potential energy PE = mgh, work-energy theorem, and conservation of mechanical energy.

topics.title: Power
topics.description: Rate of doing work or energy transfer P = W/t = Fv, measured in Watts (W) and horsepower.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Simple Machines

topics.title: Simple Machines and Their Purposes
topics.description: Definition of simple machines, force multipliers, speed/distance multipliers, and direction changers.

topics.title: Simple Machines at Home
topics.description: Everyday household machines: scissors, bottle openers, knives, tweezers, door knobs, and nail clippers.

topics.title: Simple Machines at Work Place
topics.description: Construction, agricultural, and workshop machines: wheelbarrows, pulleys, jacks, ramps, axes, and wedges.

topics.title: Classification of Simple Machines
topics.description: The six classical simple machines: lever, pulley, inclined plane, wheel and axle, wedge, and screw.

topics.title: Mechanical Advantage, Velocity Ratio and Efficiency
topics.description: Actual MA (Load/Effort), Velocity Ratio VR (d_E/d_L), and Efficiency η = (MA/VR) × 100% calculations for all simple machines.

topics.title: Designing Simple Machine
topics.description: Practical design and compounding of simple machines to solve real community mechanical tasks.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 6: Mechanical Oscillation and Sound Wave
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Mechanical Oscillation and Sound Wave

topics.title: Common Characteristics of Waves
topics.description: Amplitude, wavelength (λ), period (T), frequency (f = 1/T), wave speed (v = fλ), crests, troughs, compressions, and rarefactions.

topics.title: String, Pendulum and Spring
topics.description: Periodic oscillatory motion, simple pendulum period T = 2π√(L/g), and mass-spring system T = 2π√(m/k).

topics.title: Propagation of Waves and Energy Transmission
topics.description: Transverse vs longitudinal waves, mechanical vs electromagnetic waves, and energy transfer without net matter transport.

topics.title: Sound Waves
topics.description: Production and longitudinal propagation of sound in solids, liquids, and gases; speed of sound vs temperature v = 331 + 0.6T.

topics.title: Superposition of Waves
topics.description: Principle of superposition, constructive and destructive interference, standing waves, nodes, and antinodes.

topics.title: Characteristics of Sound Waves
topics.description: Pitch (frequency), loudness and intensity (decibel dB scale), timbre (quality), reflection of sound (echoes), and ultrasound uses.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 7: Temperature and Thermometry

topics.title: Temperature and Our Life
topics.description: Concept of temperature vs heat, human body temperature regulation, weather, and environmental thermal effects.

topics.title: Extreme Temperature Safety
topics.description: Hypothermia, heatstroke, thermal burns, and safety precautions in extreme cold or hot environments.

topics.title: Temperature Change and Its Effects
topics.description: Average molecular kinetic energy, state changes, and physical property variations with temperature.

topics.title: Measuring Temperature with Different Thermometric Scales
topics.description: Celsius (°C), Fahrenheit (°F), and Kelvin (K) scales; ice point, steam point, and absolute zero (0 K = -273.15 °C).

topics.title: Types of Thermometers and Their Use
topics.description: Liquid-in-glass (mercury and alcohol), clinical, thermocouple, resistance, and infrared radiation thermometers.

topics.title: Conversion between Temperature Scales
topics.description: Exact conversion formulas: T_F = (9/5)T_C + 32, T_C = (5/9)(T_F - 32), and T_K = T_C + 273.15.

topics.title: Thermal Expansion of Materials
topics.description: Linear (ΔL = αL₀ΔT), area (ΔA = 2αA₀ΔT), and volume (ΔV = βV₀ΔT) thermal expansion of solids, liquids, and anomalous expansion of water.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Chemistry and Its Importance

topics.title: Definition and Scope of Chemistry
topics.description: Chemistry as study of composition, structure, properties, and changes of matter; central role in physical and life sciences.

topics.title: Chemistry in Industry, Medicine and Agriculture
topics.description: Synthetic fertilizers, pharmaceuticals, plastics, soaps, metallurgy, and food preservation in Ethiopia.

topics.title: The Scientific Method in Chemistry
topics.description: Systematic observation, hypothesis formulation, controlled experimentation, law vs theory formulation.

topics.title: Laboratory Safety, Hazard Symbols and Common Apparatus
topics.description: Beakers, flasks, graduated cylinders, Bunsen burners, pipettes, and safe handling of corrosive and toxic chemicals.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Measurements and Scientific Calculations

topics.title: Physical Quantities and the SI System of Units
topics.description: Base SI units (meter, kilogram, second, kelvin, mole) and derived units (volume, density, concentration).

topics.title: Scientific Notation, Metric Prefixes and Precision
