topics.description: Expressing large/small numbers in exponential form (N × 10ⁿ), mega, kilo, centi, milli, micro, nano prefixes.

topics.title: Significant Figures and Uncertainty in Measurement
topics.description: Rules for counting significant figures, rounding off rules in addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

topics.title: Dimensional Analysis (Factor-Label Method)
topics.description: Conversion factors, unit cancellations, density problems (d = m/V), and multi-step metric unit conversions.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Structure of the Atom

topics.title: Historical Development of the Atomic Model
topics.description: Dalton atomic theory, Thomson cathode ray experiment and plum pudding model, Rutherford gold foil experiment and nuclear atom.

topics.title: Subatomic Particles: Protons, Neutrons and Electrons
topics.description: Charges, relative masses, and locations of particles within the atomic nucleus and extranuclear cloud.

topics.title: Atomic Number, Mass Number, and Isotopes
topics.description: Z and A notation, calculation of neutrons (A - Z), isotopes of hydrogen, carbon, and chlorine, and calculating relative atomic mass.

topics.title: Bohr Model and Electron Energy Levels
topics.description: Quantized energy shells (K, L, M, N), electron configuration (2n² rule) and sublevels (s, p, d, f) for elements Z = 1 to 20.

topics.title: Valence Electrons and Electronic Stability
topics.description: Outermost shell electrons, Lewis dot symbols, and relationship between electron configuration and chemical reactivity.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 4: Periodic Classification of the Elements
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Periodic Classification of the Elements

topics.title: Historical Development and the Modern Periodic Law
topics.description: Dobereiner triads, Newlands octaves, Mendeleev periodic table vs Moseley modern periodic law based on atomic number.

topics.title: Periods, Groups, and Blocks of the Periodic Table
topics.description: Periods (1-7), Groups (IA-VIIIA and transition elements), s-, p-, d-, and f-blocks; metals, nonmetals, and metalloids.

topics.title: Periodic Trends: Atomic Radius and Ionic Size
topics.description: Effective nuclear charge (Z_eff), electron shielding, atomic radius decrease across a period and increase down a group.

topics.title: Ionization Energy, Electron Affinity, and Electronegativity
topics.description: First ionization energy, electron affinity, Pauling electronegativity scale, and metallic vs nonmetallic character trends.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 5: Chemical Bonding and Intermolecular Forces
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Chemical Bonding and Intermolecular Forces

topics.title: The Octet Rule and Why Atoms Combine
topics.description: Noble gas configuration (ns²np⁶), energy lowering during bond formation, and Lewis electron dot representations.

topics.title: Ionic (Electrovalent) Bonding and Properties
topics.description: Electron transfer from metal to nonmetal, crystal lattice energy, high melting points, and electrical conductivity of molten/aqueous ions.

topics.title: Covalent Bonding and Molecular Geometry
topics.description: Sharing electron pairs between nonmetals; single, double, triple, and coordinate (dative) covalent bonds.

topics.title: Polar Bonds, Metallic Bonding, and Intermolecular Forces
topics.description: Bond polarity, dipole-dipole forces, London dispersion forces, hydrogen bonding in H₂O/NH₃/HF, and the electron-sea model of metals.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Introduction to Biology

topics.title: Meaning and Branches of Biology
topics.description: Definition of biology, living vs non-living, and core branches (botany, zoology, microbiology, ecology, cytology).

topics.title: The Scientific Method in Biology
topics.description: Observation, posing testable questions, formulating hypotheses, controlled experiments, data collection, and conclusions.

topics.title: Biological Tools and Laboratory Safety
topics.description: Safety rules in laboratory, hazard symbols, dissection kit, test tubes, and chemical reagent handling.

topics.title: The Light Microscope: Parts, Care and Magnification
topics.description: Optical components, mechanical parts, total magnification calculation (eyepiece × objective), and slide preparation.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 2: Characteristics and Classification of Organisms
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Characteristics and Classification of Organisms

topics.title: Characteristics of Living Things
topics.description: Movement, respiration, sensitivity, growth, reproduction, excretion, and nutrition (MRS GREN).

topics.title: Taxonomy and Binomial Nomenclature
topics.description: Linnaean hierarchy: Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species; Latin naming conventions.

topics.title: The Five-Kingdom Classification System
topics.description: Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae, and Animalia with distinctive cellular and nutritional features.

topics.title: Using and Constructing Dichotomous Keys
topics.description: Couplets of contrasting observable physical traits used to identify unknown specimen organisms.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Cells

topics.title: The Cell Theory and Discovery of Cells
topics.description: Robert Hooke, Anton van Leeuwenhoek, Schleiden and Schwann cell theory postulates.

topics.title: Structure and Functions of Cell Organelles
topics.description: Nucleus, mitochondria, chloroplasts, ribosomes, endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus, vacuoles, cell membrane, cell wall.

topics.title: Comparison of Plant and Animal Cells
topics.description: Structural distinctions: chloroplasts, large central vacuole, rigid cellulose cell wall, and centrioles.

topics.title: Movement of Substances across Cell Membranes
topics.description: Passive transport (diffusion, facilitated diffusion, osmosis), hypotonic/hypertonic solutions, active transport (ATP).

topics.title: Cell Specialization and Levels of Organization
topics.description: Specialized cells (sperm, egg, red blood cells, guard cells, root hair), tissues, organs, organ systems.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Reproduction

topics.title: Introduction to Reproduction & Asexual Methods
topics.description: Binary fission in bacteria, budding in yeast, vegetative propagation in crops (tubers, cuttings), spore formation.

topics.title: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants (Angiosperms)
topics.description: Flower anatomy (stamen, carpel), pollination vectors (wind, insects), double fertilization, seed and fruit formation.

topics.title: Human Reproductive Anatomy
topics.description: Structure and functions of male and female reproductive systems, gamete production (spermatogenesis, oogenesis).

topics.title: The Menstrual Cycle, Fertilization and Pregnancy
topics.description: Hormonal regulation (estrogen, progesterone, LH, FSH), fertilization in oviduct, implantation, placenta function.

topics.title: Sexually Transmitted Infections (STIs) and Contraception
topics.description: Transmission, symptoms, prevention of HIV/AIDS, syphilis, gonorrhea; barrier, hormonal, and traditional family planning methods.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 5: Human Health, Nutrition, and Disease
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Human Health, Nutrition, and Disease

topics.title: Concepts of Health, Balanced Diet and Pathogens
topics.description: WHO definition of health, nutrients, infectious vs non-infectious diseases, pathogenic agents (bacteria, viruses, protozoa, fungi).

topics.title: Common Infectious Diseases in Ethiopia
topics.description: Etiology, transmission cycle, symptoms, treatment, and vector control of Malaria, Tuberculosis, Amoebiasis, and Cholera.

topics.title: Immunity and Immunization Programs
topics.description: Innate vs adaptive immunity, antigens and antibodies, active vs passive immunity, childhood vaccines (EPI).

topics.title: Personal Hygiene, Sanitation and Clean Water
topics.description: Safe waste disposal, pit latrines, water purification methods (boiling, chlorination, filtration) to prevent epidemic outbreaks.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Ecology

topics.title: Ecosystem Components and Habitats
topics.description: Biotic factors (plants, animals, microbes) and abiotic factors (sunlight, temperature, soil pH, moisture), habitats and niches.

topics.title: Food Chains, Food Webs and Trophic Levels
topics.description: Primary producers, herbivores, carnivores, omnivores, apex predators, decomposers, and trophic energy loss (10% rule).

topics.title: Ecological Pyramids and Biogeochemical Cycles
topics.description: Pyramids of numbers, biomass, and energy; carbon cycle, nitrogen cycle, and water cycle in maintaining biosphere equilibrium.

topics.title: Conservation of Natural Resources in Ethiopia
topics.description: Reforestation, soil conservation, protected areas (national parks, wildlife reserves), and preserving endemic Ethiopian biodiversity.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Living in a Village

topics.title: Reading: Daily Life and Community in an Ethiopian Village
topics.description: Agrarian communal lifestyle, harvesting, Debo cooperative labor, and rural traditions.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Agriculture, Rural Landscapes & Community Terms
topics.description: Homestead, cattle husbandry, ploughing, harvest, seasonal calendar, and hospitality.

topics.title: Grammar: Simple Present vs. Present Continuous Tenses
topics.description: Habitual actions and general truths vs ongoing temporary actions; stative verbs.

topics.title: Speaking: Describing One's Hometown and Local Traditions
topics.description: Oral descriptions of regional hometowns, asking polite questions about rural life.

topics.title: Writing: Descriptive Paragraphs about Village Communities
topics.description: Topic sentences, sensory details, spatial organization, and concluding sentences.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: History of Writing

topics.title: Reading: From Ancient Cuneiform and Hieroglyphs to the Ge'ez Script
topics.description: Evolution of written language, Mesopotamian tablets, Egyptian papyrus, and Ethiopian Ge'ez abugida.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Literacy, Manuscripts & Ancient Inscriptions
topics.description: Calligraphy, parchment, scribes, alphabet, vowels, consonants, epigraphy.

topics.title: Grammar: Simple Past and Past Continuous Tenses
topics.description: Completed historical events vs interrupted past actions with when and while clauses.

topics.title: Speaking: Recounting the Origins and Significance of Writing
topics.description: Summarizing historical timelines orally, giving short explanatory talks to class.

topics.title: Writing: Short Narrative Paragraphs on Historical Discoveries
topics.description: Chronological transition words (initially, subsequently, thereafter, finally).

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: People and Animals

topics.title: Reading: Wildlife Conservation and Endangered Species in Ethiopia
topics.description: Walia ibex, Ethiopian wolf, mountain nyala, human-wildlife conflict and sanctuary habitats.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Zoology, Animal Behaviors & Conservation Biology
topics.description: Carnivore, herbivore, habitat loss, poaching, endangered, sanctuary, national park.

topics.title: Grammar: Modals of Ability, Permission and Advice
topics.description: Can, could, may, should, ought to; giving environmental advice to community members.

topics.title: Speaking: Debating the Protection of Endangered Wildlife
topics.description: Expressing agreement, respectful disagreement, and offering conservation solutions.

topics.title: Writing: Persuasive Short Essays on Protecting Domestic & Wild Animals
topics.description: Stating a clear claim, providing supporting reasons, and concluding with a call to action.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: The Digital World

topics.title: Reading: How the Internet and Smart Devices Transform Modern Society
topics.description: Communication revolutions, access to online educational libraries, and social media connectivity.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Computing, Internet Navigation & Cyber Security
topics.description: Browsers, hyperlinks, password security, viruses, downloads, online forums, cloud.

topics.title: Grammar: Expressing the Future: Will, Be Going To, Present Continuous
topics.description: Predictions vs prior intentions/plans vs fixed calendar arrangements.

topics.title: Speaking: Safe Internet Habits and Cyber-Bullying Prevention
topics.description: Discussing online privacy, ethical internet use, and digital footprint with peers.

topics.title: Writing: Opinion Paragraphs on the Benefits and Risks of Social Media
topics.description: Balanced paragraph structure: topic claim, supporting evidence, acknowledging opposing views.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Tourism in Ethiopia

topics.title: Reading: Historic and Natural Marvels of Ethiopia
topics.description: Lalibela, Gondar castles, Axum stelae, Danakil depression, Erta Ale, Blue Nile Falls.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Travel, Tourism Destinations & Hospitality
topics.description: Souvenirs, tour guide, lodging, expedition, historical monuments, scenic landscapes.

topics.title: Grammar: Comparative and Superlative Adjectives and Adverbs
topics.description: Regular and irregular comparative forms (better, worse, farther); as... as comparisons.

topics.title: Speaking: Roleplaying Tour Guides Recommending Itineraries
topics.description: Providing courteous recommendations, highlighting historical facts, and answering questions.

topics.title: Writing: Informational Travel Brochures on Ethiopian Attractions
topics.description: Appealing headlines, descriptive adjectives, bulleted highlights, and practical visitor tips.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Community Services

topics.title: Reading: Civic Engagement, Iddir, and Community Self-Help Organizations
topics.description: Traditional Ethiopian social support networks, volunteerism, blood donation, elderly care.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Volunteerism, Civic Duties & Social Welfare
topics.description: Contribution, solidarity, welfare, nonprofit, civic responsibility, mutual assistance.

topics.title: Grammar: The Passive Voice (Present and Past Simple)
topics.description: Focusing on the action and recipient rather than the actor: Millions of trees are planted.

topics.title: Speaking: Delivering Short Speeches on Community Leadership
topics.description: Structuring a short persuasive speech, eye contact, audible projection, and inspirational closing.

topics.title: Writing: Formal Thank-You Letters to Community Volunteers
topics.description: Formal salutation, expressing genuine gratitude, specifying contributions, and formal sign-off.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 7: Traditional Games

topics.title: Reading: Indigenous Ethiopian Sports: Genna, Gugs, and Gebeta
topics.description: Cultural origins, rules, seasonal festivities, sportsmanship, and physical coordination.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Sports Rules, Equipment & Traditional Pastimes
topics.description: Puck, stick, equestrian, game board, pebbles, tournament, referee, victory.

topics.title: Grammar: Zero and First Conditionals
topics.description: Universal game rules (If you drop the ball...) and realistic future outcomes (If they score...).

topics.title: Speaking: Explaining Game Rules Clearly to New Players
topics.description: Using sequential instructions, checking for listener understanding, and demonstrating.

topics.title: Writing: Instructional Rulebooks for Traditional Games
topics.description: Numbered rule steps, equipment lists, player count, penalty conditions, and winning criteria.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 8: Healthy Living

topics.title: Reading: Dietary Balance, Hydration and Daily Exercise
topics.description: Balanced food plate, benefits of active movement, mental wellbeing, and sleep hygiene.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Health, Nutrition, Physical Exercise & Wellness
topics.description: Vitamins, proteins, minerals, carbohydrates, hydration, calories, aerobic fitness.

topics.title: Grammar: Defining and Non-Defining Relative Clauses
topics.description: Who, which, that, where; combining sentences to add essential or descriptive information.

topics.title: Speaking: Interviewing Peers on Daily Health Routines
topics.description: Conducting health surveys, recording responses, and presenting group findings.

topics.title: Writing: Health Advisory Articles for School Newsletters
topics.description: Catchy advisory title, subheadings, actionable wellness tips, and encouraging closing.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 9: Climate and Environment

topics.title: Reading: Weather Cycles, Droughts, and Climate Resilience in the Horn of Africa
topics.description: Rainfall patterns, impact of climate variability on agriculture, and building resilience.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Meteorology, Climatology & Ecological Adaptation
topics.description: Precipitation, greenhouse effect, renewable energy, reforestation, afforestation, drought.

topics.title: Grammar: Cause and Effect Conjunctions
topics.description: Because, since, as a result of, consequently, therefore, due to; sentence linking.

topics.title: Speaking: Presenting Proposals for School Tree Nurseries
topics.description: Pitching school environmental initiatives, justifying resource requirements.

topics.title: Writing: Cause-and-Effect Essays on Deforestation and Soil Erosion
topics.description: Structuring cause-and-effect body paragraphs with clear analytical linking.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 10: Woodwork and Metalwork

topics.title: Reading: Traditional Crafts, Carpentry, and Blacksmithing in Ethiopia
topics.description: Handcrafted agricultural tools, wooden furniture, cultural ironwork, and technical skills.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Workshop Tools, Metallurgy & Carpentry Materials
topics.description: Anvil, chisel, plane, saw, hammer, welding, timber, joints, forge, measuring tape.

topics.title: Grammar: Imperatives and Process Passive for Technical Instructions
topics.description: Direct steps: Measure twice, cut once; Passive: The timber is planed smooth.

topics.title: Speaking: Explaining Safety Precautions in Vocational Workshops
topics.description: Safety goggles, protective boots, ventilation, hazard awareness in workshop.

topics.title: Writing: Illustrated Technical How-To Manuals for Simple Wooden Items
topics.description: Materials list, tool requirements, sequential numbered steps, and safety warnings.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Relations and Functions

topics.title: Relations
topics.description: Definition of relation, domain, codomain, range, inverse of a relation, and graphing relations including linear inequalities.

topics.title: Functions
topics.description: Definition of function, combinations of functions, one-to-one (injective), onto (surjective), and one-to-one correspondence (bijective), composition of functions f(g(x)), inverse functions f⁻¹(x), and graph transformations.

topics.title: Applications of Relations and Functions
topics.description: Real-world mathematical modeling using linear, quadratic, and piecewise relations and functions.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Polynomial Functions

topics.title: Definition of Polynomial Function
topics.description: Polynomial function P(x) = aₙxⁿ + ... + a₁x + a₀, degree, leading coefficient, constant term, and domain.

topics.title: Operations on Polynomial Functions
topics.description: Addition, subtraction, multiplication, and polynomial division algorithm P(x) = D(x)·Q(x) + R(x).

topics.title: Theorems on Polynomial Functions
topics.description: Polynomial Division Theorem, Remainder Theorem R = P(c), Factor Theorem (x - c is a factor iff P(c) = 0), and synthetic division.

topics.title: Zeros of Polynomial Functions
topics.description: Rational Root Test (p/q), Location Theorem (intermediate value sign change), multiplicity of zeros, and Fundamental Theorem of Algebra.

topics.title: Graphs of Polynomial Functions
topics.description: End behavior (leading term test), x- and y-intercepts, behavior at roots of even/odd multiplicity, turning points (at most n - 1), and curve sketching.

topics.title: Applications
topics.description: Applied optimization and geometric volume/area problems modeled by polynomial equations.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Exponential and Logarithmic Functions

topics.title: Exponents and Logarithms
topics.description: Irrational exponents, laws of exponents, definition of logarithm log_b(y) = x ⇔ bˣ = y, laws of logarithms, change of base formula, common logs (mantissa & characteristic), and natural logarithms (ln).

topics.title: The Exponential Functions and Their Graphs
topics.description: f(x) = bˣ (b > 1 growth vs 0 < b < 1 decay), domain ℝ, range (0, ∞), y-intercept (0, 1), horizontal asymptote, and transformations.

topics.title: The Logarithmic Functions and Their Graphs
topics.description: f(x) = log_b(x), domain (0, ∞), range ℝ, x-intercept (1, 0), vertical asymptote x = 0, and reflection symmetry across y = x.

topics.title: Solving Exponential and Logarithmic Equations
topics.description: Properties of equality for exponential and logarithmic equations, extraneous root checking, and change-of-base techniques.

topics.title: Relation Between Exponential and Logarithmic Functions
topics.description: Inverse relationship f(f⁻¹(x)) = b^(log_b x) = x and log_b(bˣ) = x, and converting between forms.

topics.title: Applications
topics.description: Population growth, radioactive half-life decay, compound interest A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt), continuous compounding Pe^(rt), pH scale, and decibel intensity.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Trigonometric Functions

topics.title: Radian Measure of Angle
topics.description: Angles in standard position, coterminal angles, radian measure (180° = π rad), arc length s = rθ, and sector area A = ½r²θ.

topics.title: Basic Trigonometric Functions
topics.description: Unit circle definitions of sin θ, cos θ, tan θ, csc θ, sec θ, cot θ; signs in four quadrants (ASTC); reference angles; co-function and periodicity properties; graphs of sin, cos, and tan.

topics.title: Trigonometric Identities & Equations
topics.description: Reciprocal, quotient, and Pythagorean identities (sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, 1 + cot²θ = csc²θ), simplifying expressions, and solving trigonometric equations.

topics.title: Applications
topics.description: Angles of elevation and depression, marine/aerial navigation bearings, and surveying heights and distances.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Circles

topics.title: Symmetrical Properties of Circles
topics.description: Chord properties, perpendicular bisector of a chord passes through the center, and equal chords are equidistant from the center.

topics.title: Angle Properties of Circles
topics.description: Central angles, inscribed angles, Thales' theorem (angle in a semicircle is 90°), angles subtended by the same arc, and cyclic quadrilaterals.

topics.title: Arc Length, Perimeters and Areas of Segments and Sectors
topics.description: Calculating arc length, perimeter and area of circular sectors, and area of circular segments (A_sector - ½r² sin θ).

topics.title: Theorems on Angles and Arcs Determined by Lines Intersecting Inside, On and Outside a Circle
topics.description: Intersecting chords angle/segment theorems, tangent-chord angle theorem, and secant-secant / secant-tangent exterior angle and power theorems.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Solid Figures

topics.title: Revision of Cylinders and Prisms
topics.description: Cross-sections, lateral surface area, total surface area, and volume of right prisms and circular cylinders.

topics.title: Pyramids, Cones and Spheres
topics.description: Regular pyramids, right circular cones, and spheres: slant height, vertex angle, lateral/total surface area, and volume formulas.

topics.title: Frustum of Pyramids and Cones
topics.description: Horizontal cross-sections, similarity ratios of areas (k²) and volumes (k³), lateral/total surface area, and volume of frustums V = (h/3)(A₁ + A₂ + √(A₁A₂)) and V = (πh/3)(R² + r² + Rr).

topics.title: Surface Areas and Volumes of Composed Solids
topics.description: Calculating exposed surface area and total volume of composite 3D solids (cone-cylinder, hemisphere-cylinder, hollowed solids).

topics.title: Applications
topics.description: Engineering and container capacity problems involving frustums (buckets, lampshades, hoppers) and composite solids.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 7: Coordinate Geometry

topics.title: Distance Between Two Points
topics.description: Distance formula d = √[(x₂ - x₁)² + (y₂ - y₁)²] and geometric proofs in the coordinate plane.

topics.title: Division of a Line Segment
topics.description: Point P(x, y) dividing segment AB internally in ratio m:n: x = (mx₂ + nx₁)/(m+n), y = (my₂ + ny₁)/(m+n), and midpoint formula.

topics.title: Equation of a Line
topics.description: Angle of inclination θ, slope m = tan θ, point-slope, slope-intercept, two-point, intercept (x/a + y/b = 1), and general form Ax + By + C = 0.

topics.title: Slopes of Parallel and Perpendicular Lines
topics.description: Parallel lines (m₁ = m₂) and perpendicular lines (m₁·m₂ = -1); finding perpendicular bisectors and altitudes of triangles.

topics.title: Equation of a Circle
topics.description: Standard form (x - h)² + (y - k)² = r², general form x² + y² + Dx + Ey + F = 0, completing the square, and position of a point/line relative to a circle.

topics.title: Applications
topics.description: Applied coordinate geometry problems in navigation, urban grid mapping, and geometric locus proofs.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Vector Quantities

topics.title: Scalars and Vectors
topics.description: Distinction between scalar quantities (magnitude only) and vector quantities (magnitude and direction).

topics.title: Vector Representations
topics.description: Graphical arrow representation and analytical algebraic notation of vectors, collinear, coplanar, equal, and negative vectors.

topics.title: Vector Addition and Subtraction
topics.description: Adding and subtracting parallel, anti-parallel, and perpendicular vectors using Pythagoras' theorem and trigonometry.

topics.title: Graphical Method of Vector Addition
topics.description: Triangle law, parallelogram law, and polygon law of vector addition using scale drawings.

topics.title: Vector Resolution
topics.description: Resolving a vector into perpendicular horizontal (R_x = R cos θ) and vertical (R_y = R sin θ) components, and finding resultant from components.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Uniformly Accelerated Motion

topics.title: Position and Displacement
topics.description: Position vector and displacement Δx = x_f - x_i along a straight coordinate axis.

topics.title: Average Velocity and Instantaneous Velocity
topics.description: Average velocity v_avg = Δx/Δt vs instantaneous velocity at a specific instant in time.

topics.title: Acceleration
topics.description: Average and instantaneous acceleration a = (v - u)/t, uniform acceleration, and direction of acceleration relative to velocity.

topics.title: Equations of Motion with Constant Acceleration
topics.description: The five kinematic equations of uniformly accelerated motion and vertical free fall under gravity (g = 9.8 m/s²).

topics.title: Graphical Representation of Uniformly Accelerated Motion
topics.description: Interpreting position-time (s-t), velocity-time (v-t), and acceleration-time (a-t) graphs; slopes and areas under curves.

topics.title: Relative Velocity in One Dimension
topics.description: Relative velocity v_AB = v_A - v_B for bodies moving in the same or opposite directions.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 3: Elasticity and Static Equilibrium of Rigid Body
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Elasticity and Static Equilibrium of Rigid Body

topics.title: Elasticity and Plasticity
topics.description: Deforming forces, elastic vs plastic deformation, Hooke's Law (F = kx), and elastic limit.

topics.title: Density and Specific Gravity
topics.description: Density ρ = m/V (kg/m³) and relative density / specific gravity (ρ_substance / ρ_water).

topics.title: Stress and Strain
topics.description: Tensile/compressive stress (σ = F/A in Pascals), tensile strain (ε = ΔL/L₀), and stress-strain curve (yield point, ultimate strength, fracture).

topics.title: The Young Modulus
topics.description: Young's modulus of elasticity Y = Stress/Strain = (F·L₀)/(A·ΔL) and elastic strain energy.

topics.title: Static Equilibrium
topics.description: Torque (moment of force τ = rF sin θ), center of gravity, First Condition (ΣF = 0) and Second Condition (Στ = 0) of static equilibrium.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Static and Current Electricity

topics.title: Charges in Nature
topics.description: Positive and negative electric charges, quantization of charge (Q = ne), conservation of charge, conductors and insulators.

topics.title: Methods of Charging a Body
topics.description: Charging by rubbing (triboelectric friction), charging by conduction (contact), and charging by electrostatic induction.

topics.title: The Electroscope
topics.description: Gold-leaf electroscope structure, charging an electroscope, detecting charge presence, sign of charge, and testing conductors/insulators.

topics.title: Electrical Discharge
topics.description: Point discharge, lightning formation, lightning conductors (arresters), and electrostatic hazards.

topics.title: Coulomb's Law of Electrostatics
topics.description: Electrostatic force F = k|q₁q₂|/r² between point charges (k = 8.99 × 10⁹ N·m²/C²).

topics.title: The Electric Field
topics.description: Electric field strength E = F/q = kQ/r² (N/C), electric field lines properties, and field patterns around point charges and parallel plates.

topics.title: Electric Circuits
topics.description: Components of a complete electric circuit, circuit symbols, open vs closed circuits, conventional current vs electron flow.

topics.title: Current, Voltage, and Ohm's Law
topics.description: Electric current I = Q/t (Amperes), potential difference V = W/Q (Volts), EMF, internal resistance, Ohm's Law (V = IR), and resistivity R = ρL/A.

topics.title: Combination of Resistors in a Circuit
topics.description: Series (R_eq = R₁ + R₂ + ...), parallel (1/R_eq = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂ + ...), and series-parallel resistor networks.

topics.title: Voltmeter and Ammeter Connection in a Circuit
topics.description: Connecting ammeters in series (low resistance) and voltmeters in parallel (high resistance); electrical energy and power P = IV = I²R = V²/R.

topics.title: Electrical Safety in General and Local Context
topics.description: Fuses, circuit breakers, three-pin plugs, earthing (grounding), dampness hazards, and first aid for electric shock.

topics.title: Electric Projects
topics.description: Practical domestic wiring projects, model house lighting circuits, and troubleshooting simple circuits.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Magnetism

topics.title: Magnet
topics.description: Ferromagnetic, paramagnetic, and diamagnetic materials; magnetic poles, law of magnetism, magnetization and demagnetization.

topics.title: Magnetic Field
topics.description: Magnetic field lines, magnetic flux density B (Tesla), neutral points, and magnetic shielding.

topics.title: The Earth's Magnetic Field and the Compass
topics.description: Geomagnetic poles vs geographic poles, angle of declination, angle of dip (inclination), and compass navigation.

topics.title: Magnetic Field of a Current-Carrying Conductor
topics.description: Oersted's experiment, right-hand grip rule for a straight wire (B = μ₀I / 2πr) and a current-carrying solenoid (B = μ₀nI).

topics.title: Magnetic Force on a Moving Charge
topics.description: Magnetic Lorentz force F = qvB sin θ on a charged particle moving in a magnetic field and circular path radius r = mv/(qB).

topics.title: Magnetic Force on a Current-Carrying Wire
topics.description: Motor force F = BIL sin θ on a conductor in a magnetic field and Fleming's Left-Hand Rule / Right-Hand Palm Rule.

topics.title: Magnetic Force Between Two Parallel Current-Carrying Wires
topics.description: Force per unit length F/L = (μ₀I₁I₂)/(2πd); parallel currents attract, anti-parallel currents repel.

topics.title: Applications of Magnetism
topics.description: Electromagnets, electric bells, relays, moving-coil loudspeakers, and simple DC electric motors.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 6: Electromagnetic Waves and Geometrical Optics
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Electromagnetic Waves and Geometrical Optics

topics.title: Electromagnetic (EM) Waves
topics.description: Transverse oscillating electric and magnetic fields perpendicular to propagation, speed in vacuum c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m/s, c = fλ.

topics.title: EM Spectrum
topics.description: Radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays, and gamma rays: wavelengths, frequencies, sources, and applications.

topics.title: Light as a Wave
topics.description: Rectilinear propagation of light, rays and beams, luminous vs illuminated bodies, transparent/translucent/opaque media, and pinhole camera.

topics.title: Laws of Reflection & Refraction
topics.description: Laws of reflection, plane mirror image properties, number of images in inclined mirrors, refractive index n = c/v, Snell's Law (n₁ sin θ₁ = n₂ sin θ₂), real/apparent depth, critical angle (sin θ_c = 1/n), and total internal reflection (optical fibers).

topics.title: Mirrors and Lenses
topics.description: Concave and convex spherical mirrors, principal focus, ray diagrams, mirror equation (1/f = 1/u + 1/v), magnification m = -v/u, converging and diverging thin lenses, lens equation, and power of a lens P = 1/f (Diopters).

topics.title: Human Eye and Optical Instruments
topics.description: Anatomy of the human eye, accommodation, near point (25 cm) and far point, myopia (short-sightedness, concave lens) and hypermetropia (long-sightedness, convex lens), simple magnifier, compound microscope, and astronomical telescope.

topics.title: Primary Colors of Light and Human Vision
topics.description: Dispersion of white light by a prism (VIBGYOR), monochromatic vs polychromatic light, rods and cones in the retina, and RGB primary colors.

topics.title: Color Addition of Light
topics.description: Additive mixing of Red, Green, and Blue light to produce secondary colors (Yellow, Cyan, Magenta) and white light; complementary colors.

topics.title: Color Subtraction of Light Using Filters
topics.description: Subtractive color mixing with pigments and optical color filters; appearance of colored objects under different illuminations.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Chemical Reactions and Stoichiometry

topics.title: Introduction
topics.description: Physical vs chemical changes, reactants and products, and conditions for chemical reactions.

topics.title: Chemical Equations
topics.description: Writing and balancing chemical equations using the Law of Conservation of Mass, inspection method, and LCM method.

topics.title: Types of Chemical Reactions
topics.description: Direct combination (synthesis), decomposition, single displacement, and double displacement (metathesis) reactions.

topics.title: Oxidation and Reduction Reactions
topics.description: Oxidation number rules, oxidizing and reducing agents, redox vs non-redox reactions, and balancing redox equations by oxidation-number change.

topics.title: Molecular and Formula Masses, the Mole Concept and Chemical Formulas
topics.description: Molecular mass, formula mass, mole, Avogadro's number (6.022 × 10²³), molar mass, percentage composition, empirical and molecular formulas.

topics.title: Stoichiometry
topics.description: Mass-mass, mole-mole, volume-volume (STP 22.4 L/mol), mass-volume calculations, limiting and excess reactants, and percentage yield.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Solutions

topics.title: Heterogeneous and Homogeneous Mixtures
topics.description: Definitions and properties of suspensions, colloids (Tyndall effect, Brownian motion), and true solutions (solute and solvent).

topics.title: The Solution Process
topics.description: Liquid solutions, inter-particle forces ("like dissolves like"), hydration/solvation energy, lattice energy, and heat of solution (ΔH_soln).

topics.title: Solubility as an Equilibrium Process
topics.description: Unsaturated, saturated, and supersaturated solutions; effect of temperature on solid/gas solubility and Henry's Law (C = kP).

topics.title: Ways of Expressing Concentration of Solution
topics.description: Mass percentage, ppm, mole fraction (X), molarity (M), normality (N = M × z), and molality (m).

topics.title: Preparation of Solutions
topics.description: Preparing solutions of known molarity from solid solutes and by diluting stock solutions (M₁V₁ = M₂V₂).

topics.title: Solution Stoichiometry
topics.description: Calculating volumes, moles, and masses of reactants and products in aqueous chemical reactions and titrations.

topics.title: Describing Reactions in Solution
topics.description: Molecular equations, complete ionic equations, spectator ions, and net ionic equations.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Important Inorganic Compounds

topics.title: Introduction
topics.description: Classification of inorganic compounds into oxides, acids, bases, and salts.

topics.title: Oxides
topics.description: Acidic oxides, basic oxides, amphoteric oxides (ZnO, Al₂O₃, PbO, SnO), neutral oxides (CO, NO, N₂O), and peroxides (H₂O₂, Na₂O₂).

topics.title: Acids
topics.description: Arrhenius, Brønsted-Lowry (conjugate acid-base pairs), and Lewis definitions; classification, preparation, properties, pH and pOH scales (pH + pOH = 14).

topics.title: Bases
topics.description: Arrhenius, Brønsted-Lowry, and Lewis bases; strong vs weak bases, alkalis, preparation, chemical properties, and neutralization.

topics.title: Salts
topics.description: Classification (normal, acidic, basic, double, complex salts), preparation methods, solubility rules, deliquescent/hygroscopic/efflorescent salts, and plant macronutrients (N, P, K).

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Energy Changes and Electrochemistry

topics.title: Introduction
topics.description: System and surroundings, open/closed/isolated systems, exothermic (ΔH < 0) and endothermic (ΔH > 0) reactions, enthalpy and thermochemical equations.

topics.title: Energy Changes in Electrochemistry
topics.description: Electrical conductivity: metallic (electronic) vs electrolytic (ionic) conduction; strong and weak electrolytes.

topics.title: Electrochemical Cells
topics.description: Galvanic (voltaic) cells: Daniell cell, anode (oxidation), cathode (reduction), salt bridge, primary and secondary batteries (Dry cell, Lead-acid storage, Nickel-cadmium).

topics.title: Electrolysis
topics.description: Electrolytic cells, preferential discharge of ions, electrolysis of molten PbBr₂, concentrated NaCl, dilute H₂SO₄, and electroplating/electrorefining.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Metals and Nonmetals

topics.title: Introduction
topics.description: Natural abundance of elements in the Earth's crust, minerals, ores, and gangue.

topics.title: General Properties of Metals and Production of Some Metals
topics.description: Physical/chemical properties of metals, metallurgy steps (concentration, roasting/calcination, reduction, refining), alloys, and extraction/uses of Al, Fe (blast furnace), and Cu.

topics.title: Production of Some Important Nonmetals
topics.description: General properties of nonmetals; industrial extraction, allotropes, properties, and compounds of Nitrogen (Haber process), Phosphorus, Oxygen, Sulfur (Frasch & Contact process), and Chlorine.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 6: Hydrocarbons and Their Natural Sources
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Hydrocarbons and Their Natural Sources

topics.title: Introduction
topics.description: History of organic chemistry (Wöhler synthesis of urea), catenation and tetravalency of carbon, functional groups, and homologous series.

topics.title: Saturated Hydrocarbons: Alkanes (CnH2n+2)
topics.description: Alkanes and cycloalkanes, IUPAC nomenclature, structural isomerism, laboratory preparation (decarboxylation, Wurtz reaction), and halogenation/combustion reactions.

topics.title: Unsaturated Hydrocarbons: Alkenes and Alkynes
topics.description: Alkenes (CnH2n) and Alkynes (CnH2n-2), cis-trans geometrical isomerism, preparation (dehydration, dehydrohalogenation, CaC₂ hydrolysis), Markovnikov's rule addition reactions, and tests for unsaturation (Br₂ water, Baeyer's reagent).

topics.title: Aromatic Hydrocarbons: Benzene
topics.description: Structure of benzene (C₆H₆), resonance stability, physical properties, and substitution (nitration, halogenation, sulfonation) vs addition reactions.

topics.title: Natural Sources of Hydrocarbons
topics.description: Natural gas, crude oil (fractional distillation of petroleum, cracking, octane number), and destructive distillation of coal.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Sub-fields of Biology

topics.title: Meaning and Major Sub-fields of Biology
topics.description: Botany, zoology, microbiology, cytology, genetics, ecology, anatomy, physiology, taxonomy, and molecular biology.

topics.title: Pure and Applied Fields of Biology
topics.description: Distinctions between pure biological research and applied fields: agriculture, medicine, forestry, biotechnology, and environmental management.

topics.title: Contributions of Renowned Biologists
topics.description: Historical milestones: Aristotle, Galen, Antonie van Leeuwenhoek, Carl Linnaeus, Charles Darwin, Gregor Mendel, Robert Koch, Louis Pasteur, Watson & Crick, and Ian Wilmut.

topics.title: Contributions of Ethiopian Biologists
topics.description: Groundbreaking discoveries: Dr. Aklilu Lemma & Dr. Legesse Wolde-Yohannes (Endod for bilharzia control), Prof. Yalemtsehay Mekonnen, Prof. Gebissa Ejeta (Striga-resistant sorghum), and Prof. Tilahun Yilma.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Plants

topics.title: Major Groups of Plants
topics.description: Classification: Bryophytes (mosses), Pteridophytes (ferns), Gymnosperms (conifers), and Angiosperms (flowering plants - monocots vs dicots).

topics.title: Structure and Function of Plant Organs
topics.description: Anatomy and morphology of roots, stems, and leaves; internal cellular structure and vascular bundles (xylem and phloem).

topics.title: Reproduction in Gymnosperms and Angiosperms
topics.description: Life cycle of pine trees, floral reproductive anatomy, pollination mechanisms, double fertilization, fruit formation, and seed structure.

topics.title: Photosynthesis, Transpiration, and Transport in Plants
topics.description: Light-dependent and light-independent photosynthetic pathways, action spectrum, stomatal mechanism, transpiration pull, and phloem translocation.

topics.title: Plant Tropisms and Hormones
topics.description: Phytohormones (auxins, gibberellins, cytokinins, ethylene, ABA), phototropism, geotropism, Darwin experiments, and growth regulation.

topics.title: Economically and Medicinally Important Ethiopian Plants
topics.description: Indigenous crops and phytomedicines: Coffee arabica, Teff (Eragrostis tef), Enset (Ensete ventricosum), Gesho, Hagenia abyssinica (Kosso), and traditional therapeutic uses.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Biochemical Molecules

topics.title: Inorganic Molecules: Water and Minerals
topics.description: Chemical structure of water, polar covalent bonding, cohesion, adhesion, high specific heat, surface tension, and biological significance of macro- and micro-minerals.

topics.title: Carbohydrates: Monosaccharides, Disaccharides, and Polysaccharides
topics.description: Structural formulas of glucose, fructose, galactose; glycosidic bonds in maltose, sucrose, lactose; storage polysaccharides (starch, glycogen) and structural cellulose; Benedict and iodine tests.

topics.title: Lipids: Fats, Oils, and Phospholipids
topics.description: Triglyceride formation, ester linkages, saturated vs unsaturated fatty acids, phospholipid amphipathic bilayer in cell membranes, and lipid biological functions.

topics.title: Proteins: Amino Acids and Polypeptides
topics.description: General structure of amino acids, peptide bond formation, essential vs non-essential amino acids, structural organization, enzyme catalysis, Biuret and Xanthoproteic tests.

topics.title: Nucleic Acids: DNA and RNA
topics.description: Nucleotide monomer components (pentose sugar, phosphate, nitrogenous bases A, T, C, G, U), phosphodiester backbone, Watson-Crick double helix, mRNA/tRNA/rRNA, and genetic information storage.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Cell Reproduction

topics.title: The Cell Cycle and Stages
topics.description: Interphase phases (G1, S, G2), DNA replication, cellular growth checkpoints, and transition into mitotic division.

topics.title: Mitosis: Stages and Significance
topics.description: Sequential phases: Prophase, Metaphase, Anaphase, Telophase; mitotic spindle assembly, cytokinesis; role in growth, tissue repair, and asexual reproduction.

topics.title: Meiosis: Reduction Division and Genetic Variation
topics.description: Meiosis I and Meiosis II, homologous chromosome synapsis, crossing over at chiasmata, independent assortment, haploid gamete formation, and genetic diversity.

topics.title: Comparison Between Mitosis and Meiosis
topics.description: Equational vs reductional division, diploid (2n) vs haploid (n) daughter cells, somatic vs germline occurrence, and evolutionary significance.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Human Biology

topics.title: The Human Digestive System
topics.description: Alimentary canal anatomy (mouth, pharynx, esophagus, stomach, small and large intestines), accessory glands (salivary, liver, pancreas), mechanical and chemical digestion, digestive enzymes, villi nutrient absorption.

topics.title: The Human Circulatory and Lymphatic System
topics.description: Heart structure, cardiac cycle, double circulation, arterial/venous/capillary anatomy, blood cellular components (RBCs, WBCs, platelets, plasma), ABO blood typing and Rh factor, lymphatic drainage, cardiovascular health.

topics.title: The Human Respiratory System
topics.description: Respiratory tract anatomy (nasal cavity, larynx, trachea, bronchi, alveoli), breathing mechanics (diaphragm and intercostal muscle action during inspiration/expiration), pulmonary gas diffusion, comparison of atmospheric vs exhaled air.

topics.title: The Human Excretory and Urinary System
topics.description: Kidney macro- and micro-anatomy, nephron filtration (Bowman capsule ultrafiltration, selective reabsorption, tubular secretion), urine composition, osmoregulation, and homeostatic fluid balance.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Ecological Interactions

topics.title: Ecosystem Concepts and Trophic Relationships
topics.description: Biotic and abiotic ecosystem components, autotrophs, heterotrophs, saprotrophs, food chains, complex food webs, trophic levels, and the 10% ecological energy transfer efficiency.

topics.title: Ecological Pyramids
topics.description: Construction and interpretation of pyramids of numbers, biomass, and energy; inverted vs upright ecological pyramids in terrestrial and aquatic systems.

topics.title: Biogeochemical Nutrient Cycles
topics.description: Hydrological cycle, carbon-oxygen cycle, and nitrogen cycle pathways (nitrogen fixation, nitrification, plant assimilation, ammonification, denitrification) in biosphere maintenance.

topics.title: Interspecific Interactions and Symbiosis
topics.description: Symbiotic and non-symbiotic relationships: mutualism, commensalism, parasitism, predation, interspecific competition, and ecological niche partitioning.

topics.title: Environmental Challenges and Conservation in Ethiopia
topics.description: Deforestation, soil erosion, climate change, wildlife protected areas (Simien, Bale Mountains, Awash), conservation of endemic Ethiopian fauna, and national afforestation initiatives.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Population Growth

topics.title: Listening: Population Explosion
topics.description: Listening for demographic statistics, population growth rates, and socio-economic impacts.

topics.title: Speaking: Discussing Population Trends
topics.description: Expressing opinions, agreeing and disagreeing politely on demographic challenges.

topics.title: Reading: Population Growth
topics.description: Skimming, scanning, and intensive reading on global and Ethiopian population dynamics.

topics.title: Grammar: Degrees of Comparison, Tenses & Relative Clauses
topics.description: Comparative structures, present tenses for trends, and relative clauses in demographic writing.

topics.title: Writing: Interpreting Graphs and Descriptive Paragraphs
topics.description: Describing population charts and writing well-structured analytical paragraphs.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Travel Behaviors

topics.title: Listening: Travelling and Places
topics.description: Comprehending travel narratives, itineraries, and commuter habits.

topics.title: Speaking: Asking for and Giving Directions & Advice
topics.description: Polite inquiries, giving clear spatial directions, and travel recommendations.

topics.title: Reading: Travel Behaviors
topics.description: Analyzing texts on modern travel patterns, road safety, and eco-friendly transit.

topics.title: Grammar: Past Tenses, Modals of Obligation & Adverbs of Frequency
topics.description: Simple past vs past continuous/perfect, must/have to/should, and frequency adverbs.

topics.title: Writing: Narrative and Expository Travel Paragraphs
topics.description: Writing personal travel narratives and formal paragraphs on transportation.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Punctuality

topics.title: Listening: Punctual Students
topics.description: Identifying habits of effective time management and consequences of tardiness.

topics.title: Speaking: Apologizing and Explaining Reasons
topics.description: Making sincere apologies, giving valid reasons, and discussing time consciousness.

topics.title: Reading: Punctuality
topics.description: Reading comprehension on the value of punctuality in academic and professional life.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Time Management, Idioms & Collocations
topics.description: Time-related idioms (on the dot, around the clock, procrastinate, deadline) and word formation.

topics.title: Grammar: Conditionals, Prepositions of Time & Clauses of Result
topics.description: Zero, first, and second conditionals; prepositions (at, on, in, by, until); so...that / such...that.

topics.title: Writing: Expository Essays on Time Management
topics.description: Planning, drafting, and revising multi-paragraph essays on punctuality.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Tourist Attractions

topics.title: Listening: Giving Information for Tourists
topics.description: Listening to tour briefings on Ethiopia's UNESCO World Heritage landmarks.

topics.title: Speaking: Describing Historical and Natural Attractions
topics.description: Role-playing tour guides and tourists, using vivid descriptive adjectives.

topics.title: Reading: Tourism
topics.description: Comprehending passages on eco-tourism, cultural heritage, and economic benefits of tourism.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Hospitality, Heritage & Geographical Terms
topics.description: Itinerary, monument, sanctuary, endemic, hospitality, and synonyms/antonyms.

topics.title: Grammar: Passive Voice, Present Perfect & Adjective Order
topics.description: Passive voice in historical descriptions (was carved, has been preserved) and royal order of adjectives.

topics.title: Writing: Descriptive Essays and Tourist Brochures
topics.description: Designing persuasive travel brochures and descriptive essays on Ethiopian landmarks.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Honey Processing

topics.title: Listening: Honey Processing
topics.description: Following sequential stages of apiculture, hive management, and honey extraction.

topics.title: Speaking: Describing Processes and Procedures
topics.description: Using sequence markers (firstly, next, subsequently, finally) to explain agricultural processes.

topics.title: Reading: The Importance of Honey
topics.description: Nutritional, medicinal, and export value of Ethiopian honey and beeswax.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Apiculture, Processing & Commercial Terms
topics.description: Apiary, nectar, pollination, centrifugal extractor, filtration, organic export.

topics.title: Grammar: Process Passive, Imperatives & Quantifiers
topics.description: Present simple passive for manufacturing processes (is harvested, is filtered, is bottled) and quantifiers.

topics.title: Writing: Process Description Paragraphs
topics.description: Writing clear step-by-step procedural reports from flowcharts.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Migration

topics.title: Listening: Causes and Consequences of Migration
topics.description: Listening to testimonies and reports on internal and international migration.

topics.title: Speaking: Debating Migration Issues
topics.description: Discussing push and pull factors, brain drain, and risks of irregular migration.

topics.title: Reading: Migration in Ethiopia
topics.description: Critical reading on rural-to-urban migration, youth employment, and safe migration.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Demography, Mobility & Socio-Economic Terms
topics.description: Emigration, immigration, remittance, diaspora, asylum, human trafficking, reintegration.

topics.title: Grammar: Tense Review, Clauses of Cause/Effect & Concession
topics.description: Past perfect, present perfect continuous, because of/due to/consequently, although/despite.

topics.title: Writing: Cause-and-Effect and Argumentative Essays
topics.description: Structuring cause-and-effect essays with thesis statements and supporting evidence.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 7: Branding Ethiopia and National Identity
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 7: Branding Ethiopia and National Identity

topics.title: Listening: National Image and Cultural Diplomacy
topics.description: Comprehending talks on nation branding, coffee origin, athletics, and heritage.

topics.title: Speaking: Promoting National Values and Unity
topics.description: Delivering persuasive speeches on Ethiopia's contributions to world civilization.

topics.title: Reading: Branding Ethiopia and National Identity
topics.description: Analyzing texts on national symbols, cultural diversity, and global perception.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Identity, Diplomacy, Heritage & Branding
topics.description: Sovereignty, cradle of humanity, prestige, ambassador, indigenous, resilience.

topics.title: Grammar: Reported Speech, Relative Clauses & Modals
topics.description: Reporting statements, questions, and commands; defining and non-defining relative clauses.

topics.title: Writing: Persuasive Essays and Formal Speeches
topics.description: Writing patriotic and analytical essays promoting Ethiopia's natural and cultural wealth.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 8: The Healing Power of Plants
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 8: The Healing Power of Plants

topics.title: Listening: Herbal Medicine and Ethnobotany
topics.description: Listening to scientific discussions on medicinal plants and pharmacology.

topics.title: Speaking: Discussing Traditional vs Modern Medicine
topics.description: Comparing herbal remedies and modern pharmaceuticals using contrast markers.

topics.title: Reading: A Traditional Medicine, Moringa Oleifera
topics.description: Reading scientific profiles of Moringa oleifera (Shiferaw), Endod, Damakese, and Kosso.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Botany, Pharmacology & Healthcare
topics.description: Phytochemicals, antioxidant, dosage, infusion, biodiversity, clinical efficacy.

topics.title: Grammar: Zero/First/Second Conditionals & Passive Voice
topics.description: Scientific conditionals, modal passive (can be extracted, should be boiled), and participial phrases.

topics.title: Writing: Expository Research Reports on Medicinal Plants
topics.description: Writing structured informational reports on indigenous Ethiopian medicinal plants.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 9: Multilingualism

topics.title: Listening: Multilingualism
topics.description: Understanding lectures on linguistic diversity and mother-tongue education.

topics.title: Speaking: Sharing Language Learning Experiences
topics.description: Discussing strategies for mastering multiple languages and intercultural communication.

topics.title: Reading: Cognitive Benefits of Being Multilingual
topics.description: Analyzing research on how bilingualism/multilingualism enhances executive brain function and empathy.

topics.title: Writing: Formal and Informal Letter Writing
topics.description: Conventions, layout, salutations, body, and sign-offs of formal business letters and informal letters.

topics.title: Grammar: Wishes, Third Conditional & Conjunctions
topics.description: Expressing regrets and wishes (I wish I spoke..., If I had learned...), correlative conjunctions (both...and, not only...but also).

topics.title: Vocabulary: Linguistics, Cognition & Communication
topics.description: Polyglot, bilingual, lingua franca, mother tongue, dialect, cognitive flexibility.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 10: Digital Vs Satellite Television

topics.title: Listening: Broadcasting Technologies
topics.description: Listening to technical comparisons of terrestrial digital broadcasting and satellite television.

topics.title: Speaking: Comparing Media Platforms
topics.description: Debating the educational and entertainment impacts of digital media vs satellite TV.

topics.title: Reading: Digital Vs Satellite Television
topics.description: Comprehending texts on signal transmission, bandwidth, HD resolution, and media literacy.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Telecommunications, Broadcasting & Media
topics.description: Transponder, dish antenna, set-top box, fiber optics, streaming, encryption, bandwidth.

topics.title: Grammar: Comparative/Contrastive Structures & Future Tenses
topics.description: Whereas, while, in contrast to, on the other hand; future continuous and future perfect tenses.

topics.title: Writing: Compare-and-Contrast Essays
topics.description: Block method and point-by-point organization for compare-and-contrast essays.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Relations and Functions

topics.title: Relations, Domain and Range
topics.description: Ordered pairs, Cartesian products, coordinate graphs, domain and range algebraic determination.

topics.title: Inverse Relations and Graphical Reflection
topics.description: Reflection across line y = x, swapping coordinates, and domain/range interchange.

topics.title: Types of Functions: Injective, Surjective, Bijective
topics.description: Horizontal line test, one-to-one (injective), onto (surjective), bijective mappings, and signum/step functions.

topics.title: Composition of Functions
topics.description: Composite function (f o g)(x) = f(g(x)), domain restrictions of composite functions, and non-commutativity.

topics.title: Inverse Functions and Their Graphs
topics.description: Condition for invertibility (bijectivity), finding algebraic formula for f^-1(x), and graphical symmetry.

topics.title: Applications of Relations and Functions
topics.description: Mathematical modeling of economic supply/demand, population growth curves, and physical trajectories.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 2: Rational Expressions and Rational Functions
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Rational Expressions and Rational Functions

topics.title: Rational Expressions: Simplification and Operations
topics.description: Simplification, domain exclusions, addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of polynomial fractions.

topics.title: Rational Equations and Rational Inequalities
topics.description: Clearing denominators, extraneous solutions, sign tables (critical value intervals) for solving inequalities.

topics.title: Rational Functions, Asymptotes and Graphs
topics.description: Vertical asymptotes, horizontal asymptotes, oblique (slant) asymptotes, holes (removable discontinuities), and intercepts.

topics.title: Applications of Rational Functions
topics.description: Rate-of-work problems, mixture concentration models, average cost functions, and distance-rate-time systems.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Matrices

topics.title: Concepts of a Matrix and Matrix Notations
topics.description: Dimensions (rows x columns), entries, row vectors, column vectors, square matrices, and equality of matrices.

topics.title: Matrix Operations: Addition, Scalar & Multiplication
topics.description: Commutative/associative properties of addition, scalar distribution, row-column dot product multiplication criteria.

topics.title: Special Types of Matrices and Transpose
topics.description: Identity matrix, zero matrix, diagonal matrix, symmetric matrix, skew-symmetric matrix, and transpose rules.

topics.title: Elementary Row Operations and Gaussian Elimination
topics.description: Row swapping, scalar multiplication of rows, row replacement, and reducing to row-echelon form.

topics.title: Systems of Linear Equations with Two and Three Variables
topics.description: Augmented matrices, consistent vs. inconsistent systems, unique solutions, infinitely many solutions, and geometric interpretation.

topics.title: Inverse of a Square Matrix and Matrix Equations
topics.description: Invertibility condition, Gauss-Jordan elimination [A | I] -> [I | A^-1], and solving AX = B via X = A^-1 B.

topics.title: Applications of Matrices in Networks and Business
topics.description: Input-output Leontief economic models, network communication graphs, inventory tracking, and cryptography.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Determinants and Their Properties

topics.title: Determinants of 2x2 Matrices
topics.description: Formula det(A) = ad - bc, geometric interpretation as signed area of parallelogram formed by row vectors.

topics.title: Minors, Cofactors and Expansion of 3x3 Determinants
topics.description: Minor Mij, cofactor Cij = (-1)^(i+j) Mij, and Laplace cofactor expansion along any chosen row or column.

topics.title: Properties of Determinants
topics.description: det(AB) = det(A)det(B), effect of row operations on determinants, det(A^T) = det(A), and zero determinant criteria.

topics.title: Adjoint Matrix and Inverse Calculation
topics.description: Cofactor matrix, classical adjoint adj(A) = C^T, and inversion formula A^-1 = (1/det(A)) adj(A).

topics.title: Cramer Rule for Linear Systems
topics.description: Determinant quotient formula xi = det(Ai)/det(A) for non-singular square systems and solvability checks.

topics.title: Applications of Determinants in Geometry
topics.description: Area of triangles via coordinates, collinearity test of three points, and equation of lines through two points.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Vectors

topics.title: Revision on Vectors and Scalars
topics.description: Directed line segments, magnitude ||v||, direction angle, position vectors, and zero vector.

topics.title: Algebraic Representation and Operations in R2 and R3
topics.description: Component form (x, y, z), unit base vectors i, j, k, scalar multiplication, and vector linear combinations.

topics.title: Dot (Scalar) Product and Projections
topics.description: u · v = ||u||||v||cos(theta), angle between vectors, orthogonality conditions, scalar projection and vector projection.

topics.title: Cross (Vector) Product in R3
topics.description: Determinant formulation for cross product, right-hand rule, perpendicularity to both operand vectors, and parallel tests.

topics.title: Applications of Dot and Cross Products
topics.description: Work done, torque, area of parallelogram, area of triangle, and volume of parallelepiped via scalar triple product.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Transformations of the Plane

topics.title: Introduction to Isometries and Rigid Motions
topics.description: Preservation of distance, angle measures, and collinearity in plane geometric transformations.

topics.title: Translations: Vector Formulation and Coordinate Rules
topics.description: T_v(x, y) = (x + a, y + b), composition of translations, and matrix representation.

topics.title: Reflections Across Lines
topics.description: Reflection across x-axis, y-axis, lines y = x, y = -x, and general line ax + by + c = 0.

topics.title: Rotations About the Origin and General Centers
topics.description: Rotation matrices for angles 90, 180, 270, and general theta; center of rotation and clockwise vs counterclockwise.

topics.title: Dilations (Homothety) and Composite Transformations
topics.description: Scale factors, similarity vs. congruence, matrix multiplication for composite mappings, and computer graphics uses.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 7: Statistics

topics.title: Types of Data and Grouped Frequency Distributions
topics.description: Qualitative vs. quantitative data, continuous vs. discrete variables, class intervals, boundaries, and midpoints.

topics.title: Graphical Representation of Grouped Data
topics.description: Frequency histograms, frequency polygons, relative frequency curves, and cumulative frequency ogives.

topics.title: Measures of Central Tendency for Grouped Data
topics.description: Mean via assumed mean method, median formula L + ((N/2 - CF)/f)w, and mode formula L + (d1/(d1 + d2))w.

topics.title: Measures of Dispersion: Variance and Standard Deviation
topics.description: Range, mean absolute deviation, sample/population variance, standard deviation, and coefficient of variation.

topics.title: Real-Life Statistical Applications and Misrepresentations
topics.description: Interpreting national economic data, health survey indices, skewness, and detecting misleading graphical axes.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 8: Probability

topics.title: Fundamental Principle of Counting
topics.description: Multiplication principle, addition principle, tree diagrams, and systematic listing of sample spaces.

topics.title: Permutations and Combinations
topics.description: Factorial notation, linear permutations nPr = n!/(n-r)!, circular permutations, identical item permutations, and combinations nCr.

topics.title: The Binomial Theorem
topics.description: Pascal triangle, binomial expansion formula (a + b)^n = sum(nCr a^(n-r) b^r), and finding specific general terms.

topics.title: Random Experiments, Sample Spaces and Events
topics.description: Sample spaces, mutually exclusive events, independent events, complementary events, and union/intersection Venn diagrams.

topics.title: Probability Axioms and Addition Rules
topics.description: P(A U B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A n B), complementary probability P(A') = 1 - P(A), and odds for/against.

topics.title: Conditional Probability and Multiplication Rule
topics.description: P(A|B) = P(A n B)/P(B), test for statistical independence P(A n B) = P(A)P(B), and two-stage tree diagrams.

topics.title: Real-Life Applications of Probability
topics.description: Quality control defect sampling, genetic cross probabilities, medical diagnostic predictive values, and insurance risk.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Physics and Human Society

topics.title: Importance of Physics to Society
topics.description: Role of physics in transportation, telecommunication, medicine, energy production, and industrial automation.

topics.title: Physics Communities and Their Roles
topics.description: National and international professional physical societies, scientific publishing, peer review, and ethics in research.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Vectors

topics.title: Vector Representation and Coordinate Systems
topics.description: Cartesian vs. polar coordinates, unit vector notation (i, j, k), magnitude, and directional cosines.

topics.title: Vector Addition and Subtraction in 2D & 3D
topics.description: Triangle law, parallelogram law, polygon method, and analytical algebraic component resolution.

topics.title: Scalar (Dot) Product and Applications
topics.description: A · B = |A||B|cos(theta), work done calculations, orthogonality tests, and vector projections.

topics.title: Vector (Cross) Product and Applications
topics.description: A x B = |A||B|sin(theta) n, right-hand rule, torque formulation, and area of parallelograms and triangles.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 3: Motion in One and Two Dimensions
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Motion in One and Two Dimensions

topics.title: Kinematics in One Dimension and Calculus Approach
topics.description: Instantaneous velocity and acceleration as derivatives, kinematic integration, and free fall under gravity.

topics.title: Graphical Analysis of Non-Uniform Motion
topics.description: Slopes and areas under s-t, v-t, and a-t curves; jerk and physical interpretations of kinematic graphs.

topics.title: Projectile Motion in Two Dimensions
topics.description: Independent horizontal and vertical motions, trajectory equation, time of flight, maximum height, and horizontal range.

topics.title: Uniform Circular Motion and Centripetal Acceleration
topics.description: Angular displacement, angular velocity, tangential velocity, centripetal acceleration (ac = v^2/r), and period/frequency.

topics.title: Relative Velocity in Two Dimensions
topics.description: Vector addition of relative frames (v_AB = v_A - v_B), river-boat crossing problems, and wind-aircraft navigation.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Dynamics

topics.title: Newton Laws of Motion and Free-Body Diagrams
topics.description: Inertia, F_net = ma in component form, action-reaction pairs, normal force, tension, and inclined planes.

topics.title: Frictional Forces and Applications
topics.description: Static vs. kinetic friction coefficients, angle of repose, rolling resistance, and banking of road curves.

topics.title: Work, Kinetic Energy and Work-Energy Theorem
topics.description: Work done by constant and variable forces, kinetic energy (0.5mv^2), and W_net = dKE.

topics.title: Conservative Forces and Potential Energy
topics.description: Gravitational and elastic potential energy, mechanical energy conservation, and non-conservative dissipation.

topics.title: Linear Momentum, Impulse and Collisions
topics.description: Impulse-momentum theorem, conservation of linear momentum, elastic vs. inelastic collisions in 1D and 2D.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Heat Conduction and Calorimetry

topics.title: Thermal Equilibrium and Temperature Measurement
topics.description: Zeroth law of thermodynamics, thermal expansion of solids and liquids, bimetallic strips, and anomalous expansion of water.

topics.title: Heat Capacity and Specific Heat Capacity
topics.description: Quantity of heat (Q = mc dT), method of mixtures calorimetry, water equivalent, and conservation of thermal energy.

topics.title: Phase Changes and Latent Heat
topics.description: Latent heat of fusion and vaporization (Q = mL), cooling curves, supercooling, and evaporation mechanisms.

topics.title: Thermal Conduction, Convection and Radiation
topics.description: Fourier law of heat conduction (dQ/dt = -kA dT/dx), Stefan-Boltzmann law of blackbody radiation, and insulation.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Electrostatics and Electric Circuit

topics.title: Coulomb Law and Electric Field Intensity
topics.description: Quantization of charge, Coulomb inverse square law, superposition principle, electric field lines, and flux.

topics.title: Electric Potential and Potential Energy
topics.description: Electric potential difference (V = W/q), equipotential surfaces, uniform field relations (E = -dV/dr), and work in fields.

topics.title: Capacitance and Dielectrics
topics.description: Parallel-plate capacitors (C = eA/d), dielectric constant, energy stored in capacitors, and series/parallel combinations.

topics.title: Direct Current (DC) Circuits and Kirchhoff Rules
topics.description: Electromotive force (EMF), internal resistance, Kirchhoff junction and loop rules, and bridge network analysis.

topics.title: Electrical Power, Energy and Domestic Safety
topics.description: Joule heating (P = I^2R = VI), fuse ratings, earthing/grounding, three-pin plugs, and electric shock prevention.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 7: Nuclear Physics

topics.title: Nuclear Composition and Nuclear Forces
topics.description: Protons, neutrons, isotopes, isobars, strong nuclear force properties, nuclear density, and nuclear radius.

topics.title: Mass Defect and Nuclear Binding Energy
topics.description: Einstein mass-energy equivalence (E = mc^2), mass defect dm, binding energy per nucleon curve, and stability.

topics.title: Radioactive Decay and Half-Life Calculations
topics.description: Alpha, beta, and gamma radiation, radioactive decay law (N = N0 e^-lt), half-life (t1/2), and activity (Becquerel).

topics.title: Nuclear Reactions: Fission and Fusion
topics.description: Induced nuclear fission, chain reactions, critical mass, nuclear reactors, and thermonuclear fusion in stars.

topics.title: Radiation Hazards, Protection and Applications
topics.description: Dosimetry (Sieverts), biological radiation damage, radiocarbon dating, medical imaging/radiotherapy, and tracer techniques.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 1: Atomic Structure and Periodic Properties of the Elements
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Atomic Structure and Periodic Properties of the Elements

topics.title: Historical Development and Modern Atomic Theory
topics.description: Dalton postulates, discoveries of electron (Thomson, Millikan), nucleus (Rutherford), and neutron (Chadwick).

topics.title: Subatomic Particles, Atomic Mass, and Isotopes
topics.description: Mass spectrometry, atomic mass unit definitions, isotopic abundance calculations, and nuclear notations.

topics.title: Electromagnetic Radiation, Quantum Theory & Bohr Model
topics.description: Planck constant, photoelectric effect, hydrogen emission spectrum lines (Lyman, Balmer), and Bohr orbits.

topics.title: Quantum Mechanical Model of the Atom
topics.description: De Broglie matter waves, Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle, quantum numbers (n, l, ml, ms), and orbital shapes.

topics.title: Electronic Configurations and Aufbau Principle
topics.description: Pauli Exclusion Principle, Hund rule of maximum multiplicity, orbital diagrams, and anomalies (Cr, Cu).

topics.title: Modern Periodic Table and Periodic Trends
topics.description: Atomic radii, ionic radii, ionization energy trends, electron affinity, and electronegativity scales.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 2: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Geometry
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Geometry

topics.title: Ionic Bonding and Lattice Energy
topics.description: Lewis dot structures, octet rule, Born-Haber thermochemical cycle, and properties of crystalline ionic solids.

topics.title: Covalent Bonding and Lewis Structures
topics.description: Single, double, triple bonds, coordinate covalent bonds, resonance hybrids, and formal charge calculations.

topics.title: VSEPR Theory and Molecular Geometry
topics.description: Electron pair repulsion geometries: linear, trigonal planar, tetrahedral, trigonal bipyramidal, and octahedral.

topics.title: Intermolecular Forces in Covalent Compounds
topics.description: Dipole-dipole interactions, hydrogen bonding, and London dispersion forces influencing melting and boiling points.

topics.title: Metallic Bonding and Crystal Types
topics.description: Electron-sea model, metallic luster, malleability, electrical conductivity, and ionic/molecular/covalent network crystals.

topics.title: Valence Bond (VB) Theory and Hybridization
topics.description: Sigma and pi orbital overlap, sp, sp2, sp3, sp3d, and sp3d2 hybridizations with bond angle derivations.

topics.title: Molecular Orbital (MO) Theory
topics.description: Bonding and antibonding molecular orbitals, bond order calculations, and magnetic behavior of homonuclear diatomics.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Physical States of Matter

topics.title: Kinetic Molecular Theory of Matter
topics.description: Postulates of KMT, microscopic particle dynamics in solids, liquids, and gases, and kinetic temperature.

topics.title: The Gaseous State and Ideal Gas Laws
topics.description: Boyle law, Charles law, Gay-Lussac law, Avogadro law, and the combined Ideal Gas Equation (PV = nRT).

topics.title: Gas Stoichiometry and Dalton Law of Partial Pressures
topics.description: Mole fractions, partial pressures, collection of gases over water, and Graham law of effusion and diffusion.

topics.title: Real Gases and Deviations from Ideal Behavior
topics.description: Intermolecular attractions and finite molecular volume, Van der Waals equation of state.

topics.title: The Liquid State: Viscosity, Surface Tension & Vapor Pressure
topics.description: Dynamic equilibrium, boiling point variations with atmospheric pressure, Clausius-Clapeyron relation.

topics.title: The Solid State and Phase Diagrams
topics.description: Unit cells, packing efficiency, phase changes, heating curves, triple point, and critical point in phase diagrams.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Chemical Kinetics

topics.title: Rate of Chemical Reaction and Rate Expressions
topics.description: Average vs. instantaneous rates, differential rate laws, reaction orders (zero, first, second), and rate constant k.

topics.title: Factors Affecting Reaction Rates
topics.description: Effect of nature of reactants, concentration, surface area, temperature, and catalysts.

topics.title: Collision Theory and Transition State Theory
topics.description: Effective collisions, activation energy (Ea), steric factors, and reaction coordinate energy profiles.

topics.title: The Arrhenius Equation and Reaction Mechanisms
topics.description: Arrhenius plot (ln k vs 1/T), elementary steps, molecularity, and rate-determining step determination.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Chemical Equilibrium

topics.title: Characteristics of Dynamic Chemical Equilibrium
topics.description: Reversibility of reactions, forward and reverse rate equality, and constancy of macroscopic properties.

topics.title: Equilibrium Constant Expressions (Kc and Kp)
topics.description: Law of mass action, relationship between Kc and Kp (Kp = Kc(RT)^dn), and heterogeneous equilibria expressions.

topics.title: Applications of Equilibrium Constants
topics.description: Reaction quotient (Qc) comparisons, predicting reaction direction, and equilibrium concentration ICE tables.

topics.title: Le Chatelier Principle and Equilibrium Shifts
topics.description: Effects of changing concentration, pressure, volume, temperature, and inert gas additions on equilibrium.

topics.title: Industrial Equilibrium Processes in Ethiopia
