topics.description: Haber-Bosch ammonia synthesis and Contact process for sulfuric acid: thermodynamic vs. kinetic optimization.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 6: Some Important Oxygen-Containing Organic Compounds
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Some Important Oxygen-Containing Organic Compounds

topics.title: Alcohols and Ethers: Classification and Properties
topics.description: Primary, secondary, tertiary alcohols, IUPAC nomenclature, hydrogen bonding, dehydration, and ether synthesis.

topics.title: Aldehydes and Ketones: Carbonyl Group Chemistry
topics.description: Structure, nomenclature, oxidation reactions, Tollens and Fehling tests, and nucleophilic addition reactions.

topics.title: Carboxylic Acids: Synthesis and Acidity
topics.description: Carboxyl group resonance stabilization, inductive effects on pKa, esterification, and fatty acid classifications.

topics.title: Esters and Saponification
topics.description: Fischer esterification mechanism, fragrance compounds, alkaline hydrolysis (saponification), and soap making.

topics.title: Fats and Oils: Structure, Hardening & Rancidity
topics.description: Triglyceride structures, saturated vs unsaturated fatty acids, catalytic hydrogenation of oils, and lipid oxidation.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Biology and Technology

topics.title: Nature of Science and Biology
topics.description: Empirical investigation, scientific inquiry, hypothesis testing, and the frontiers of modern biological science.

topics.title: Methods and Tools of Biological Research
topics.description: Microscopy (light and electron), centrifugation, staining, chromatography, and aseptic laboratory techniques.

topics.title: Interdependence of Biology and Technology
topics.description: Biotechnology applications, bioengineering, medical innovations, and bio-industrial manufacturing in Ethiopia.

topics.title: Ethics and Impacts of Biological Advances
topics.description: Bioethics in genetic modification, biosafety, environmental impacts, and ethical research standards.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Animals

topics.title: Characteristics and Diversity of Animals
topics.description: Multicellularity, heterotrophy, symmetry (radial, bilateral), germ layers, and coelom organization.

topics.title: Invertebrates: Structure and Classification
topics.description: Porifera, Cnidaria, Platyhelminthes, Nematoda, Annelida, Mollusca, Arthropoda, and Echinodermata.

topics.title: Vertebrates: Structure and Classification
topics.description: Pisces, Amphibia, Reptilia, Aves, and Mammalia with evolutionary adaptations for terrestrial survival.

topics.title: Reproduction and Development in Animals
topics.description: Asexual vs. sexual reproduction, gametogenesis, fertilization, embryogenesis, and metamorphosis.

topics.title: Economic and Ecological Importance of Animals
topics.description: Pollination, food security, apiculture, sericulture, vectors of disease, and ecosystem regulation in Ethiopia.

topics.title: Animal Behavior
topics.description: Innate behavior (taxes, reflexes, instincts) and learned behavior (habituation, conditioning, imprinting, insight).

topics.title: Homeostasis in Animals
topics.description: Thermoregulation, osmoregulation, blood glucose maintenance, and negative feedback loops.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Enzymes

topics.title: Nature and Chemical Structure of Enzymes
topics.description: Globular protein architecture, active sites, cofactors, coenzymes, and prosthetic groups.

topics.title: Enzyme Nomenclature and Classification
topics.description: Oxidoreductases, transferases, hydrolases, lyases, isomerases, and ligases according to IUBMB.

topics.title: Mechanisms of Enzyme Action
topics.description: Activation energy lowering, Lock-and-Key hypothesis, and Induced Fit model of transition-state stabilization.

topics.title: Factors Affecting Enzyme Activity
topics.description: Substrate concentration, enzyme concentration, temperature, pH, and Michaelis-Menten kinetics.

topics.title: Enzyme Inhibition and Regulation
topics.description: Competitive, non-competitive, allosteric inhibition, and feedback inhibition in metabolic pathways.

topics.title: Industrial and Medical Applications of Enzymes
topics.description: Diagnostic assays, brewing, detergent production, textile processing, and therapeutic enzymes.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Genetics

topics.title: Molecular Basis of Heredity: DNA & RNA
topics.description: Nucleotide composition, double helix structure, Chargaff rules, and RNA variants (mRNA, tRNA, rRNA).

topics.title: DNA Replication, Transcription and Translation
topics.description: Semi-conservative replication, RNA polymerase, genetic code codons, ribosome mechanics, and protein synthesis.

topics.title: Mendelian Genetics and Laws of Inheritance
topics.description: Mendel principles of segregation and independent assortment, monohybrid and dihybrid cross ratios.

topics.title: Non-Mendelian Inheritance Patterns
topics.description: Incomplete dominance, codominance, multiple alleles (ABO blood groups), and polygenic inheritance.

topics.title: Sex Determination and Sex-Linked Inheritance
topics.description: Chromosomal sex determination (XY system), hemophilia, color blindness, and pedigree chart analysis.

topics.title: Mutations and Genetic Disorders
topics.description: Gene mutations (point, frameshift), chromosomal aberrations (aneuploidy, polyploidy), and mutagenic agents.

topics.title: Recombinant DNA Technology & Gene Editing
topics.description: Restriction enzymes, plasmids, PCR, DNA fingerprinting, transgenic crops, and CRISPR-Cas9 overview.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: The Human Body Systems

topics.title: Nervous Coordination and Sense Organs
topics.description: Neuron anatomy, action potential conduction, synaptic transmission, CNS, PNS, and eye/ear sensory reception.

topics.title: The Endocrine System and Hormonal Control
topics.description: Major endocrine glands (pituitary, thyroid, adrenal, pancreas), hormone feedback loops, and disorders.

topics.title: Musculoskeletal System and Biomechanics
topics.description: Skeletal framework, bone remodeling, joint classifications, and sliding filament theory of muscle contraction.

topics.title: Human Reproductive Anatomy and Endocrinology
topics.description: Male and female reproductive organs, menstrual cycle hormones, gametogenesis, and contraception methods.

topics.title: Human Development and Teratogens
topics.description: Embryonic cleavage, organogenesis, placental physiology, lactation, and teratogenic risks during pregnancy.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Population and Natural Resources

topics.title: Population Dynamics and Growth Models
topics.description: Natality, mortality, immigration, emigration, exponential growth vs. logistic sigmoid curves, and carrying capacity.

topics.title: Human Population Trends and Demography
topics.description: Age-sex population pyramids, demographic transition model, and population pressure on Ethiopian resources.

topics.title: Renewable and Non-Renewable Resources in Ethiopia
topics.description: Hydropower, solar, geothermal, mineral deposits, forests, soil, and wildlife biodiversity conservation.

topics.title: Environmental Degradation and Climate Resilience
topics.description: Deforestation, soil erosion, desertification, Green Legacy Initiative, water management, and sustainable development.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Environmental Hazards

topics.title: Listening: Natural and Anthropogenic Environmental Hazards
topics.description: Identifying main ideas, acoustic discrimination, note-taking strategies, and hazard classifications.

topics.title: Speaking: Discussing Disaster Preparedness in Ethiopian Regions
topics.description: Expressing viewpoints, modal certainty, group deliberation, and formal presentation conventions.

topics.title: Reading: Drought, Deforestation and Ecological Balance
topics.description: Skimming, scanning, contextual lexical inference, cause-and-effect rhetorical patterns, and critical analysis.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Environmental Science & Climatology Terminology
topics.description: Affixes, environmental collocation pairs, register distinctions, and idiomatic ecological phrases.

topics.title: Grammar: Present Perfect vs. Past Simple in Environmental Reports
topics.description: Aspectual contrasts, time adverbials (since, for, already, recently), and active-passive environmental constructions.

topics.title: Writing: Cause-and-Effect Analytical Paragraphs
topics.description: Causal linkers (consequently, due to, as a result of), topic sentences, evidentiary elaboration, and concluding remarks.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Civilization

topics.title: Listening: Ancient Civilizations and Ethiopian Archaeological Heritage
topics.description: Axumite kingdom, Lalibela rock-hewn architecture, historical chronology, and audio note extraction.

topics.title: Speaking: Debating Attributes of Ancient and Modern Societies
topics.description: Persuasive rhetoric, formal refutations, turn-taking markers, and consensus negotiation.

topics.title: Reading: Evolutionary Trajectory of Agrarian and Urban Settlements
topics.description: Textual cohesion, pronoun referencing, identifying author perspective, and synthesis across historical passages.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Historiography, Architecture & Civil Administration
topics.description: Domain-specific vocabulary, archaic vs modern linguistic shifts, and structural word formation.

topics.title: Grammar: Past Perfect and Past Continuous Narrative Tenses
topics.description: Time sequencers (prior to, by the time, while), narrative progression, and reported speech transformations.

topics.title: Writing: Chronological Historical Expositions
topics.description: Timeline connectors, transitional coherence, paragraph organization, and thesis statement formulation.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 3: Causes of Road Traffic Accidents
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Causes of Road Traffic Accidents

topics.title: Listening: Traffic Safety and Road Statistics in Ethiopia
topics.description: Statistical data interpretation from speech, identifying warning signs, and synthesizing auditory facts.

topics.title: Speaking: Proposing Community Interventions for Road Safety
topics.description: Giving recommendations (should, ought to, must), asking clarifying questions, and cooperative problem-solving.

topics.title: Reading: Behavioral, Mechanical and Infrastructural Risk Factors
topics.description: Categorization of risk variables, identifying logical fallacies, and comparative reading analysis.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Vehicular Dynamics, Highway Codes & Emergency Response
topics.description: Traffic regulation terminology, phrasal verbs related to travel and transit, and emergency jargon.

topics.title: Grammar: Modal Verbs of Obligation, Prohibition & Advice
topics.description: Must, mustn't, have to, need to, should, had better; degrees of prescriptive force and formal legal discourse.

topics.title: Writing: Problem-Solution Proposals for Municipal Transit
topics.description: Executive proposal format, problem statement, feasible interventions, budget/resource justification, and call to action.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: People and Natural Resources

topics.title: Listening: Sustainable Resource Management Practices
topics.description: Comprehending lectures on resource depletion, note-taking in outline format, and speaker tone detection.

topics.title: Speaking: Role-Playing Stakeholder Summits on Land and Water
topics.description: Diplomatic discourse registers, conditional concessions (provided that, as long as), and active listening.

topics.title: Reading: Indigenous Conservation Systems and Forest Stewardship
topics.description: Sacred groves in Ethiopia, community pasture management, and analytical reading of socio-ecological texts.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Agronomy, Biodiversity & Ecological Sustainability
topics.description: Compound nouns, antonyms and synonyms in resource science, and formal expository terms.

topics.title: Grammar: Conditionals (Zero, First, Second, and Third Conditionals)
topics.description: Real vs hypothetical conditions, unreal past regrets (If + had + V3, would have + V3), and inverted conditionals.

topics.title: Writing: Evaluative Essays on Resource Exploitation vs Conservation
topics.description: Balanced argument essay structure, integrating counterarguments, conceding opposing points, and synthesizing conclusions.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Irrigation

topics.title: Listening: Engineering Agricultural Water Systems
topics.description: Following sequential instructions, identifying technical hydraulic terminology, and diagram labeling.

topics.title: Speaking: Explaining Drip vs Flood Irrigation Methodologies
topics.description: Comparative discourse markers (whereas, in contrast, similarly), clarifying technical concepts, and audience pacing.

topics.title: Reading: River Basin Development in Ethiopia (Awash, Omo, Nile)
topics.description: Reading technical schematics, distinguishing between direct observations and inferences in hydro-development.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Hydrology, Agronomy & Soil Salinization
topics.description: Technical agrarian terminology, water distribution vocabularies, and prefix/suffix analysis.

topics.title: Grammar: Passive Voice in Scientific and Technical Descriptions
topics.description: Agent omission for objectivity, passive with modals (must be maintained), and process description flow.

topics.title: Writing: Technical Process Descriptions and Field Reports
topics.description: Sequential connectors (initially, subsequently, simultaneously), objective passive register, and clear flow diagrams.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Global Warming

topics.title: Listening: Climate Science and Greenhouse Gas Emissions
topics.description: Atmospheric physics summaries, identifying speaker bias, and noting numerical statistical trends.

topics.title: Speaking: Delivering Persuasive Speeches on Carbon Reduction
topics.description: Rhetorical questions, emotive vs objective registers, vocal projection, and audience engagement.

topics.title: Reading: Impacts of Global Warming on Sub-Saharan Ecosystems
topics.description: Analyzing complex academic prose, synthesizing disparate paragraphs, and evaluating evidentiary strength.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Climatology, Renewable Energy & Carbon Sequestration
topics.description: Carbon footprints, greenhouse gases, mitigation terminology, and academic collocations.

topics.title: Grammar: Adverbial Clauses of Contrast, Reason and Purpose
topics.description: Although, even though, whereas, in spite of, so that, in order to; sentence combining and punctuation rules.

topics.title: Writing: Persuasive Argumentative Essays on Climate Action
topics.description: Clear thesis statement, body paragraphs with topic sentences and evidence, refutation of counterarguments, and strong conclusion.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 7: Patriotism

topics.title: Listening: Civic Responsibility and National Unity in Ethiopia
topics.description: Comprehending historical speeches, distinguishing patriotism from chauvinism, and thematic analysis.

topics.title: Speaking: Presenting on Heroes and Contributions of Ethiopian Citizens
topics.description: Narrative presentation skills, expressive intonation, and moderating classroom panel discussions.

topics.title: Reading: Civic Virtues, Rule of Law, and Community Development
topics.description: Textual interpretation of civic texts, ethical reasoning, and evaluating moral choices presented in stories.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Civic Institutions, Constitutional Rights & Patriotism
topics.description: Constitutional terminology, civic duty phrases, abstract ethical nouns, and antonym pairs.

topics.title: Grammar: Relative Clauses (Defining and Non-Defining)
topics.description: Who, whom, whose, which, that; essential vs non-essential information, comma conventions, and pronoun omission.

topics.title: Writing: Reflective Essays on Personal Contribution to Society
topics.description: First-person reflective style, balancing personal anecdotes with broader civic analysis, and polished rhetoric.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 8: Efficiency of Health Services

topics.title: Listening: Healthcare Delivery and Primary Care Systems
topics.description: Clinical audio dialogues, recognizing patient-physician interactions, and identifying diagnostic steps.

topics.title: Speaking: Formulating Inquiries and Interviewing Medical Personnel
topics.description: Polite questioning techniques (Could you clarify...), indirect questions, and respectful professional registers.

topics.title: Reading: Health Extension Programs and Rural Clinics in Ethiopia
topics.description: Understanding administrative public health literature, analyzing healthcare equity, and statistical infographics.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Medical Terminology, Epidemiology & Public Health
topics.description: Symptom descriptions, therapeutic treatments, pharmacological terms, and healthcare policy vocabulary.

topics.title: Grammar: Reported Speech in Medical Diagnostics and Interviews
topics.description: Backshifting tenses, changes in pronouns/time markers, reporting verbs (advised, warned, inquired, insisted).

topics.title: Writing: Formal Healthcare Appraisal and Evaluation Reports
topics.description: Administrative report structure, executive summary, methodology, findings, and formal policy recommendations.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 9: Indigenous Conflict Resolution

topics.title: Listening: Traditional Justice Mechanisms (Gadaa, Shimgellina)
topics.description: Oral history traditions, identifying cultural mediation steps, and listening for consensus-building nuances.

topics.title: Speaking: Simulating Traditional Reconciliation Assemblies
topics.description: Mediation discourse, consensus building, non-adversarial framing, and customary respectful addresses.

topics.title: Reading: Comparative Analysis of Customary and Formal Courts
topics.description: Restorative vs retributive justice paradigms, identifying sociological arguments, and critical synthesis.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Customary Law, Restorative Justice & Mediation
topics.description: Jurisprudential concepts, arbitration vocabularies, idiomatic peace-making metaphors, and legal registers.

topics.title: Grammar: Subjunctive Mood, Wish, and Hypothetical Inversions
topics.description: It is essential that he be present; Had the elders not intervened...; expressing solemn formal recommendations.

topics.title: Writing: Comparative Synthesis Papers on Justice Paradigms
topics.description: Point-by-point vs block comparison formats, comparative transitions, and objective academic conclusions.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 10: Artificial Intelligence

topics.title: Listening: Machine Learning, Automation and Societal Futures
topics.description: Tech podcasts, distinguishing algorithmic hype from reality, and noting predictions on employment.

topics.title: Speaking: Debating the Ethics and Boundaries of AI Systems
topics.description: Parliamentary debate conventions, rebuttal techniques, cross-examination, and framing ethical dilemmas.

topics.title: Reading: Natural Language Processing and Computer Vision Applications
topics.description: Comprehending computer science literature, identifying technical metaphors, and assessing AI in Ethiopia.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Computer Science, Algorithms & Data Ethics
topics.description: Neural networks, training models, algorithmic bias, generative AI, and cybersecurity lexicon.

topics.title: Grammar: Advanced Cohesive Devices and Discourse Markers
topics.description: Furthermore, notwithstanding, in light of, conversely; complex sentence punctuation and academic cohesion.

topics.title: Writing: Forward-Looking Analytical Essays on Technological Impact
topics.description: Synthesizing technical evidence, balancing opportunity and peril, and formulating well-substantiated forecasts.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Thermodynamics and Heat Engines

topics.title: Zeroth and First Laws of Thermodynamics
topics.description: Thermal equilibrium and temperature concept (Zeroth law); Internal energy U, heat Q, and work done W; First law ΔU = Q - W; Thermodynamic processes: Isochoric (W = 0), Isobaric (W = PΔV), Isothermal (ΔU = 0, Q = W), Adiabatic (Q = 0, ΔU = -W).

topics.title: Molar Heat Capacities and Ideal Gas Work
topics.description: Molar heat capacity at constant volume Cv and constant pressure Cp; Mayer's relation Cp - Cv = R; adiabatic index γ = Cp/Cv; PV diagram work calculation W = area under PV curve.

topics.title: Second Law of Thermodynamics and Entropy
topics.description: Kelvin-Planck statement (no heat engine can convert 100% of absorbed heat into work); Clausius statement (heat cannot spontaneously flow from cold to hot reservoir); Entropy S as measure of disorder, ΔS ≥ 0 for isolated systems.

topics.title: Heat Engines, Refrigerators and the Carnot Cycle
topics.description: Cyclic heat engines, thermal efficiency η = W/Q_H = 1 - Q_C/Q_H; Carnot cycle (two isothermal, two adiabatic processes); maximum Carnot efficiency η_Carnot = 1 - T_C/T_H; Coefficient of Performance (COP) of refrigerators.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Electric Fields and Potential

topics.title: Coulomb's Law and Electric Field Distribution
topics.description: Quantization and conservation of electric charge; Coulomb's inverse-square law F = k|q1q2|/r^2 in vacuum and dielectric media; Electric field vector E = F/q0; Principle of superposition for discrete and continuous charge distributions.

topics.title: Electric Potential Energy and Electric Potential
topics.description: Electrostatic work and potential energy U = kq1q2/r; Electric potential V = U/q0 = kQ/r; Potential difference ΔV = -∫ E·dl; Equipotential surfaces and relationship E = -dV/dr.

topics.title: Capacitance and Dielectrics
topics.description: Definition of capacitance C = Q/V; Parallel plate capacitor formula C = ε0·A/d; Effect of dielectric constant κ (C = κC0); Series and parallel combinations of capacitors; Energy stored in electrostatic field U = 1/2 CV^2.

topics.title: Motion of Charged Particles in Uniform Electric Fields
topics.description: Trajectory of electron or proton in uniform electric field (parabolic motion analogous to projectile kinematics), acceleration a = qE/m, deflection in cathode ray tube (CRT) and mass spectrometers.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 3: Steady Electric Current and Direct Current Circuits
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Steady Electric Current and Direct Current Circuits

topics.title: Electric Current, Drift Velocity and Current Density
topics.description: Microscopic conduction model: free electron density n, drift velocity v_d, electric current I = n·q·A·v_d; Current density J = I/A = σE; Electrical conductivity σ and resistivity ρ = 1/σ.

topics.title: Ohm's Law, Resistance and Temperature Dependence
topics.description: Ohmic vs non-ohmic materials; Resistance formula R = ρL/A; Temperature dependence of resistivity ρ(T) = ρ0[1 + α(T - T0)]; Superconductivity phenomenon at critical temperatures.

topics.title: Electromotive Force, Internal Resistance and Terminal Voltage
topics.description: Ideal vs real voltage sources; Electromotive force (EMF) ε, internal resistance r, terminal voltage V = ε - Ir; Maximum power transfer theorem (R_load = r for P_max).

topics.title: Kirchhoff's Laws and Complex Circuit Networks
topics.description: Kirchhoff's Current Law (KCL - charge conservation at junctions); Kirchhoff's Voltage Law (KVL - energy conservation in closed loops); Sign conventions for resistors and EMF sources; Solving multi-loop bridge networks.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Magnetism and Electromagnetic Induction

topics.title: Magnetic Fields and Magnetic Forces on Charges and Currents
topics.description: Lorentz force on moving charge F = q(v × B) = qvB sin θ; Circular and helical motion of charges in magnetic field (radius r = mv/qB, cyclotron frequency); Magnetic force on current-carrying conductor F = I(L × B) = ILB sin θ.

topics.title: Sources of Magnetic Fields: Biot-Savart and Ampère's Laws
topics.description: Biot-Savart law for magnetic field of current element; Magnetic field around long straight wire B = μ0·I/(2πr); Field at center of circular loop; Field inside an ideal solenoid B = μ0·n·I; Ampère's Circuital Law ∮ B·dl = μ0·I_enc.

topics.title: Faraday's Law and Lenz's Law of Induction
topics.description: Magnetic flux Φ_B = B·A·cos θ; Faraday's induction law ε = -N(dΦ_B/dt); Lenz's law as consequence of conservation of energy (induced current opposes flux change); Motional EMF ε = B·L·v for moving rod.

topics.title: Inductance and Energy in Magnetic Fields
topics.description: Self-inductance L = NΦ/I; Back EMF in inductors ε_L = -L(dI/dt); Mutual inductance M; Magnetic energy stored in inductor U_B = 1/2 L·I^2; Energy density of magnetic field u_B = B^2/(2μ0).

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Alternating Current Circuits

topics.title: Generation of Alternating Current and AC Quantities
topics.description: AC generator principle (rotating coil in uniform B-field); Sinusoidal voltage v(t) = V0 sin(ωt) and current i(t) = I0 sin(ωt - φ); Peak value V0, RMS value V_rms = V0/√2 = 0.707 V0, root-mean-square current I_rms = I0/√2.

topics.title: AC Circuits with Pure R, L, and C Elements
topics.description: Pure resistor (current in phase with voltage); Pure inductor (voltage leads current by 90° or π/2, inductive reactance X_L = ωL = 2πfL); Pure capacitor (current leads voltage by 90°, capacitive reactance X_C = 1/(ωC) = 1/(2πfC)); Phasor diagrams.

topics.title: Series RLC Circuits and Electrical Resonance
topics.description: Impedance Z = √(R^2 + (X_L - X_C)^2); Phase angle tan φ = (X_L - X_C)/R; Resonance condition X_L = X_C giving resonant frequency f0 = 1/(2π√(LC)); Quality factor Q and power factor cos φ = R/Z; Average power P_avg = V_rms·I_rms·cos φ.

topics.title: Electrical Transformers and High-Voltage Power Transmission
topics.description: Principle of mutual induction in iron core; Transformer turns ratio V_s/V_p = N_s/N_p = I_p/I_s; Step-up and step-down transformers; Energy losses (Joule heating, eddy currents, hysteresis); Ethiopia's national power grid (GERD to regional sub-stations).

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Atomic and Nuclear Physics

topics.title: Bohr's Model of the Atom and Atomic Spectra
topics.description: Rutherford alpha scattering experiment; Bohr's quantum postulates (quantized angular momentum L = nh/2π); Energy levels of hydrogen E_n = -13.6/n^2 eV; Rydberg formula 1/λ = R_H (1/n1^2 - 1/n2^2); Spectral series: Lyman (UV), Balmer (visible), Paschen (IR).

topics.title: Photoelectric Effect and Wave-Particle Duality
topics.description: Photoelectric threshold frequency f0, work function Φ; Einstein's photon energy equation E = hf = Φ + KE_max = hf0 + e·V_stop; Failure of classical wave theory; de Broglie wavelength λ = h/p = h/(mv); Wave-particle duality of electrons.

topics.title: Nuclear Structure, Mass Defect and Binding Energy
topics.description: Nucleons (protons and neutrons), atomic number Z, mass number A, isotopes; Strong nuclear force; Mass defect Δm = [Z·m_p + (A-Z)m_n] - M_nucleus; Einstein mass-energy equivalence E = Δm·c^2; Binding energy per nucleon curve (maximum at Fe-56).

topics.title: Radioactivity, Nuclear Reactions, Fission and Fusion
topics.description: Natural radioactivity: Alpha decay (He-4 nucleus), Beta-minus (electron + antineutrino), Beta-plus (positron + neutrino), Gamma decay (high-energy photons); Radioactive decay law N(t) = N0 e^(-λt); Half-life T_1/2 = ln 2 / λ = 0.693/λ; Nuclear fission vs thermonuclear fusion.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Democracy and Democratization

topics.title: The Concept of Democracy and Democratization

topics.title: Definitions and Actors of Democratization Process
topics.description: Roles of political parties, civil society organizations (CSOs), independent media, interest groups, and citizens.

topics.title: Institutionalizing Democracy
topics.description: Democratic institutions: independent electoral board, parliament, independent judiciary, ombudsman, and human rights commission.

topics.title: The Role of Democracy for Social Transformation
topics.description: Promoting social justice, peaceful conflict resolution, inclusive economic development, and equality.

topics.title: Democratic Values
topics.description: Liberty, equality, justice, tolerance, pluralism, popular sovereignty, and rule of law.

topics.title: Aspects of Democracy
topics.description: Social, economic, and political aspects of substantive vs procedural democracy.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 2: Citizens in the Digital Technology Age
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Citizens in the Digital Technology Age

topics.title: Implications of Digital Technology on Citizens
topics.description: How digital media reshapes emotional wellbeing, social relationships, ethical norms, and economic opportunities.

topics.title: The Ethics of Using Digital Technology
topics.description: Netiquette, digital responsibility, respecting intellectual property, data privacy, and truthfulness online.

topics.title: Opportunities of Digital Technology for Young Citizens
topics.description: E-learning, global collaboration, digital entrepreneurship, innovation, and civic participation.

topics.title: Impacts of Unethical Use of Digital Technology on Young Citizens
topics.description: Cyberbullying, online hate speech, misinformation/disinformation, identity theft, and screen addiction.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Understanding Good Governance

topics.title: The Role of Good Governance

topics.title: Challenges for Good Governance
topics.description: Corruption, rent-seeking, nepotism, weak institutional capacity, and lack of public awareness.

topics.title: Impacts of Lack of Good Governance

topics.title: Understanding and Fighting Corruption

topics.description: Humanitarian displacement, destruction of infrastructure, economic collapse, and psychological trauma.

topics.title: The Notion of Peace Building
topics.description: Conflict prevention, peacekeeping, peacemaking, reconciliation, and post-conflict reconstruction.

topics.title: Indigenous Conflict Resolution Mechanisms
topics.description: Ethiopian customary reconciliation institutions: Shimgellina, Jaarsummaa, Abo-Gereb, Mada'a, Yajoka, and Kanchi.

topics.title: The Roles of Indigenous Social Institutions in Ensuring Sustainable Peace
topics.description: Restorative justice, repairing community relationships, elder mediation, and consensus building.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Federalism in Ethiopia

topics.title: The Meaning of Federalism
topics.description: Constitutional division of sovereignty between a central federal government and regional constituent states.

topics.title: Types of Federalism
topics.description: Coming-together vs Holding-together federalism; Dual vs Cooperative federalism; Symmetric vs Asymmetric federalism.

topics.title: Key Features of Federalism
topics.description: Written supreme constitution, division of powers (exclusive, concurrent, residual), bicameralism, and constitutionalumpire (House of Federation).

topics.title: Advantage and Disadvantage of Federalism
topics.description: Accommodating diversity, local self-rule, and administrative proximity vs duplication of costs and jurisdictional disputes.

topics.title: The Roles of Federalism in Accommodating Diversity in Ethiopia
topics.description: Self-rule and shared-rule under the 1995 FDRE Constitution, linguistic/cultural rights, and maintaining national unity.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Human Rights

topics.title: The Concept of Human Right
topics.description: Universal, inalienable, indivisible, and interdependent nature of human rights; generations of rights (civil/political, socio-economic, solidarity).

topics.title: Citizens and State Obligations in Realizing Human Rights
topics.description: State obligations to Respect, Protect, and Fulfill human rights, and citizens' duty to respect the rights of others.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 7: Patriotism

topics.title: The Meaning of Patriotism
topics.description: Devotion to the welfare, constitutional values, and sustainable progress of one's country.

topics.title: Types of Patriotism
topics.description: Traditional (military defense of territorial integrity) vs Modern/Constitutional patriotism (upholding democracy, human rights, tolerance, and development).

topics.title: The Bases of Patriotism
topics.description: Equality of citizens, justice, constitutionalism, shared historical pride, and concern for the common good.

topics.title: The Importance of Patriotism
topics.description: National sovereignty, fighting poverty and corruption, volunteerism, and national cohesion.

topics.title: Duties Expected of Patriots
topics.description: Paying taxes honestly, protecting public property and the environment, defending the constitution, and ethical whistleblowing.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 8: Globalization and Global Issues

topics.title: The Meaning of Globalization
topics.description: Economic, political, technological, and cultural interconnectedness and interdependence across the globe.

topics.title: Advantages and Disadvantages of Globalization
topics.description: Technology transfer, trade expansion, and information access vs cultural erosion, brain drain, and unequal trade terms for developing nations.

topics.title: Fighting the Negative Impact of Globalization
topics.description: Preserving indigenous cultural values, strengthening domestic production, regional integration (AU, AfCFTA), and selective technological adoption.

topics.title: Major Global Issues
topics.description: Climate change, global terrorism, nuclear proliferation, pandemics, refugee crises, and global poverty.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Landforms of Africa

topics.title: Overview of the World's Major Landforms
topics.description: Endogenic (tectonic folding, faulting, volcanism) and exogenic (weathering, erosion, deposition) processes; mountains, plateaus, and plains.

topics.title: Location and Related Features of Africa
topics.description: Astronomical (37°21'N to 34°52'S, 17°33'W to 51°28'E) and relative location of Africa, compactness, coastline, and area (30.37 million km²).

topics.title: Major Landforms of Africa
topics.description: Atlas Mountains, Sahara Desert, Sahel, Sudanian Savanna, African Massif, East African Rift System & Highlands, and Southern Africa Platform (Drakensberg, Kalahari, Namib).

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Climate of Africa

topics.title: Overview of World Climatic Regions and Types
topics.description: Global climate classification schemes (ancient Greek torrid/temperate/frigid and Köppen empirical classification system).

topics.title: Climate Types and Zones of Africa
topics.description: Controls of African climate (latitude/ITCZ, ocean currents, altitude, continentality) and the 7 climate zones: Equatorial, Tropical Wet-and-Dry (Savanna), Semi-arid (Sahel), Hot Desert, Mediterranean, Humid Subtropical, and Highland.

topics.title: Benefits of Climate for Life of People of Africa
topics.description: Solar/wind/hydro energy potential, diverse agro-climatic zones, bimodal rainfall, and wildlife tourism.

topics.title: Climate Change and Its Challenges to Africa's Development Vision
topics.description: Vulnerability of African rain-fed agriculture, recurrent droughts in the Horn and Sahel, desertification, and adaptation/mitigation strategies.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 3: Natural Resource Base of Africa
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Natural Resource Base of Africa

topics.title: Overview of Major Natural Resources of the World
topics.description: Renewable vs non-renewable resources and sustainable resource management.

topics.title: Major Drainage and Water Resources in Africa
topics.description: Major rivers (Nile, Congo, Niger, Zambezi, Orange, Limpopo), Rift Valley & Victoria lakes, swamps (Sudd, Okavango, Chad), and hydro-power dams (GERD, Aswan, Kariba, Inga, Akosombo).

topics.title: Main Types of Soils and Mineral Resources in Africa
topics.description: African soil groups (Ferralsols, Arenosols, Lixisols, Nitisols, Vertisols, Calcisols) and strategic mineral wealth (gold, diamonds, cobalt, platinum, copper, bauxite, petroleum).

topics.title: Major Vegetation and Wildlife of Africa
topics.description: Tropical rainforest, savanna (parkland, acacia, scrub), desert xerophytes, Mediterranean maquis, Afro-montane vegetation, rich megafauna, and conservation challenges (poaching, deforestation).

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Population of Africa

topics.title: Overview of World Population Growth and Size
topics.description: Global demographic growth trends, doubling time, and regional population shares.

topics.title: Africa's Major Demographic Trends
topics.description: High fertility and birth rates, declining mortality, rapid natural increase, infant mortality rate, and life expectancy in Africa.

topics.title: Population Structure
topics.description: Broad-based youthful age-sex pyramid of Africa, high youth dependency ratio, sex ratio, and demographic dividend potential.

topics.title: Distribution and Density of Africa's Population
topics.description: Densely populated regions (Nile Valley, West African coast, East African Highlands) vs sparsely populated deserts and rainforest basins.

topics.title: Urban and Rural Settlement Patterns in Africa
topics.description: Rural agrarian Dominance vs rapid urbanization rate, primate cities, informal settlements, and urban infrastructure.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 5: Major Economic and Cultural Activities of Africa
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Major Economic and Cultural Activities of Africa

topics.title: Overview of Employment Structure in the World
topics.description: Primary, secondary, tertiary, and quaternary economic sectors across developed and developing nations.

topics.title: Major Economic Activities in Africa
topics.description: Subsistence vs plantation agriculture (cocoa, coffee, tea, cotton, palm oil), pastoralism, forestry, fishing, mining, and nascent manufacturing.

topics.title: Possible Solutions to the Problem of Unemployment
topics.description: Youth unemployment in Africa, TVET skill development, entrepreneurship, agro-processing industrialization, and digital jobs.

topics.title: Africa's Agenda 2063 and Its Implications
topics.description: The African Union's 50-year strategic framework ("The Africa We Want"), flagship projects, and AfCFTA continental free trade.

topics.title: Africa's Agenda 2063 Vis-À-Vis Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
topics.description: Alignment between AU Agenda 2063 aspirations and the UN 2030 Sustainable Development Goals.

topics.title: Linguistic and Religious Diversity in Africa
topics.description: Afro-Asiatic, Niger-Congo, Nilo-Saharan, and Khoisan language families; indigenous beliefs, Islam, and Christianity in Africa.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Human – Natural Environment Interactions

topics.title: Overview of Global Population Change
topics.description: Population growth pressures on global land, water, energy, and ecological carrying capacity.

topics.title: Human-Environment Relationship
topics.description: Environmental determinism, possibilism, and human modification of landscapes (overgrazing, deforestation, pollution, irrigation).

topics.title: Indigenous Knowledge in Conservation of Natural Resources in Africa
topics.description: Traditional African agroforestry, Konso terracing, sacred groves, rotational pastoralism, and water harvesting.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 7: Geographic Issues and Public Concerns in Africa
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 7: Geographic Issues and Public Concerns in Africa

topics.title: Unplanned Urbanization
topics.description: Causes and consequences of rapid unplanned urban sprawl: slums, sanitation deficits, traffic congestion, unemployment, and urban planning remedies.

topics.title: Migration – Factors and Impacts on Africa
topics.description: Internal displacement, rural-urban migration, trans-Mediterranean and Red Sea irregular migration routes, brain drain, and remittances.

topics.title: Coastal Pollution in Africa
topics.description: Oil spills (Niger Delta), plastic waste, untreated sewage, industrial effluent, mangrove destruction, and marine ecosystem protection.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 8: Geospatial Information and Data Processing
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 8: Geospatial Information and Data Processing

topics.title: Basic Concepts of Geospatial Information
topics.description: Spatial vs attribute data, georeferencing, coordinates, and importance of geospatial intelligence.

topics.title: Sources and Tools of Geographic Data
topics.description: Field surveys, census, aerial photography, satellite remote sensing, Global Positioning System (GPS), and GIS software.

topics.title: Geographic Data Representations
topics.description: Vector data model (points, lines, polygons) vs Raster data model (grid cells/pixels), qualitative and quantitative thematic maps.

topics.title: Advances in Mapmaking and the Birth of GIS
topics.description: Evolution from manual cartography to digital Geographic Information Systems (hardware, software, data, people, methods) and layer overlay analysis.

topics.title: Making and Interpretation of Graphs, Charts and Diagrams
topics.description: Constructing and analyzing climographs (temperature-rainfall), line graphs, bar graphs, pie charts, and population pyramids.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Organization of Files

topics.title: Unit Overview & File Management
topics.description: File system hierarchy, directories, root folders, subfolders, and operating system file management.

topics.title: Storage Drives
topics.description: Logical drive letters, partitioning, Hard Disk Drives (HDD), Solid State Drives (SSD), optical drives, USB flash drives, and cloud storage.

topics.title: File Name Extension
topics.description: Identifying file types and default applications via extensions (.docx, .pdf, .xlsx, .pptx, .mp3, .mp4, .jpg, .png, .exe, .zip, .html).

topics.title: File Directory Structure
topics.description: Absolute paths vs relative file paths, directory trees, path separators (\ vs /), and navigating folders via GUI and Command Prompt.

topics.title: File Conversion, Importing and Exporting
topics.description: Converting document, image, and media formats (e.g., DOCX to PDF, XLSX to CSV) and importing/exporting data across applications.

topics.title: Saving, Opening, Backup and Recovery
topics.description: Save vs Save As, local and cloud backup strategies (3-2-1 rule), system restore points, and file recovery.

topics.title: File Compression, Deleting and Restoring Files
topics.description: Lossless vs lossy compression, archiving (.zip, .rar), disk space optimization, Recycle Bin restoration, and permanent deletion (Shift+Delete).

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Computer Network

topics.title: Network Media (Transmission Media)
topics.description: Guided (wired) media: UTP/STP twisted-pair (RJ-45), coaxial cable, and fiber-optic cable (single-mode/multi-mode); Unguided (wireless) media: radio waves, microwaves, and infrared.

topics.title: Telecommunications Network
topics.description: Components of telecommunications systems, analog vs digital signals, modulation/demodulation, multiplexing, and bandwidth/throughput.

topics.title: Mobile Communications
topics.description: Principles of wireless mobile communication, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi (IEEE 802.11), hotspots, and mobile computing devices.

topics.title: Cellular Networks
topics.description: Cellular architecture (cells, base transceiver stations, mobile switching centers, handoff) and evolution from 1G, 2G (GSM), 3G, 4G (LTE) to 5G.

topics.title: Satellite Networks
topics.description: Uplink and downlink transponders, Geostationary (GEO), Medium Earth (MEO/GPS), and Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite systems.

topics.title: Internet Protocol (IP) & Data Communications
topics.description: TCP/IP protocol suite, IPv4 (32-bit dotted decimal, classes, public vs private) vs IPv6 (128-bit hexadecimal), subnet mask, DNS, and DHCP.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Application Software

topics.title: Unit Overview
topics.description: Advanced document publishing, data analysis, and visual presentation in office suites.

topics.title: Word Processing
topics.description: Creating and formatting complex tables, inserting pictures/shapes/SmartArt, section breaks, multi-column layouts, automatic Table of Contents (TOC), citations, and Mail Merge.

topics.title: Spreadsheet
topics.description: Relative ($A1), absolute ($A$1), and mixed cell references; advanced functions (IF, COUNTIF, SUMIF, VLOOKUP, RANK, AND, OR); data sorting, filtering, conditional formatting, and charts.

topics.title: PowerPoint Presentation
topics.description: Slide Master customization, action buttons, hyperlinks, embedding audio/video, animation pane timing, rehearsal, and speaker notes.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Image Processing and Multimedia

topics.title: Basics of Multimedia
topics.description: Linear vs non-linear (interactive) multimedia, hypertext vs hypermedia, and hardware/software requirements for multimedia systems.

topics.title: Multimedia File Formats
topics.description: Image (JPEG, PNG, GIF, SVG, PSD, TIFF), Audio (MP3, WAV, AAC, OGG), and Video (MP4, AVI, MKV, MOV, WMV) codecs and containers.

topics.title: Multimedia Production & Authoring Tools
topics.description: Stages of multimedia production (planning, design, production, testing, distribution) and card/page, icon, and time-based authoring tools.

topics.title: Multimedia Editing
topics.description: Image editing (layers, masks, curves, healing brush, clone stamp), audio editing (trimming, noise reduction, mixing), and non-linear video editing (timeline, transitions, chroma key).

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Information and Computer Security

topics.title: Information and Computer Security & Impact on Society
topics.description: National critical infrastructure protection, digital trust, e-banking/e-government security, and societal implications of cyber incidents.

topics.title: Privacy and Security
topics.description: Data privacy vs data security, personally identifiable information (PII), digital footprints, cookies, and data protection rights.

topics.title: Computer Security Threats
topics.description: Advanced malware (ransomware, rootkits, keyloggers, botnets), social engineering (phishing, spear-phishing, pretexting), SQL injection, and Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attacks.

topics.title: Threat Prevention Strategies
topics.description: Technical controls: encryption (symmetric & public-key), firewalls, Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), VPNs, patch management, and biometric access control.

topics.title: Cyber Security
topics.description: Cyber defense frameworks, ethical hacking vs black-hat cracking, incident response, and Ethiopian Computer Crime Proclamation.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Fundamentals of Programming

topics.title: Basics and Definition of Algorithm
topics.description: Role of algorithms in computer science, translating real-world logic into unambiguous computational instructions.

topics.title: Characteristics of Algorithm
topics.description: Finiteness, definiteness (unambiguity), input, output, effectiveness, and generality of a valid algorithm.

topics.title: Algorithm Representation
topics.description: Representing algorithms using structured Pseudocode and standard Flowcharts for sequence, selection (IF-ELSE), and iteration (WHILE, FOR) problems; trace tables.

topics.title: Integrated Development Environment (IDE)
topics.description: Components of an IDE (source code editor, compiler vs interpreter, debugger, build automation, console) and writing/executing basic programs.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Biology and Technology

topics.title: Nature of Science and Biology
topics.description: Empirical investigation, scientific inquiry, hypothesis testing, and the frontiers of modern biological science.

topics.title: Methods and Tools of Biological Research
topics.description: Microscopy (light and electron), centrifugation, staining, chromatography, and aseptic laboratory techniques.

topics.title: Interdependence of Biology and Technology
topics.description: Biotechnology applications, bioengineering, medical innovations, and bio-industrial manufacturing in Ethiopia.

topics.title: Ethics and Impacts of Biological Advances
topics.description: Bioethics in genetic modification, biosafety, environmental impacts, and ethical research standards.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Animals

topics.title: Characteristics and Diversity of Animals
topics.description: Multicellularity, heterotrophy, symmetry (radial, bilateral), germ layers, and coelom organization.

topics.title: Invertebrates: Structure and Classification
topics.description: Porifera, Cnidaria, Platyhelminthes, Nematoda, Annelida, Mollusca, Arthropoda, and Echinodermata.

topics.title: Vertebrates: Structure and Classification
topics.description: Pisces, Amphibia, Reptilia, Aves, and Mammalia with evolutionary adaptations for terrestrial survival.

topics.title: Reproduction and Development in Animals
topics.description: Asexual vs. sexual reproduction, gametogenesis, fertilization, embryogenesis, and metamorphosis.

topics.title: Economic and Ecological Importance of Animals
topics.description: Pollination, food security, apiculture, sericulture, vectors of disease, and ecosystem regulation in Ethiopia.

topics.title: Animal Behavior
topics.description: Innate behavior (taxes, reflexes, instincts) and learned behavior (habituation, conditioning, imprinting, insight).

topics.title: Homeostasis in Animals
topics.description: Thermoregulation, osmoregulation, blood glucose maintenance, and negative feedback loops.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Enzymes

topics.title: Nature and Chemical Structure of Enzymes
topics.description: Globular protein architecture, active sites, cofactors, coenzymes, and prosthetic groups.

topics.title: Enzyme Nomenclature and Classification
topics.description: Oxidoreductases, transferases, hydrolases, lyases, isomerases, and ligases according to IUBMB.

topics.title: Mechanisms of Enzyme Action
topics.description: Activation energy lowering, Lock-and-Key hypothesis, and Induced Fit model of transition-state stabilization.

topics.title: Factors Affecting Enzyme Activity
topics.description: Substrate concentration, enzyme concentration, temperature, pH, and Michaelis-Menten kinetics.

topics.title: Enzyme Inhibition and Regulation
topics.description: Competitive, non-competitive, allosteric inhibition, and feedback inhibition in metabolic pathways.

topics.title: Industrial and Medical Applications of Enzymes
topics.description: Diagnostic assays, brewing, detergent production, textile processing, and therapeutic enzymes.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Genetics

topics.title: Molecular Basis of Heredity: DNA & RNA
topics.description: Nucleotide composition, double helix structure, Chargaff rules, and RNA variants (mRNA, tRNA, rRNA).

topics.title: DNA Replication, Transcription and Translation
topics.description: Semi-conservative replication, RNA polymerase, genetic code codons, ribosome mechanics, and protein synthesis.

topics.title: Mendelian Genetics and Laws of Inheritance
topics.description: Mendel principles of segregation and independent assortment, monohybrid and dihybrid cross ratios.

topics.title: Non-Mendelian Inheritance Patterns
topics.description: Incomplete dominance, codominance, multiple alleles (ABO blood groups), and polygenic inheritance.

topics.title: Sex Determination and Sex-Linked Inheritance
topics.description: Chromosomal sex determination (XY system), hemophilia, color blindness, and pedigree chart analysis.

topics.title: Mutations and Genetic Disorders
topics.description: Gene mutations (point, frameshift), chromosomal aberrations (aneuploidy, polyploidy), and mutagenic agents.

topics.title: Recombinant DNA Technology & Gene Editing
topics.description: Restriction enzymes, plasmids, PCR, DNA fingerprinting, transgenic crops, and CRISPR-Cas9 overview.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: The Human Body Systems

topics.title: Nervous Coordination and Sense Organs
topics.description: Neuron anatomy, action potential conduction, synaptic transmission, CNS, PNS, and eye/ear sensory reception.

topics.title: The Endocrine System and Hormonal Control
topics.description: Major endocrine glands (pituitary, thyroid, adrenal, pancreas), hormone feedback loops, and disorders.

topics.title: Musculoskeletal System and Biomechanics
topics.description: Skeletal framework, bone remodeling, joint classifications, and sliding filament theory of muscle contraction.

topics.title: Human Reproductive Anatomy and Endocrinology
topics.description: Male and female reproductive organs, menstrual cycle hormones, gametogenesis, and contraception methods.

topics.title: Human Development and Teratogens
topics.description: Embryonic cleavage, organogenesis, placental physiology, lactation, and teratogenic risks during pregnancy.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Population and Natural Resources

topics.title: Population Dynamics and Growth Models
topics.description: Natality, mortality, immigration, emigration, exponential growth vs. logistic sigmoid curves, and carrying capacity.

topics.title: Human Population Trends and Demography
topics.description: Age-sex population pyramids, demographic transition model, and population pressure on Ethiopian resources.

topics.title: Renewable and Non-Renewable Resources in Ethiopia
topics.description: Hydropower, solar, geothermal, mineral deposits, forests, soil, and wildlife biodiversity conservation.

topics.title: Environmental Degradation and Climate Resilience
topics.description: Deforestation, soil erosion, desertification, Green Legacy Initiative, water management, and sustainable development.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 1: Atomic Structure and Periodic Properties of the Elements
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Atomic Structure and Periodic Properties of the Elements

topics.title: Historical Development and Modern Atomic Theory
topics.description: Dalton postulates, discoveries of electron (Thomson, Millikan), nucleus (Rutherford), and neutron (Chadwick).

topics.title: Subatomic Particles, Atomic Mass, and Isotopes
topics.description: Mass spectrometry, atomic mass unit definitions, isotopic abundance calculations, and nuclear notations.

topics.title: Electromagnetic Radiation, Quantum Theory & Bohr Model
topics.description: Planck constant, photoelectric effect, hydrogen emission spectrum lines (Lyman, Balmer), and Bohr orbits.

topics.title: Quantum Mechanical Model of the Atom
topics.description: De Broglie matter waves, Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle, quantum numbers (n, l, ml, ms), and orbital shapes.

topics.title: Electronic Configurations and Aufbau Principle
topics.description: Pauli Exclusion Principle, Hund rule of maximum multiplicity, orbital diagrams, and anomalies (Cr, Cu).

topics.title: Modern Periodic Table and Periodic Trends
topics.description: Atomic radii, ionic radii, ionization energy trends, electron affinity, and electronegativity scales.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 2: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Geometry
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Geometry

topics.title: Ionic Bonding and Lattice Energy
topics.description: Lewis dot structures, octet rule, Born-Haber thermochemical cycle, and properties of crystalline ionic solids.

topics.title: Covalent Bonding and Lewis Structures
topics.description: Single, double, triple bonds, coordinate covalent bonds, resonance hybrids, and formal charge calculations.

topics.title: VSEPR Theory and Molecular Geometry
topics.description: Electron pair repulsion geometries: linear, trigonal planar, tetrahedral, trigonal bipyramidal, and octahedral.

topics.title: Intermolecular Forces in Covalent Compounds
topics.description: Dipole-dipole interactions, hydrogen bonding, and London dispersion forces influencing melting and boiling points.

topics.title: Metallic Bonding and Crystal Types
topics.description: Electron-sea model, metallic luster, malleability, electrical conductivity, and ionic/molecular/covalent network crystals.

topics.title: Valence Bond (VB) Theory and Hybridization
topics.description: Sigma and pi orbital overlap, sp, sp2, sp3, sp3d, and sp3d2 hybridizations with bond angle derivations.

topics.title: Molecular Orbital (MO) Theory
topics.description: Bonding and antibonding molecular orbitals, bond order calculations, and magnetic behavior of homonuclear diatomics.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Physical States of Matter

topics.title: Kinetic Molecular Theory of Matter
topics.description: Postulates of KMT, microscopic particle dynamics in solids, liquids, and gases, and kinetic temperature.

topics.title: The Gaseous State and Ideal Gas Laws
topics.description: Boyle law, Charles law, Gay-Lussac law, Avogadro law, and the combined Ideal Gas Equation (PV = nRT).

topics.title: Gas Stoichiometry and Dalton Law of Partial Pressures
topics.description: Mole fractions, partial pressures, collection of gases over water, and Graham law of effusion and diffusion.

topics.title: Real Gases and Deviations from Ideal Behavior
topics.description: Intermolecular attractions and finite molecular volume, Van der Waals equation of state.

topics.title: The Liquid State: Viscosity, Surface Tension & Vapor Pressure
topics.description: Dynamic equilibrium, boiling point variations with atmospheric pressure, Clausius-Clapeyron relation.

topics.title: The Solid State and Phase Diagrams
topics.description: Unit cells, packing efficiency, phase changes, heating curves, triple point, and critical point in phase diagrams.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Chemical Kinetics

topics.title: Rate of Chemical Reaction and Rate Expressions
topics.description: Average vs. instantaneous rates, differential rate laws, reaction orders (zero, first, second), and rate constant k.

topics.title: Factors Affecting Reaction Rates
topics.description: Effect of nature of reactants, concentration, surface area, temperature, and catalysts.

topics.title: Collision Theory and Transition State Theory
topics.description: Effective collisions, activation energy (Ea), steric factors, and reaction coordinate energy profiles.

topics.title: The Arrhenius Equation and Reaction Mechanisms
topics.description: Arrhenius plot (ln k vs 1/T), elementary steps, molecularity, and rate-determining step determination.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Chemical Equilibrium

topics.title: Characteristics of Dynamic Chemical Equilibrium
topics.description: Reversibility of reactions, forward and reverse rate equality, and constancy of macroscopic properties.

topics.title: Equilibrium Constant Expressions (Kc and Kp)
topics.description: Law of mass action, relationship between Kc and Kp (Kp = Kc(RT)^dn), and heterogeneous equilibria expressions.

topics.title: Applications of Equilibrium Constants
topics.description: Reaction quotient (Qc) comparisons, predicting reaction direction, and equilibrium concentration ICE tables.

topics.title: Le Chatelier Principle and Equilibrium Shifts
topics.description: Effects of changing concentration, pressure, volume, temperature, and inert gas additions on equilibrium.

topics.title: Industrial Equilibrium Processes in Ethiopia
topics.description: Haber-Bosch ammonia synthesis and Contact process for sulfuric acid: thermodynamic vs. kinetic optimization.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 6: Some Important Oxygen-Containing Organic Compounds
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Some Important Oxygen-Containing Organic Compounds

topics.title: Alcohols and Ethers: Classification and Properties
topics.description: Primary, secondary, tertiary alcohols, IUPAC nomenclature, hydrogen bonding, dehydration, and ether synthesis.

topics.title: Aldehydes and Ketones: Carbonyl Group Chemistry
topics.description: Structure, nomenclature, oxidation reactions, Tollens and Fehling tests, and nucleophilic addition reactions.

topics.title: Carboxylic Acids: Synthesis and Acidity
topics.description: Carboxyl group resonance stabilization, inductive effects on pKa, esterification, and fatty acid classifications.

topics.title: Esters and Saponification
topics.description: Fischer esterification mechanism, fragrance compounds, alkaline hydrolysis (saponification), and soap making.

topics.title: Fats and Oils: Structure, Hardening & Rancidity
topics.description: Triglyceride structures, saturated vs unsaturated fatty acids, catalytic hydrogenation of oils, and lipid oxidation.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Environmental Hazards

topics.title: Listening: Natural and Anthropogenic Environmental Hazards
topics.description: Identifying main ideas, acoustic discrimination, note-taking strategies, and hazard classifications.

topics.title: Speaking: Discussing Disaster Preparedness in Ethiopian Regions
topics.description: Expressing viewpoints, modal certainty, group deliberation, and formal presentation conventions.

topics.title: Reading: Drought, Deforestation and Ecological Balance
topics.description: Skimming, scanning, contextual lexical inference, cause-and-effect rhetorical patterns, and critical analysis.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Environmental Science & Climatology Terminology
topics.description: Affixes, environmental collocation pairs, register distinctions, and idiomatic ecological phrases.

topics.title: Grammar: Present Perfect vs. Past Simple in Environmental Reports
topics.description: Aspectual contrasts, time adverbials (since, for, already, recently), and active-passive environmental constructions.

topics.title: Writing: Cause-and-Effect Analytical Paragraphs
topics.description: Causal linkers (consequently, due to, as a result of), topic sentences, evidentiary elaboration, and concluding remarks.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Civilization

topics.title: Listening: Ancient Civilizations and Ethiopian Archaeological Heritage
topics.description: Axumite kingdom, Lalibela rock-hewn architecture, historical chronology, and audio note extraction.

topics.title: Vocabulary: Agronomy, Biodiversity & Ecological Sustainability

topics.title: Reading: River Basin Development in Ethiopia (Awash, Omo, Nile)

topics.title: Vocabulary: Hydrology, Agronomy & Soil Salinization

topics.title: Grammar: Passive Voice in Scientific and Technical Descriptions
topics.description: Agent omission for objectivity, passive with modals (must be maintained), and process description flow.

topics.description: Clinical audio dialogues, recognizing patient-physician interactions, and identifying diagnostic steps.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Database Management Systems and Data Modeling

topics.description: Relations, tuples, attributes, primary/foreign/candidate/composite keys, entity integrity, and referential integrity.

topics.description: Cardinality ratios (1:1, 1:M, M:N), eliminating repeating groups, partial dependencies, and transitive dependencies.

topics.description: Zero-based indexing, slicing, mutable lists vs immutable tuples, key-value dictionaries, and string methods.

topics.description: Defining reusable functions, local vs global scope, reading/writing text and CSV files, and try-except blocks.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Relations and Functions

topics.title: Relations, Domain and Range
topics.description: Ordered pairs, Cartesian products, coordinate graphs, domain and range algebraic determination.

topics.title: Inverse Relations and Graphical Reflection
topics.description: Reflection across line y = x, swapping coordinates, and domain/range interchange.

topics.title: Types of Functions: Injective, Surjective, Bijective
topics.description: Horizontal line test, one-to-one (injective), onto (surjective), bijective mappings, and signum/step functions.

topics.title: Composition of Functions
topics.description: Composite function (f o g)(x) = f(g(x)), domain restrictions of composite functions, and non-commutativity.

topics.title: Inverse Functions and Their Graphs
topics.description: Condition for invertibility (bijectivity), finding algebraic formula for f^-1(x), and graphical symmetry.

topics.title: Applications of Relations and Functions
topics.description: Mathematical modeling of economic supply/demand, population growth curves, and physical trajectories.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 2: Rational Expressions and Rational Functions
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Rational Expressions and Rational Functions

topics.title: Rational Expressions: Simplification and Operations
topics.description: Simplification, domain exclusions, addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of polynomial fractions.

topics.title: Rational Equations and Rational Inequalities
topics.description: Clearing denominators, extraneous solutions, sign tables (critical value intervals) for solving inequalities.

topics.title: Rational Functions, Asymptotes and Graphs
topics.description: Vertical asymptotes, horizontal asymptotes, oblique (slant) asymptotes, holes (removable discontinuities), and intercepts.

topics.title: Applications of Rational Functions
topics.description: Rate-of-work problems, mixture concentration models, average cost functions, and distance-rate-time systems.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Matrices

topics.title: Concepts of a Matrix and Matrix Notations
topics.description: Dimensions (rows x columns), entries, row vectors, column vectors, square matrices, and equality of matrices.

topics.title: Matrix Operations: Addition, Scalar & Multiplication
topics.description: Commutative/associative properties of addition, scalar distribution, row-column dot product multiplication criteria.

topics.title: Special Types of Matrices and Transpose
topics.description: Identity matrix, zero matrix, diagonal matrix, symmetric matrix, skew-symmetric matrix, and transpose rules.

topics.title: Elementary Row Operations and Gaussian Elimination
topics.description: Row swapping, scalar multiplication of rows, row replacement, and reducing to row-echelon form.

topics.title: Systems of Linear Equations with Two and Three Variables
topics.description: Augmented matrices, consistent vs. inconsistent systems, unique solutions, infinitely many solutions, and geometric interpretation.

topics.title: Inverse of a Square Matrix and Matrix Equations
topics.description: Invertibility condition, Gauss-Jordan elimination [A | I] -> [I | A^-1], and solving AX = B via X = A^-1 B.

topics.title: Applications of Matrices in Networks and Business
topics.description: Input-output Leontief economic models, network communication graphs, inventory tracking, and cryptography.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Determinants and Their Properties

topics.title: Determinants of 2x2 Matrices
topics.description: Formula det(A) = ad - bc, geometric interpretation as signed area of parallelogram formed by row vectors.

topics.title: Minors, Cofactors and Expansion of 3x3 Determinants
topics.description: Minor Mij, cofactor Cij = (-1)^(i+j) Mij, and Laplace cofactor expansion along any chosen row or column.

topics.title: Properties of Determinants
topics.description: det(AB) = det(A)det(B), effect of row operations on determinants, det(A^T) = det(A), and zero determinant criteria.

topics.title: Adjoint Matrix and Inverse Calculation
topics.description: Cofactor matrix, classical adjoint adj(A) = C^T, and inversion formula A^-1 = (1/det(A)) adj(A).

topics.title: Cramer Rule for Linear Systems
topics.description: Determinant quotient formula xi = det(Ai)/det(A) for non-singular square systems and solvability checks.

topics.title: Applications of Determinants in Geometry
topics.description: Area of triangles via coordinates, collinearity test of three points, and equation of lines through two points.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Vectors

topics.title: Revision on Vectors and Scalars
topics.description: Directed line segments, magnitude ||v||, direction angle, position vectors, and zero vector.

topics.title: Algebraic Representation and Operations in R2 and R3
topics.description: Component form (x, y, z), unit base vectors i, j, k, scalar multiplication, and vector linear combinations.

topics.title: Dot (Scalar) Product and Projections
topics.description: u · v = ||u||||v||cos(theta), angle between vectors, orthogonality conditions, scalar projection and vector projection.

topics.title: Cross (Vector) Product in R3
topics.description: Determinant formulation for cross product, right-hand rule, perpendicularity to both operand vectors, and parallel tests.

topics.title: Applications of Dot and Cross Products
topics.description: Work done, torque, area of parallelogram, area of triangle, and volume of parallelepiped via scalar triple product.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Transformations of the Plane

topics.title: Introduction to Isometries and Rigid Motions
topics.description: Preservation of distance, angle measures, and collinearity in plane geometric transformations.

topics.title: Translations: Vector Formulation and Coordinate Rules
topics.description: T_v(x, y) = (x + a, y + b), composition of translations, and matrix representation.

topics.title: Reflections Across Lines
topics.description: Reflection across x-axis, y-axis, lines y = x, y = -x, and general line ax + by + c = 0.

topics.title: Rotations About the Origin and General Centers
topics.description: Rotation matrices for angles 90, 180, 270, and general theta; center of rotation and clockwise vs counterclockwise.

topics.title: Dilations (Homothety) and Composite Transformations
topics.description: Scale factors, similarity vs. congruence, matrix multiplication for composite mappings, and computer graphics uses.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 7: Statistics

topics.title: Types of Data and Grouped Frequency Distributions
topics.description: Qualitative vs. quantitative data, continuous vs. discrete variables, class intervals, boundaries, and midpoints.

topics.title: Graphical Representation of Grouped Data
topics.description: Frequency histograms, frequency polygons, relative frequency curves, and cumulative frequency ogives.

topics.title: Measures of Central Tendency for Grouped Data
topics.description: Mean via assumed mean method, median formula L + ((N/2 - CF)/f)w, and mode formula L + (d1/(d1 + d2))w.

topics.title: Measures of Dispersion: Variance and Standard Deviation
topics.description: Range, mean absolute deviation, sample/population variance, standard deviation, and coefficient of variation.

topics.title: Real-Life Statistical Applications and Misrepresentations
topics.description: Interpreting national economic data, health survey indices, skewness, and detecting misleading graphical axes.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 8: Probability

topics.title: Fundamental Principle of Counting
topics.description: Multiplication principle, addition principle, tree diagrams, and systematic listing of sample spaces.

topics.title: Permutations and Combinations
topics.description: Factorial notation, linear permutations nPr = n!/(n-r)!, circular permutations, identical item permutations, and combinations nCr.

topics.title: The Binomial Theorem
topics.description: Pascal triangle, binomial expansion formula (a + b)^n = sum(nCr a^(n-r) b^r), and finding specific general terms.

topics.title: Random Experiments, Sample Spaces and Events
topics.description: Sample spaces, mutually exclusive events, independent events, complementary events, and union/intersection Venn diagrams.

topics.title: Probability Axioms and Addition Rules
topics.description: P(A U B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A n B), complementary probability P(A') = 1 - P(A), and odds for/against.

topics.title: Conditional Probability and Multiplication Rule
topics.description: P(A|B) = P(A n B)/P(B), test for statistical independence P(A n B) = P(A)P(B), and two-stage tree diagrams.

topics.title: Real-Life Applications of Probability
topics.description: Quality control defect sampling, genetic cross probabilities, medical diagnostic predictive values, and insurance risk.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Physics and Human Society

topics.title: Importance of Physics to Society
topics.description: Role of physics in transportation, telecommunication, medicine, energy production, and industrial automation.

topics.title: Physics Communities and Their Roles
topics.description: National and international professional physical societies, scientific publishing, peer review, and ethics in research.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Vectors

topics.title: Vector Representation and Coordinate Systems
topics.description: Cartesian vs. polar coordinates, unit vector notation (i, j, k), magnitude, and directional cosines.

topics.title: Vector Addition and Subtraction in 2D & 3D
topics.description: Triangle law, parallelogram law, polygon method, and analytical algebraic component resolution.

topics.title: Scalar (Dot) Product and Applications
topics.description: A · B = |A||B|cos(theta), work done calculations, orthogonality tests, and vector projections.

topics.title: Vector (Cross) Product and Applications
topics.description: A x B = |A||B|sin(theta) n, right-hand rule, torque formulation, and area of parallelograms and triangles.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 3: Motion in One and Two Dimensions
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Motion in One and Two Dimensions

topics.title: Kinematics in One Dimension and Calculus Approach
topics.description: Instantaneous velocity and acceleration as derivatives, kinematic integration, and free fall under gravity.

topics.title: Graphical Analysis of Non-Uniform Motion
topics.description: Slopes and areas under s-t, v-t, and a-t curves; jerk and physical interpretations of kinematic graphs.

topics.title: Projectile Motion in Two Dimensions
topics.description: Independent horizontal and vertical motions, trajectory equation, time of flight, maximum height, and horizontal range.

topics.title: Uniform Circular Motion and Centripetal Acceleration
topics.description: Angular displacement, angular velocity, tangential velocity, centripetal acceleration (ac = v^2/r), and period/frequency.

topics.title: Relative Velocity in Two Dimensions
topics.description: Vector addition of relative frames (v_AB = v_A - v_B), river-boat crossing problems, and wind-aircraft navigation.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Dynamics

topics.title: Newton Laws of Motion and Free-Body Diagrams
topics.description: Inertia, F_net = ma in component form, action-reaction pairs, normal force, tension, and inclined planes.

topics.title: Frictional Forces and Applications
topics.description: Static vs. kinetic friction coefficients, angle of repose, rolling resistance, and banking of road curves.

topics.title: Work, Kinetic Energy and Work-Energy Theorem
topics.description: Work done by constant and variable forces, kinetic energy (0.5mv^2), and W_net = dKE.

topics.title: Conservative Forces and Potential Energy
topics.description: Gravitational and elastic potential energy, mechanical energy conservation, and non-conservative dissipation.

topics.title: Linear Momentum, Impulse and Collisions
topics.description: Impulse-momentum theorem, conservation of linear momentum, elastic vs. inelastic collisions in 1D and 2D.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Heat Conduction and Calorimetry

topics.title: Thermal Equilibrium and Temperature Measurement
topics.description: Zeroth law of thermodynamics, thermal expansion of solids and liquids, bimetallic strips, and anomalous expansion of water.

topics.title: Heat Capacity and Specific Heat Capacity
topics.description: Quantity of heat (Q = mc dT), method of mixtures calorimetry, water equivalent, and conservation of thermal energy.

topics.title: Phase Changes and Latent Heat
topics.description: Latent heat of fusion and vaporization (Q = mL), cooling curves, supercooling, and evaporation mechanisms.

topics.title: Thermal Conduction, Convection and Radiation
topics.description: Fourier law of heat conduction (dQ/dt = -kA dT/dx), Stefan-Boltzmann law of blackbody radiation, and insulation.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Electrostatics and Electric Circuit

topics.title: Coulomb Law and Electric Field Intensity
topics.description: Quantization of charge, Coulomb inverse square law, superposition principle, electric field lines, and flux.

topics.title: Electric Potential and Potential Energy
topics.description: Electric potential difference (V = W/q), equipotential surfaces, uniform field relations (E = -dV/dr), and work in fields.

topics.title: Capacitance and Dielectrics
topics.description: Parallel-plate capacitors (C = eA/d), dielectric constant, energy stored in capacitors, and series/parallel combinations.

topics.title: Direct Current (DC) Circuits and Kirchhoff Rules
topics.description: Electromotive force (EMF), internal resistance, Kirchhoff junction and loop rules, and bridge network analysis.

topics.title: Electrical Power, Energy and Domestic Safety
topics.description: Joule heating (P = I^2R = VI), fuse ratings, earthing/grounding, three-pin plugs, and electric shock prevention.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 7: Nuclear Physics

topics.title: Nuclear Composition and Nuclear Forces
topics.description: Protons, neutrons, isotopes, isobars, strong nuclear force properties, nuclear density, and nuclear radius.

topics.title: Mass Defect and Nuclear Binding Energy
topics.description: Einstein mass-energy equivalence (E = mc^2), mass defect dm, binding energy per nucleon curve, and stability.

topics.title: Radioactive Decay and Half-Life Calculations
topics.description: Alpha, beta, and gamma radiation, radioactive decay law (N = N0 e^-lt), half-life (t1/2), and activity (Becquerel).

topics.title: Nuclear Reactions: Fission and Fusion
topics.description: Induced nuclear fission, chain reactions, critical mass, nuclear reactors, and thermonuclear fusion in stars.

topics.title: Radiation Hazards, Protection and Applications
topics.description: Dosimetry (Sieverts), biological radiation damage, radiocarbon dating, medical imaging/radiotherapy, and tracer techniques.

topics.title: Inference, Deduction, and Textual Evidence Extraction
