topics.title: Logical Fallacies, Assumptions, and Argument Structure

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Analytical & Logical Reasoning Puzzles

topics.description: UPS power protection, S.M.A.R.T. disk diagnostics, full/incremental/differential backups, and system restore.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 6: Python Programming and Algorithmic Problem Solving

topics.title: Python Data Structures: Lists, Tuples, Dictionaries, and String Manipulation
topics.description: Zero-based indexing, slicing, mutable lists vs immutable tuples, key-value dictionaries, and string methods.

topics.title: Modular Functions, Scope, File Input/Output, and Exception Handling
topics.description: Defining reusable functions, local vs global scope, reading/writing text and CSV files, and try-except blocks.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Relations and Functions

topics.title: Relations, Domain and Range
topics.description: Ordered pairs, Cartesian products, coordinate graphs, domain and range algebraic determination.

topics.title: Inverse Relations and Graphical Reflection
topics.description: Reflection across line y = x, swapping coordinates, and domain/range interchange.

topics.title: Types of Functions: Injective, Surjective, Bijective
topics.description: Horizontal line test, one-to-one (injective), onto (surjective), bijective mappings, and signum/step functions.

topics.title: Composition of Functions
topics.description: Composite function (f o g)(x) = f(g(x)), domain restrictions of composite functions, and non-commutativity.

topics.title: Inverse Functions and Their Graphs
topics.description: Condition for invertibility (bijectivity), finding algebraic formula for f^-1(x), and graphical symmetry.

topics.title: Applications of Relations and Functions
topics.description: Mathematical modeling of economic supply/demand, population growth curves, and physical trajectories.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 2: Rational Expressions and Rational Functions
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Rational Expressions and Rational Functions

topics.title: Rational Expressions: Simplification and Operations
topics.description: Simplification, domain exclusions, addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of polynomial fractions.

topics.title: Rational Equations and Rational Inequalities
topics.description: Clearing denominators, extraneous solutions, sign tables (critical value intervals) for solving inequalities.

topics.title: Rational Functions, Asymptotes and Graphs
topics.description: Vertical asymptotes, horizontal asymptotes, oblique (slant) asymptotes, holes (removable discontinuities), and intercepts.

topics.title: Applications of Rational Functions
topics.description: Rate-of-work problems, mixture concentration models, average cost functions, and distance-rate-time systems.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Matrices

topics.title: Concepts of a Matrix and Matrix Notations
topics.description: Dimensions (rows x columns), entries, row vectors, column vectors, square matrices, and equality of matrices.

topics.title: Matrix Operations: Addition, Scalar & Multiplication
topics.description: Commutative/associative properties of addition, scalar distribution, row-column dot product multiplication criteria.

topics.title: Special Types of Matrices and Transpose
topics.description: Identity matrix, zero matrix, diagonal matrix, symmetric matrix, skew-symmetric matrix, and transpose rules.

topics.title: Elementary Row Operations and Gaussian Elimination
topics.description: Row swapping, scalar multiplication of rows, row replacement, and reducing to row-echelon form.

topics.title: Systems of Linear Equations with Two and Three Variables
topics.description: Augmented matrices, consistent vs. inconsistent systems, unique solutions, infinitely many solutions, and geometric interpretation.

topics.title: Inverse of a Square Matrix and Matrix Equations
topics.description: Invertibility condition, Gauss-Jordan elimination [A | I] -> [I | A^-1], and solving AX = B via X = A^-1 B.

topics.title: Applications of Matrices in Networks and Business
topics.description: Input-output Leontief economic models, network communication graphs, inventory tracking, and cryptography.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Determinants and Their Properties

topics.title: Determinants of 2x2 Matrices
topics.description: Formula det(A) = ad - bc, geometric interpretation as signed area of parallelogram formed by row vectors.

topics.title: Minors, Cofactors and Expansion of 3x3 Determinants
topics.description: Minor Mij, cofactor Cij = (-1)^(i+j) Mij, and Laplace cofactor expansion along any chosen row or column.

topics.title: Properties of Determinants
topics.description: det(AB) = det(A)det(B), effect of row operations on determinants, det(A^T) = det(A), and zero determinant criteria.

topics.title: Adjoint Matrix and Inverse Calculation
topics.description: Cofactor matrix, classical adjoint adj(A) = C^T, and inversion formula A^-1 = (1/det(A)) adj(A).

topics.title: Cramer Rule for Linear Systems
topics.description: Determinant quotient formula xi = det(Ai)/det(A) for non-singular square systems and solvability checks.

topics.title: Applications of Determinants in Geometry
topics.description: Area of triangles via coordinates, collinearity test of three points, and equation of lines through two points.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Vectors

topics.title: Revision on Vectors and Scalars
topics.description: Directed line segments, magnitude ||v||, direction angle, position vectors, and zero vector.

topics.title: Algebraic Representation and Operations in R2 and R3
topics.description: Component form (x, y, z), unit base vectors i, j, k, scalar multiplication, and vector linear combinations.

topics.title: Dot (Scalar) Product and Projections
topics.description: u · v = ||u||||v||cos(theta), angle between vectors, orthogonality conditions, scalar projection and vector projection.

topics.title: Cross (Vector) Product in R3
topics.description: Determinant formulation for cross product, right-hand rule, perpendicularity to both operand vectors, and parallel tests.

topics.title: Applications of Dot and Cross Products
topics.description: Work done, torque, area of parallelogram, area of triangle, and volume of parallelepiped via scalar triple product.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Transformations of the Plane

topics.title: Introduction to Isometries and Rigid Motions
topics.description: Preservation of distance, angle measures, and collinearity in plane geometric transformations.

topics.title: Translations: Vector Formulation and Coordinate Rules
topics.description: T_v(x, y) = (x + a, y + b), composition of translations, and matrix representation.

topics.title: Reflections Across Lines
topics.description: Reflection across x-axis, y-axis, lines y = x, y = -x, and general line ax + by + c = 0.

topics.title: Rotations About the Origin and General Centers
topics.description: Rotation matrices for angles 90, 180, 270, and general theta; center of rotation and clockwise vs counterclockwise.

topics.title: Dilations (Homothety) and Composite Transformations
topics.description: Scale factors, similarity vs. congruence, matrix multiplication for composite mappings, and computer graphics uses.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 7: Statistics

topics.title: Types of Data and Grouped Frequency Distributions
topics.description: Qualitative vs. quantitative data, continuous vs. discrete variables, class intervals, boundaries, and midpoints.

topics.title: Graphical Representation of Grouped Data
topics.description: Frequency histograms, frequency polygons, relative frequency curves, and cumulative frequency ogives.

topics.title: Measures of Central Tendency for Grouped Data
topics.description: Mean via assumed mean method, median formula L + ((N/2 - CF)/f)w, and mode formula L + (d1/(d1 + d2))w.

topics.title: Measures of Dispersion: Variance and Standard Deviation
topics.description: Range, mean absolute deviation, sample/population variance, standard deviation, and coefficient of variation.

topics.title: Real-Life Statistical Applications and Misrepresentations
topics.description: Interpreting national economic data, health survey indices, skewness, and detecting misleading graphical axes.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 8: Probability

topics.title: Fundamental Principle of Counting
topics.description: Multiplication principle, addition principle, tree diagrams, and systematic listing of sample spaces.

topics.title: Permutations and Combinations
topics.description: Factorial notation, linear permutations nPr = n!/(n-r)!, circular permutations, identical item permutations, and combinations nCr.

topics.title: The Binomial Theorem
topics.description: Pascal triangle, binomial expansion formula (a + b)^n = sum(nCr a^(n-r) b^r), and finding specific general terms.

topics.title: Random Experiments, Sample Spaces and Events
topics.description: Sample spaces, mutually exclusive events, independent events, complementary events, and union/intersection Venn diagrams.

topics.title: Probability Axioms and Addition Rules
topics.description: P(A U B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A n B), complementary probability P(A') = 1 - P(A), and odds for/against.

topics.title: Conditional Probability and Multiplication Rule
topics.description: P(A|B) = P(A n B)/P(B), test for statistical independence P(A n B) = P(A)P(B), and two-stage tree diagrams.

topics.title: Real-Life Applications of Probability
topics.description: Quality control defect sampling, genetic cross probabilities, medical diagnostic predictive values, and insurance risk.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 1: Verbal Reasoning and Vocabulary Analogies
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Verbal Reasoning and Vocabulary Analogies

topics.title: Word Relationships and Paired Analogies
topics.description: Synonyms, antonyms, cause-effect, part-to-whole, degree of intensity, and tool-to-worker analogies.

topics.title: Contextual Vocabulary, Synonyms, Antonyms & Sentence Completion
topics.description: Using contrast clues, restatement clues, and transitional signals to deduce missing vocabulary.

topics.title: Verbal Classification, Idioms & Odd-Word-Out Analysis
topics.description: Categorizing semantic clusters and identifying conceptual anomalies under strict time limits.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 2: Reading Comprehension and Critical Argument Analysis
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Reading Comprehension and Critical Argument Analysis

topics.title: Primary Purpose, Main Idea, and Author Tone Analysis
topics.description: Identifying the author’s primary argument, persuasive strategies, and critical biases in academic passages.

topics.title: Inference, Deduction, and Textual Evidence Extraction
topics.description: Distinguishing explicitly stated facts from substantiated inferences and unwarranted assumptions.

topics.title: Logical Fallacies, Assumptions, and Argument Structure
topics.description: Ad hominem, circular reasoning, post hoc, false dichotomy, and evaluating premises.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Analytical & Logical Reasoning Puzzles

topics.title: Deductive Logic, Syllogisms, and Conditional Statements
topics.description: Universal and particular premises, contrapositives, Euler circles, and valid logical deductions.

topics.title: Linear Ordering, Circular Seating, and Scheduling Games
topics.description: Constraint satisfaction tables, relative positioning, and multi-condition seating puzzles.

topics.title: Blood Relations, Direction Sense, and Coding-Decoding
topics.description: Family tree generation mapping, cardinal compass displacements, and alphanumeric cipher patterns.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 4: Quantitative Aptitude: Arithmetic, Ratios, and Word Problems
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Quantitative Aptitude: Arithmetic, Ratios, and Word Problems

topics.title: Number Properties, Divisibility, LCM/GCD, and Remainder Rules
topics.description: Prime factorization, parity rules, cyclic unit digits, and modular remainder shortcuts.

topics.title: Ratios, Proportions, Percentages, Profit/Loss, and Interest
topics.description: Successive percentage changes, markup/discount, simple and compound interest calculations.

topics.title: Work-Rate, Mixture/Alligation, and Speed-Distance-Time Problems
topics.description: Combined work rates 1/T = 1/A + 1/B, weighted mixture rules, average speed, and relative velocity.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 5: Quantitative Aptitude: Algebra, Sequences, and Probability
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Quantitative Aptitude: Algebra, Sequences, and Probability

topics.title: Numerical Series, Pattern Recognition, and Algebraic Equations
topics.description: Arithmetic, geometric, alternating, second-difference, and Fibonacci sequence rules.

topics.title: Data Interpretation: Tables, Bar Charts, Pie Charts, and Line Graphs
topics.description: Extracting cross-tabulated values, percentage growth rates, and sector angle conversions.

topics.title: Counting Principles, Permutations, Combinations, and Probability
topics.description: Fundamental counting rule, nPr vs nCr selection formulas, and independent/mutually exclusive events.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 6: Spatial Reasoning and EUEE Aptitude Test Mastery
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Spatial Reasoning and EUEE Aptitude Test Mastery

topics.title: Pattern Matrix Completion, Rotations, and Spatial Visualization
topics.description: Rotational symmetry, reflection axes, 3D cube folding nets, and figure series completion.

topics.title: Quantitative Comparison (Quantity A vs. Quantity B) & Data Sufficiency

topics.title: High-Speed EUEE Aptitude Pacing, Elimination & Trap-Avoidance Strategies
topics.description: Managing the 60-question / 120-minute EUEE Aptitude exam with zero-panic elimination techniques.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 1: Advanced EUEE Verbal Aptitude: Analogies, Synonyms, Antonyms & Precision Lexicon
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Advanced EUEE Verbal Aptitude: Analogies, Synonyms, Antonyms & Precision Lexicon

topics.title: Nine Core EUEE Analogy Bridges (Function, Degree, Part-Whole, Cause-Effect, Worker-Tool)
topics.description: Constructing diagnostic bridge sentences and avoiding reversed-order and part-of-speech traps.

topics.title: High-Frequency EUEE Vocabulary, Roots, Prefixes, Synonyms & Antonyms
topics.description: Greek/Latin roots (bene, mal, omni, equi, ver), contextual synonym precision, and polarity contrast.

topics.title: Double-Blank Sentence Completion & Discourse Transition Signals
topics.description: Contrast triggers (albeit, notwithstanding, whereas), cause-effect linkers, and two-blank elimination.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 2: Advanced Reading Comprehension & Scientific/Social Passage Synthesis
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Advanced Reading Comprehension & Scientific/Social Passage Synthesis

topics.title: Analyzing Natural Science, Economics & Humanities EUEE Passages
topics.description: Structural mapping of thesis statements, experimental evidence, counter-theories, and author synthesis.

topics.title: Strengthening/Weakening Arguments, Necessary vs. Sufficient Assumptions
topics.description: Negation test for necessary assumptions, causal link validation, and identifying alternate explanations.

topics.title: Evaluating Paradoxes, Counterarguments & Author Perspective
topics.description: Resolving apparent discrepancies, tone spectrum analysis, and eliminating extreme/out-of-scope distractors.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 3: Formal Logic, Analytical Games & Deductive Reasoning
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Formal Logic, Analytical Games & Deductive Reasoning

topics.title: Propositional Logic, Contrapositives & Quantifiers
topics.description: Conditional rule If P then Q ⇔ If not Q then not P, Converse/Inverse fallacies, and De Morgan laws.

topics.title: Multi-Variable Grouping, Matrix Logic & Selection Constraint Puzzles
topics.description: In/Out selection grids, biconditional blocks, and rapid deduction chains for EUEE analytical games.

topics.title: Venn Diagram Set Logic, Syllogistic Validity & Family Tree Deductions
topics.description: Three-set inclusion-exclusion n(A ∪ B ∪ C), categorical syllogisms, and multi-generation kinship puzzles.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 4: Advanced Quantitative Reasoning: Algebraic Modeling & Word Problems
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Advanced Quantitative Reasoning: Algebraic Modeling & Word Problems

topics.title: Quantitative Comparison Strategies (Equal/Not-Equal Plug-In Method)
topics.description: Testing boundary numbers (0, 1, −1, 1/2, 2, 100) to compare Quantity A and Quantity B rapidly.

topics.title: Multi-Worker Rate Problems, Relative Velocity & Age Equations
topics.description: Pipes and cisterns, opposite/same-direction relative speeds, boat-stream equations, and age shift matrices.

topics.title: Inequalities, Absolute Value, Exponents, Radicals & Function Models
topics.description: Sign-reversal rules, compound inequalities, fractional exponents, and custom symbol operator functions.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Geometry, Combinatorics, Probability & Statistics for SAT

topics.title: Plane & Coordinate Geometry Shortcuts (Triangles, Circles, Polygons, Slopes)
topics.description: Pythagorean triples (3-4-5, 5-12-13), 30°-60°-90° and 45°-45°-90° triangles, arc/sector formulas, and slopes.

topics.title: Permutations, Combinations, Conditional Probability & Expected Value
topics.description: Committee selection with restrictions, complementary probability 1 − P(none), and conditional tree diagrams.

topics.title: Statistics: Weighted Averages, Median, Quartiles, Variance & Standard Deviation
topics.description: Effect of adding/multiplying a constant on mean and standard deviation, and balancing lever averages.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 6: Data Sufficiency, Multi-Chart Interpretation & Full EUEE SAT Blueprint
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Data Sufficiency, Multi-Chart Interpretation & Full EUEE SAT Blueprint

topics.title: Multi-Source Data Interpretation (Combined Pie Charts, Stacked Bars & Growth Tables)
topics.description: Synthesizing ratios across linked charts, compound annual growth rates, and visual estimation shortcuts.

topics.title: Data Sufficiency Decision Tree (AD/BCE Elimination Grid)
topics.description: Evaluating Statement (1) alone, Statement (2) alone, combined sufficiency, and avoiding C-trap assumptions.

topics.title: 60-Question / 120-Minute EUEE SAT Time-Management Blueprint & Common Traps
topics.description: Optimal 35-Verbal + 25-Quantitative pacing plan, two-pass triage strategy, and high-yield EUEE checklists.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 1: Academic Reading and Synthesizing Complex Information
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Academic Reading and Synthesizing Complex Information

topics.title: Academic Reading: Text Analysis, Tone and Main Ideas
topics.description: Skimming scholarly articles for main idea, scanning for supporting empirical data, evaluating author purpose and objective vs subjective tone, making logical inferences from academic prose, and distinguishing asserted facts from hypotheses.

topics.title: Scholarly Vocabulary: Affixation and Academic Word List
topics.description: Morphological word analysis: Latin and Greek prefixes (anti-, bio-, inter-, poly-, trans-) and suffixes (-tion, -ize, -ous, -able); Contextual collocations in university research papers; Connotative nuances of scholarly synonyms.

topics.title: Advanced Relative Clauses and Sentence Synthesis
topics.description: Defining vs non-defining relative clauses (comma rules, which vs that, who vs whom, whose); Reduced relative clauses (participle clauses using present -ing and past -ed participles); Combining simple sentences into cohesive compound-complex academic sentences.

topics.title: Speaking and Discussion: Academic Seminars and Debates
topics.description: Active listening during scholarly presentations, formulating constructive questions, discourse markers for polite disagreement ("While I acknowledge your point, evidence suggests..."), and summarizing group conclusions.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 2: Advanced Grammatical Structures for Entrance Examinations
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Advanced Grammatical Structures for Entrance Examinations

topics.title: Mastery of Conditional Sentences and Counterfactuals
topics.description: Zero, First, Second, and Third Conditionals review; Mixed conditionals (unreal past action with present consequence: If + past perfect, would + base verb); Formal inversion without 'if' ("Had I known the schedule...", "Were the committee to approve...", "Should you require assistance...").

topics.title: Advanced Passive Voice Constructions
topics.description: Passive with reporting verbs for academic objectivity ("It is widely believed that...", "The findings are said to indicate..."); Passive infinitive and gerund forms; Causative passive structures (have/get something done); Avoiding agent identification when agent is unknown or irrelevant.

topics.title: Reported Speech and Indirect Discourse
topics.description: Tense backshift rules in reported speech (simple present to simple past, present perfect to past perfect); Exceptions when reporting universal scientific truths; Reporting verbs with specific patterns (insist on, apologize for, deny + gerund, advise someone to do); Shifting time and place adverbs.

topics.title: Modals of Deduction, Speculation and Past Regret
topics.description: Present deduction (must be, can't be, might be); Past deduction and speculation (must have been, can't have done, might have seen); Expressing past obligation and regret (should have studied, ought to have submitted); Common multiple-choice distractors in national EUEE entrance exams.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Scientific and Technical Writing

topics.title: Expository Writing: Process Descriptions and Technical Reports
topics.description: Structuring laboratory reports: Introduction, Materials & Methods (passive voice sequential instructions), Results, and Discussion; Sequential connectors (initially, subsequently, simultaneously, following this, ultimately); Precision and concise scientific prose.

topics.title: Cause-and-Effect Discourse Analysis
topics.description: Expressing causal relationships using diverse grammatical structures: Prepositions (due to, owing to, as a consequence of), Conjunctions (since, because, as), Transitional adverbs (consequently, therefore, thus, as a result); Structuring multi-paragraph cause-and-effect analytical essays.

topics.title: Technical Vocabulary and Precise Scientific Phrasing
topics.description: Domain-specific vocabulary in STEM and social sciences; Avoiding vague colloquial language (e.g. replacing "make it bigger" with "amplify/expand", "get rid of" with "eliminate"); Technical collocations and standardized SI measurement phrasing.

topics.title: Interpreting Graphical Data and Technical Visuals
topics.description: Describing trends in charts, graphs, and tables: Upward trends (surge, climb, escalate), downward trends (plummet, decline, dip), fluctuations and plateauing; Quantifying changes using adverbs (substantially, marginally, exponentially).

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 4: Persuasive Rhetoric and Public Speaking
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Persuasive Rhetoric and Public Speaking

topics.title: Rhetorical Devices and Persuasive Discourse
topics.description: Classical appeals: Ethos (credibility), Pathos (emotional resonance), Logos (logical reasoning and empirical evidence); Rhetorical strategies: Parallelism, rhetorical questions, antithesis, tricolon (rule of three), and identifying common logical fallacies (ad hominem, false dichotomy, slippery slope).

topics.title: Composing Argumentative and Persuasive Essays
topics.description: Developing an arguable, nuanced thesis statement; Structuring introductory hook, body paragraphs with evidence, acknowledging counter-arguments with robust rebuttals, and crafting a resonant concluding call to action.

topics.title: Sentence Inversion for Emphasis and Cleft Sentences
topics.description: Negative adverbial inversion ("Rarely have we witnessed...", "Not only did they succeed, but they also...", "Under no circumstances should you..."); It-clefts ("It was the lack of infrastructure that caused the delay") and Wh-clefts ("What the research demonstrates is...").

topics.title: Public Speaking, Oratory and Pronunciation Intonation
topics.description: Vocal projection, pacing, pauses for emphasis; Intonation patterns in statements vs questions; Sentence stress highlighting contrasting key words; Overcoming public speaking anxiety and engaging an audience.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 5: University Life and Scholarly Communication
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: University Life and Scholarly Communication

topics.title: University Lectures: Listening Comprehension and Cornell Note-Taking
topics.description: Listening for lecture signposting language (introducing topics, digressing, emphasizing key takeaways, signaling exam focus); Implementing the Cornell note-taking system: Cue column, main notes section, and summary block; Using standard academic abbreviations.

topics.title: Academic Integrity: Paraphrasing, Summarizing and Citation
topics.description: Understanding plagiarism and intellectual honesty; Techniques for effective paraphrasing: changing word forms, using synonyms, altering sentence structures while preserving original meaning; Summarizing multi-page articles into concise abstracts; Basic citation formatting.

topics.title: Formal Correspondence and Application Writing
topics.description: Writing formal university and scholarship application letters; Statement of Purpose (SOP) structure; Register differences between formal letters (Dear Professor..., Sincerely) and informal emails; Formatting a modern student Curriculum Vitae (CV).

topics.title: Entrance Examination Test-Taking Strategies
topics.description: Strategic time management on the 100-question English EUEE paper; Process of elimination for tricky grammar distractors; Contextual inference shortcuts for reading comprehension; Avoiding panic traps in vocabulary questions.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Sequences and Series

topics.title: Arithmetic Sequences and Series
topics.description: Common difference d, recursive definition, general n-th term a_n = a_1 + (n-1)d, arithmetic means, partial sum S_n = n/2(2a_1 + (n-1)d) = n/2(a_1 + a_n).

topics.title: Geometric Sequences and Series
topics.description: Common ratio r, general term a_n = a_1·r^(n-1), geometric means, sum of finite geometric series S_n = a_1(1-r^n)/(1-r), convergence conditions and infinite sum S_inf = a_1/(1-r) for |r| < 1.

topics.title: Sigma Notation and Mathematical Induction
topics.description: Properties of summation operator Σ, index shifts, linearity of sums, the Principle of Mathematical Induction (Base step, Inductive hypothesis, Inductive proof step).

topics.title: Real-World Applications of Sequences and Series
topics.description: Compound interest formulas A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt), simple annuities, depreciation models, biological cell division sequences, and national economic growth projections.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 2: Introduction to Limits and Continuity
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Introduction to Limits and Continuity

topics.title: Intuitive and Algebraic Concept of Limits
topics.description: Definition of limits, one-sided limits (left-hand and right-hand), limit laws (sum, product, quotient, power), and evaluating limits by factoring, expansion, and conjugate rationalization.

topics.title: Limits Involving Infinity and Indeterminate Forms
topics.description: Infinite limits, limits at infinity, resolving 0/0 and inf/inf forms, identifying horizontal and vertical asymptotes of rational functions, and Squeeze (Sandwich) Theorem.

topics.title: Continuity of Functions
topics.description: Three conditions for continuity at a point (f(c) defined, lim f(x) exists, lim f(x) = f(c)), continuity on intervals, removable vs essential discontinuities, and Intermediate Value Theorem (IVT).

topics.title: Special Trigonometric Limits
topics.description: Fundamental limit lim(x->0) [sin(x)/x] = 1, lim(x->0) [(1 - cos(x))/x] = 0, and evaluating trigonometric indeterminate limits in EUEE.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Introduction to Differential Calculus

topics.title: The Derivative as an Instantaneous Rate of Change
topics.description: Difference quotient, limit definition f'(x) = lim(h->0) [f(x+h) - f(x)]/h, geometric slope of tangent line, instantaneous velocity and acceleration.

topics.title: Fundamental Rules of Differentiation
topics.description: Constant rule, Power rule d/dx(x^n) = n·x^(n-1), Constant multiple rule, Sum and difference rules, Product rule (uv)' = u'v + uv', Quotient rule (u/v)' = (u'v - uv')/v^2.

topics.title: The Chain Rule and Implicit Differentiation
topics.description: Derivatives of composite functions dy/dx = (dy/du)·(du/dx), extended power rule, implicit differentiation for curves F(x, y) = 0, higher order derivatives f''(x) and f^(n)(x).

topics.title: Derivatives of Trigonometric, Exponential and Logarithmic Functions
topics.description: Derivatives of sin x, cos x, tan x, sec x, e^x, a^x, ln x, log_a x, and logarithmic differentiation for complex products.

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Applications of Differential Calculus

topics.title: Critical Points, Monotonicity and Extreme Values
topics.description: Critical numbers (where f'(c) = 0 or undefined), Fermat's Theorem, Extreme Value Theorem on closed intervals [a, b], First Derivative Test for local maxima and minima.

topics.title: Concavity, Points of Inflection and Curve Sketching
topics.description: Second derivative test for local extrema, concavity test (f''(x) > 0 concave up, f''(x) < 0 concave down), points of inflection, combining asymptotes and intercepts for complete curve sketching.

topics.title: Applied Optimization Problems
topics.description: Translating word problems into objective functions, constraints, domain restrictions, maximizing profit/area/volume, minimizing cost/material in construction and commerce.

topics.title: Related Rates of Change
topics.description: Differentiating with respect to time t using chain rule, geometric modeling (expanding spherical balloons, draining conical tanks, sliding ladders, shadow movement).

book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Introduction to Integral Calculus

topics.title: Antiderivatives and Indefinite Integrals
topics.description: Definition of antiderivative, indefinite integral symbol ∫ f(x) dx = F(x) + C, power rule for integration ∫ x^n dx = (x^(n+1))/(n+1) + C (n ≠ -1), integrals of trigonometric and exponential functions.

topics.title: Integration by Substitution (u-Substitution)
topics.description: Reversing the chain rule: ∫ f(g(x))g'(x) dx = ∫ f(u) du, choosing appropriate substitution variable u, transforming differentials and limits of integration.

topics.title: The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus (FTC)

topics.title: Applications of Definite Integrals
topics.description: Calculating exact planar area between curves f(x) and g(x), net displacement vs total distance traveled given velocity v(t), average value of a continuous function.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 6: Three Dimensional Geometry and Vectors

topics.title: Vectors and Coordinate System in Three-Dimensional Space

topics.title: Cross Product of Vectors in 3D Space
topics.description: Vector product u × v, determinant calculation, magnitude |u × v| = |u||v|sin θ (area of parallelogram), right-hand rule for direction, collinearity condition u × v = 0.

topics.title: Equations of Lines and Planes in 3D Space
topics.description: Vector and parametric equations of lines in space r(t) = r_0 + t·v, symmetric equations, standard equation of a plane A(x - x0) + B(y - y0) + C(z - z0) = 0 using normal vector n.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 1: Advanced EUEE Verbal Aptitude: Analogies, Synonyms, Antonyms & Precision Lexicon
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 1: Advanced EUEE Verbal Aptitude: Analogies, Synonyms, Antonyms & Precision Lexicon

topics.title: Nine Core EUEE Analogy Bridges (Function, Degree, Part-Whole, Cause-Effect, Worker-Tool)
topics.description: Constructing diagnostic bridge sentences and avoiding reversed-order and part-of-speech traps.

topics.title: High-Frequency EUEE Vocabulary, Roots, Prefixes, Synonyms & Antonyms
topics.description: Greek/Latin roots (bene, mal, omni, equi, ver), contextual synonym precision, and polarity contrast.

topics.title: Double-Blank Sentence Completion & Discourse Transition Signals
topics.description: Contrast triggers (albeit, notwithstanding, whereas), cause-effect linkers, and two-blank elimination.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 2: Advanced Reading Comprehension & Scientific/Social Passage Synthesis
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 2: Advanced Reading Comprehension & Scientific/Social Passage Synthesis

topics.title: Analyzing Natural Science, Economics & Humanities EUEE Passages
topics.description: Structural mapping of thesis statements, experimental evidence, counter-theories, and author synthesis.

topics.title: Strengthening/Weakening Arguments, Necessary vs. Sufficient Assumptions
topics.description: Negation test for necessary assumptions, causal link validation, and identifying alternate explanations.

topics.title: Evaluating Paradoxes, Counterarguments & Author Perspective
topics.description: Resolving apparent discrepancies, tone spectrum analysis, and eliminating extreme/out-of-scope distractors.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 3: Formal Logic, Analytical Games & Deductive Reasoning
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 3: Formal Logic, Analytical Games & Deductive Reasoning

topics.title: Propositional Logic, Contrapositives & Quantifiers
topics.description: Conditional rule If P then Q ⇔ If not Q then not P, Converse/Inverse fallacies, and De Morgan laws.

topics.title: Multi-Variable Grouping, Matrix Logic & Selection Constraint Puzzles
topics.description: In/Out selection grids, biconditional blocks, and rapid deduction chains for EUEE analytical games.

topics.title: Venn Diagram Set Logic, Syllogistic Validity & Family Tree Deductions
topics.description: Three-set inclusion-exclusion n(A ∪ B ∪ C), categorical syllogisms, and multi-generation kinship puzzles.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 4: Advanced Quantitative Reasoning: Algebraic Modeling & Word Problems
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 4: Advanced Quantitative Reasoning: Algebraic Modeling & Word Problems

topics.title: Quantitative Comparison Strategies (Equal/Not-Equal Plug-In Method)
topics.description: Testing boundary numbers (0, 1, −1, 1/2, 2, 100) to compare Quantity A and Quantity B rapidly.

topics.title: Multi-Worker Rate Problems, Relative Velocity & Age Equations
topics.description: Pipes and cisterns, opposite/same-direction relative speeds, boat-stream equations, and age shift matrices.

topics.title: Inequalities, Absolute Value, Exponents, Radicals & Function Models
topics.description: Sign-reversal rules, compound inequalities, fractional exponents, and custom symbol operator functions.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 5: Geometry, Combinatorics, Probability & Statistics for SAT
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 5: Geometry, Combinatorics, Probability & Statistics for SAT

topics.title: Plane & Coordinate Geometry Shortcuts (Triangles, Circles, Polygons, Slopes)
topics.description: Pythagorean triples (3-4-5, 5-12-13), 30°-60°-90° and 45°-45°-90° triangles, arc/sector formulas, and slopes.

topics.title: Permutations, Combinations, Conditional Probability & Expected Value
topics.description: Committee selection with restrictions, complementary probability 1 − P(none), and conditional tree diagrams.

topics.title: Statistics: Weighted Averages, Median, Quartiles, Variance & Standard Deviation
topics.description: Effect of adding/multiplying a constant on mean and standard deviation, and balancing lever averages.

book_chapters.chapter_title: Unit 6: Data Sufficiency, Multi-Chart Interpretation & Full EUEE SAT Blueprint
book_chapters.description: Curriculum Unit 6: Data Sufficiency, Multi-Chart Interpretation & Full EUEE SAT Blueprint

topics.title: Multi-Source Data Interpretation (Combined Pie Charts, Stacked Bars & Growth Tables)
topics.description: Synthesizing ratios across linked charts, compound annual growth rates, and visual estimation shortcuts.

topics.title: Data Sufficiency Decision Tree (AD/BCE Elimination Grid)
topics.description: Evaluating Statement (1) alone, Statement (2) alone, combined sufficiency, and avoiding C-trap assumptions.

topics.title: 60-Question / 120-Minute EUEE SAT Time-Management Blueprint & Common Traps
topics.description: Optimal 35-Verbal + 25-Quantitative pacing plan, two-pass triage strategy, and high-yield EUEE checklists.

topics.description: Synergy between indigenous institutions (Iddir, Iqub, Debo) and formal socio-economic development.

topics.description: Cultural pluralism, accommodation of diversity, equality of cultures, and mutual respect.

topics.description: Constitutional patriotism vs destructive chauvinism and narrow extremism.

topics.title: The Role of Youth in Strengthening National Cohesion
topics.description: Youth leadership in peacebuilding, national service, and cross-regional solidarity.
